papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive (AR) language models by letting a small model draft tokens serially and a large model verify them in parallel. We reverse these roles. Starting from a standard AR checkpoint, we fine-tune the large model into a proposer that predicts a block of future tokens in a single forward pass, then use one additional forward pass to verify the proposed block. This gives ProVe, Proposer-Verifier decoding. The verifier can be a smaller AR model or the proposer itself; the latter gives ProVe-lossless, which reproduces the proposer's greedy AR decoding. Block proposals already provide substantial room for acceleration: with a block size of 16, the proposed block has an average AR-matching prefix of 6.6 tokens on GSM8K. Across six benchmarks with a 32B proposer, ProVe-lossless reaches 2.5x average AR throughput without training a separate draft head. With a small 3B verifier, ProVe reaches 2.7x average throughput at 2.6 accuracy points below AR on the six-task average, providing a controllable tradeoff between speed and accuracy.

analysis.key_results: 块大小为16时，GSM8K上平均AR匹配前缀为6.6个token；32B提议者在六个基准上，ProVe-lossless达到2.5倍平均AR吞吐量（无独立草稿头）；使用3B验证者，ProVe达到2.7倍平均吞吐量，但六任务平均准确率比AR低2.6个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ProVe（Proposer-Verifier decoding），将标准AR检查点的大模型微调为提议者，直接预测未来token块，并展示其相比标准推测解码在速度和准确性权衡上的优势。
analysis.method: ProVe：微调大模型作为提议者以单次前向预测未来token块，然后使用验证者（小AR模型或提议者自身）进行一次额外前向验证；ProVe-lossless使用提议者自身作为验证者，完全复现贪婪AR解码。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出ProVe（提议者-验证者解码），通过反转标准推测解码中草稿模型和验证模型的角色：将大模型微调为提议者，一次前向预测一块未来token，再用一次前向验证该块，实现无独立草稿头的高吞吐量自回归解码。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于语言模型的高效解码，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域；但其提出的大模型作为提议者的块级自回归加速方法，可直接应用于机器人策略模型（如VLA）的推理优化，具有潜在价值。

papers.title: ProVe: Proposer-Verifier Decoding
papers.title_zh: ProVe：提议者-验证者解码

papers.abstract: Action-free videos are an appealing substitute for costly teleoperated data. Latent action models (LAMs) turn videos into a supervision signal by inferring abstract actions between frames. Existing LAMs observe a single camera view, which resolves 6D robot actions only ambiguously missing out-of-plane movements and potential occlusions. We propose a LAM that ingests synchronized multi-camera views using cross-attention to resolve depth and occlusions before compressing them into latent actions. The latent actions are fed into a policy in which a latent expert and an action expert are coupled by sequential flow matching around a frozen VLM backbone. We further evaluate in strict cross-embodiment settings where task-specific demonstrations come from other embodiments. We show that dual-view LAM pretraining improves the decodability of ground-truth 6D actions by 17% compared to single-view, while scaling single-view data by two orders of magnitude is not sufficient to fully recover out-of-plane motions. The downstream policy improves success rate by +13.5% compared to +6.2% for single-view LAM. A single cross-embodiment is sufficient for skill transfer, and adding a second viewpoint outperforms adding up to four further embodiments. The results transfer to hardware where demonstrations come from a human hand improving success rate by +20% over action-only policies in 850 rollouts. We show that video and robot data are complementary, and that benefits of learning from video are task-dependent. Website: https://learnsyslab.github.io/multiview_latent_action_pretraining/

analysis.key_results: 双视角LAM预训练相比单视角将地面真值6D动作的可解码性提高17%；下游策略成功率提高+13.5%（单视角为+6.2%）；硬件实验中人类手部演示使成功率相比仅动作策略提高+20%；跨具身设置中单个跨具身即可实现技能迁移，添加第二视角优于添加最多四个额外具身。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种多视角潜在动作模型（Multi-View LAM），利用同步多相机视图和交叉注意力来解析深度和遮挡，以改进潜在动作的表征和解码，并提升跨具身策略学习。
analysis.method: 使用多视角潜在动作模型（LAM）进行预训练，该模型通过交叉注意力融合同步多相机视图，压缩得到潜在动作；下游策略采用潜在专家与动作专家通过序列流匹配耦合在一个冻结的VLM骨干上。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种利用同步多相机视图的潜在动作模型，通过交叉注意力解析深度和遮挡，将潜在动作输入策略以提升跨具身机器人学习性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接涉及机器人策略学习，使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干和潜在动作建模，属于VLA范畴；其多视角潜在动作建模与从视频学习机器人策略密切相关，对跨具身泛化和实际硬件部署有直接价值。

figures.caption: Method : We combine latent action pretraining from in-domain cross-embodiment videos with a downstream flow-matching policy. First, latent actions are inferred from a large cross-embodiment video dataset. Second, a sequential policy is learned on the latent actions and a small set of demonstrations on the target embodiment. The LAM uses a spatio-temporal transformer to merge multiple viewpoints before computing the latents. The spatial block attends to patches of other viewpoints, yielding latent actions grounded in 3D space. Latent action labels and real robot actions are jointly used to train a hierarchical downstream policy. The policy uses sequential flow matching experts and outputs actions applied to the robot.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Multi-View Latent Action Pretraining for Cross-Embodiment Robot Learning from Videos

papers.abstract: Human-collected real-world robotic manipulation demonstrations often contain mixed-quality trajectories, including hesitant, indirect, or inefficient action segments. While diffusion- and flow-based policies can model such multimodal data, standard behavior cloning (BC) assigns equal likelihood to all demonstrated actions and may therefore reproduce suboptimal modes. Offline RL value estimates offer a natural signal for biasing policies toward higher-value behavioral modes, but directly fine-tuning the generative policy or using critic gradients for policy steering can amplify critic errors and induce prior drift. We propose Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering (AWLS), an offline post-training method for improving frozen one-step generative manipulation policies without updating their decoders. AWLS learns a residual noise shaper, an observation-conditioned residual correction to the policy's latent noise, and trains it with an advantage-weighted action reconstruction objective. The advantages are detached, scale-normalized, and used only as supervised weights on demonstrated actions, avoiding critic-gradient policy updates while preserving fast single-step inference. We further introduce a rollout-free decoder-sensitivity criterion for selecting pretrained checkpoints that remain responsive to latent-noise perturbations. Experiments on simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks with clean and mixed-quality demonstrations show that AWLS improves over the frozen base policy while limiting drift from the pretrained behavior prior. Project page: https://awls-corl2026.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在模拟和真实机器人操作任务上的实验表明，AWLS相比冻结基础策略有所提升，同时限制了预训练行为先验的漂移。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出优势加权潜在引导（AWLS）方法，在不更新解码器的前提下，通过学习残差噪声整形器对冻结的一步生成式策略进行后训练，以利用混合质量演示数据并改善策略行为。
analysis.method: AWLS学习观测条件下的残差噪声校正，并通过优势加权的动作重建目标进行训练；优势值被分离、缩放归一化，仅作为监督权重，避免基于梯度的批评家策略更新；同时引入无rollout的解码器敏感性准则选择适合的预训练检查点。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AWLS方法，通过优势加权残差噪声整形对冻结的一步生成式操作策略进行离线后训练，以提升性能并保持单步推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究针对机器人操作生成式策略（VLA相关）的效率与性能提升，通过保持单步推理并优化策略行为，对VLA系统的后训练具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint of large language models, but preserving accuracy with efficient training remains challenging. Scalar quantization encodes weights independently, while explicit-codebook vector quantization introduces costly search during training. We propose E8-QAT, a 2-bit quantization-aware training framework that uses the $E_8$ lattice as an implicit eight-dimensional codebook. It jointly quantizes weight groups through arithmetic projection without storing or searching an explicit codebook during the training forward pass. A 2-bit core encoding and sparse extension preserve the selected lattice points exactly, adding less than 0.1\% to core index storage. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, E8-QAT matches the performance of the full-precision model in terms of the average score across the four tasks. E8-QAT improves over the state-of-the-art baseline by 2.03\% on IFEval and by 1.51\% on LiveCodeBench, under the same data, schedule, and bit width. The 2-bit representation reduces peak memory by 80\% and supports a $4\times$ larger batch. At each representation's largest feasible batch, E8-QAT reaches $1.97\times$ the decoding throughput of BF16.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上，E8-QAT在四个任务的平均分数上与全精度模型相当；在相同数据、调度和位宽下，E8-QAT在IFEval上比最先进的基线提高了2.03%，在LiveCodeBench上提高了1.51%；2位表示将峰值内存降低80%，并支持4倍更大的批次；在各表示最大可行批次下，E8-QAT的解码吞吐量达到BF16的1.97倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出E8-QAT，一种使用E8晶格作为隐式八维码本的2位量化感知训练框架，无需显式码本的存储或搜索，即可实现高效低比特量化。
analysis.method: 使用E8晶格作为隐式八维码本，通过算术投影联合量化权重组，训练前向过程中不存储或搜索显式码本；采用2位核心编码和稀疏扩展精确保持选定的格点。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: E8-QAT使用E8晶格作为隐式八维码本，在2位量化感知训练中实现了与全精度模型相当的性能，并显著降低内存占用。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大型语言模型的低比特量化感知训练，未直接涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界-动作模型（WAM）。然而，其提出的E8-QAT作为一种高效推断的量化方法，可能为在资源受限的机器人平台上部署VLA或WAM模型提供潜在价值，但摘要中未给出具体证据。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer knowledge from large-scale pretraining into robot control, but their manipulation performance remains sensitive to changes in observation conditions, which recent work addresses by fine-tuning the visual module on target-domain data. However, it remains unclear how such adaptation affects robustness beyond the target condition, as existing robustness benchmarks only evaluate models without fine-tuning and adaptation studies only report the target gain. Measuring this cross-dimension effect requires separating target gains from off-target changes, isolating adaptation effects from architectural differences, ruling out generic forgetting, and comparing tuning choices. Therefore, we introduce VLA-Retain, a benchmark that compares five open VLA models, tuned on Camera-view or Sensor-noise data, with their own base checkpoints on LIBERO-Plus dataset spanning seven perturbation dimensions. Our study reveals four findings. First, targeted vision tuning is not local, and its target gain does not predict retention. Mean off-target gain is negative in 8 of 10 model--domain configurations. Under Camera-view tuning, X-VLA gains $69.4$ percentage points on the target but loses $4.6$ points on average elsewhere, whereas OpenVLA-OFT gains $39.3$ and $1.4$ points, respectively. Second, these regressions are not explained only by performance loss on the same tasks without perturbations. Third, broader training coverage raises overall gain over target-specific training but does not eliminate dimension-level regressions. Fourth, tuning strategies are model-dependent, as DELTA-style feature preservation raises X-VLA's mean off-target gain to $+1.2$ points but lowers OpenVLA-OFT's to $-23.1$. Overall, these findings show that target-domain success alone is insufficient and highlight cross-dimensional retention as a key criterion for targeted VLA adaptation.

analysis.key_results: 10个模型-域配置中有8个的平均脱靶增益为负；Camera-view调优下X-VLA目标增益69.4个百分点但平均脱靶损失4.6个百分点，OpenVLA-OFT增益39.3和1.4个百分点；DELTA式特征保留对X-VLA提高平均脱靶增益至+1.2但降低OpenVLA-OFT至-23.1。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入VLA-Retain基准，系统评估五种开源VLA模型在Camera-view或Sensor-noise调优后的跨维度效应，揭示目标域增益与跨维度稳健性之间的脱节。
analysis.method: 在LIBERO-Plus数据集上，对五种VLA模型进行相机视角或传感器噪声调优，并与各自基础检查点进行比较，分离目标增益与跨维度变化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VLA-Retain基准评估了视觉调优对VLA模型在目标域和跨扰动维度上的性能影响，发现目标增益不能预测跨维度保留率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA模型在视觉调优后的跨维度稳健性问题，研究结果对机器人操作中的策略学习和部署具有实际意义。

papers.abstract: Simulation-ready world reconstruction demands physical interactivity beyond visual realism, which existing black-box 3D generation fails to deliver. We present NeoWorld-3, a coding-agent framework that reconstructs interactive 3D worlds from visual observations via tunable, executable programs. At its core, NeoSDK provides the underlying computational engine for low-level geometries, part composition, differentiable parameter refinement, and physics validation. At the same time, NeoMCP exposes these capabilities as structured, tool-callable APIs for vision-language agents to visually inspect, edit code, and iteratively refine programs. Through a hierarchical coordinator-worker architecture, the framework scales seamlessly from standalone articulated objects to complex compositional scenes. Evaluations across object-level and scene-level reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that NeoWorld-3 achieves state-of-the-art geometric fidelity and physical readiness. Crucially, manipulation trajectories planned within our reconstructed twins achieve successful zero-shot execution on a physical dual-arm robot, completing the Real-Sim-Real loop.

analysis.key_results: 在物体级和场景级重建基准上达到最先进的几何保真度和物理就绪度；在重建的数字孪生中规划的操控轨迹在真实双臂机器人上实现零样本执行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NeoWorld-3框架，利用编码代理从视觉观察重建可交互、物理就绪的3D世界，并通过NeoSDK和NeoMCP实现几何、物理与代码的迭代优化。
analysis.method: 分层协调器-工作者架构，底层NeoSDK提供低层几何/部件组合/可微分参数优化/物理验证，NeoMCP以结构化API形式暴露给视觉语言代理进行代码编辑和迭代改进。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: NeoWorld-3是一个编码代理框架，通过可调可执行的程序从视觉观察重建可交互的3D世界，并支持零样本机器人操控。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法重建可交互的物理世界，为机器人操控策略提供仿真环境，并可支持世界模型或动作规划，但其核心贡献是世界重建而非VLA或WAM本身。

figures.caption: Overview of the NeoWorld-3 framework. At the object level, vision-language agents construct tunable geometry programs, revising program structure based on real-sim feedback and optimizing geometric parameters through differentiable refinement, with parts and joints added for articulation. At the scene level, object subagents reconstruct individual assets, while a scene agent coordinates object integration and manages global layout using multi-view observations. Object- and scene-level feedback loops guide reconstruction and revision, producing simulation-ready scenes for sim-based policy optimization and sim-to-real deployment.

papers.title: NeoWorld-3: From Pixels to Code-Defined Physical Worlds

papers.abstract: This paper introduces a novel framework for efficiently evaluating in-game sound designs using multimodal learning and reinforcement learning. Sound design significantly influences gameplay and accessibility; however, objective evaluation methods, defined here as automated assessments based on agent performance rather than human ratings, often require retraining agents from scratch for each sound design. Our approach first pre-trains a multimodal encoder that encodes visual and auditory information into a shared latent space. A reinforcement learning agent is then trained using this latent representation. We fine-tune the multimodal encoder for each sound design while keeping the trained policy fixed, allowing us to isolate the effects of sound changes on agent behavior. To evaluate the proposed method, we conducted experiments on games from multiple genres, comparing the performance of blind agents (agents using only sound input) under various sound designs. Experimental results suggest that this approach can detect differences in agent performance caused by degraded or altered sound design. Moreover, we significantly reduce the computational cost compared to retraining the agent from scratch. Experimental results suggest that this approach provides a practical and scalable solution for evaluating in-game sound designs. The source code, data and supplementary document are available: https://github.com/thainv0212/tog-reusing-agents.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明该方法能检测声音设计降级或改变导致的智能体性能差异，并显著降低计算成本（相比从头训练）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种框架，通过预训练多模态编码器并对其微调，同时保持RL策略固定，从而高效评估声音设计，且无需从头训练智能体。
analysis.method: 预训练多模态编码器将视觉和听觉信息映射到共享潜在空间，训练RL智能体使用该表示；针对每个声音设计微调编码器（保持策略固定），以隔离声音变化对智能体行为的影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一种通过复用RL智能体和微调多模态编码器来高效评估游戏声音设计的方法，避免了为每个声音设计从头训练智能体。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于游戏环境中的多模态智能体效率评估，涉及视觉-语言-音频共享表示和RL策略重用，与机器人VLA/WAM的效率评估或世界建模无直接关联。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but effective manipulation also requires anticipating how the environment will change. Existing world-action models explore future image prediction and latent dynamics modeling. However, generating complete future images can be computationally expensive, while highly compressed latent representations may obscure local changes. To address these challenges, we propose PLaCA, a world-to-action framework built around future latent change. PLaCA directly predicts spatially structured patch-level future latent change from the current multimodal input, preserving local information about expected environmental changes. We introduce patch-level change-aware supervision to emphasize regions undergoing larger changes and a future-to-action interface that explicitly incorporates predicted future latent change into action generation. Experiments on LIBERO-Long show that PLaCA achieves a 79.0% success rate, improving upon the Action-only baseline by 5.0 percentage points. On CALVIN, PLaCA improves the average sequence length from 2.784 to 3.564. These improvements are achieved while updating only 2.95% of the model parameters during the second training stage, demonstrating the effectiveness of future latent change modeling for downstream robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Long上成功率达79.0%，比仅动作基线提高5.0个百分点；在CALVIN上平均序列长度从2.784提升到3.564；仅更新2.95%的模型参数。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PLaCA框架，使用空间结构的块级未来潜在变化预测，并结合块级变化感知监督和未来到动作接口，在仅更新少量参数的情况下提升下游操作性能。
analysis.method: 直接从当前多模态输入预测空间结构的块级未来潜在变化；引入块级变化感知监督关注变化较大区域；设计未来到动作接口将预测的潜在变化显式融合到动作生成中；第二训练阶段仅更新2.95%的模型参数。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PLaCA通过预测当前多模态输入的块级未来潜在变化，并将其显式融入动作生成，以提升机器人的操作成功率与效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与潜在世界建模的交叉，直接利用预测的未来潜在变化辅助动作生成，对机器人的动作预测与世界建模具有直接参考价值。

figures.caption: Motivation for spatially structured future latent change. (a) In robotic manipulation, future changes are often concentrated around the robot arm and manipulated objects, while much of the background remains unchanged. (b) Highly compressed state representations do not explicitly preserve the spatial locations of these changes, whereas patch-level future latent change retains their spatial structure and provides future information for action generation.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of our world-to-action framework. The shared multimodal backbone produces action-query representations, from which a future-change decoder predicts patch-level future latent change. During training, a frozen visual encoder provides change-aware supervision using current and future observations. The predicted future latent change is then incorporated into the action representation through a gated future-to-action interface to generate the full action chunk. Future observations are not required during inference.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: PLaCA: Learning Patch-Level Future Latent Change for Action Generation
papers.title_zh: PLaCA：学习块级未来潜在变化以生成动作

papers.abstract: Deep learning (DL) models are increasingly being deployed into radiation-challenging environments in spacecraft, particle accelerators, and, soon, space-based data centers. Instantiated as a learned orchestration of numbers stored in persistent memory, models are susceptible to continual degradation as high-energy particles corrupt data. At inference time, new data passed through the network fundamentally break the off-line assumptions and guarantees of a static model determined during training. To preserve the quality and efficacy of the models, fault tolerance against bit flips is a clear objective. In this work we developed a runtime method for repairing the quantized weights of neural networks (NNs) after bit flips on commodity, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) hardware, without storing extra replicas. Our work extends the well-established Fault-Aware Training (FAT) paradigm by adding an alignment penalty to concentrate undamaged activations and weights into a low-rank subspace, and we then reconstruct flagged corrupted coordinates from the uncorrupted survivors. We call this method {\it Projection Healing} and apply it to six regression benchmarks on quantized NNs. Holding a FAT checkpoint fixed and toggling only the runtime heal gives a further ${\sim}23\%$ reduction in the native-unit excess integral. Across those datasets the method extends the operational scrub interval by a median of $2.04\times$ at a $+5\%$ RMSE degradation and $1.96\times$ at $+50\%$, compared with $1.62\times$ and $1.07\times$ for classical Single Error Correction, Double Error Detection (SECDED). This introduces a new path towards designing resilient data-driven models, complementing established hardware redundancy, ECC, and FAT-based techniques.

analysis.key_results: 在六个量化神经网络回归基准上，相对于固定 FAT 检查点仅启用运行时修复，进一步减少约 23% 的原生单位超额积分；中位运行清理间隔在 +5% RMSE 退化下延长 2.04 倍，在 +50% 退化下延长 1.96 倍，优于 SECDED 的 1.62 倍和 1.07 倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 扩展容错训练（FAT）范式，通过对齐惩罚将未受损激活和权重集中到低秩子空间，并重构被破坏坐标，称为 Projection Healing。
analysis.method: Projection Healing：在容错训练基础上添加对齐惩罚，利用低秩子空间重建修复被翻转的量化权重。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种在量化神经网络权重发生比特翻转后，无需额外副本即可在运行时修复权重的方法，以提高辐射环境下的容错能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究辐射环境下量化神经网络的容错修复，属于模型量化与高效推理的独立主题，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界建模。

figures.caption: System architecture. (a) Two-pass projection healing on a row. The first DCT-II reconstruction forms the syndrome, the gate sets the blend weights, and a second projection of the surviving coordinates supplies the repaired entries. The weight-alignment term shown is E w ​ _ ​ red = max ⁡ ( 0 , r ¯ w − ρ ) E_{\mathrm{w\_red}}=\max(0,\bar{r}_{\mathrm{w}}-\rho) . (b) Training uses four forwards: a clean pass, a contiguous input-block mask, a contiguous weight-block mask, and a contiguous weight sign flip. The range penalty is analytic on the weight rows, and the loss keeps the projection-healing terms separate from the fault-aware terms. papers.abstract: Visual manuals communicate procedural knowledge through stepwise diagrams, but translating these instructions into reliable long-horizon robotic execution remains challenging. We introduce JARVIS, a method-agnostic benchmark for autonomous visual-manual-guided execution without additional language instructions. JARVIS comprises 236,679 LEGO assembly tasks across 8,987 scenes, with a carefully curated JARVIS-v1 suite of 50 tasks for interactive robotic evaluation. Tasks span varying initial structural complexities and assembly horizons, requiring agents to interpret manuals, ground actions in an evolving workspace, and execute the intended procedure. A structure-aware evaluation protocol captures geometric accuracy, structural relations, construction order, partial progress, and completion. We further introduce JARVIS-agentic, a tool-grounded embodied agent that composes robot primitives into executable programs and uses execution feedback for verification and recovery, without task-specific action trajectories or model parameter updates. Across nine multimodal and reasoning models, task-oriented primitives increase the average assembly score. Performance nevertheless declines sharply with assembly horizon, and execution errors remain difficult to correct. Prior-task experience improves initial performance, while repeated reflection provides inconsistent benefits, highlighting persistent limitations in connecting visual procedural reasoning with reliable physical execution.

analysis.key_results: 在九个多模态与推理模型上，任务导向原语提高了平均装配分数；但装配分数随装配步长急剧下降，执行错误难以纠正。
analysis.limitations: 装配分数随装配步长急剧下降，执行错误难以纠正；重复反思带来的益处不一致。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了JARVIS基准，包含236,679个乐高装配任务，以及一个基于执行反馈进行验证与恢复的具身智能体JARVIS-agentic。
analysis.method: 构建大规模视觉手册装配基准，并采用工具接地的具身智能体，将机器人原语组合成可执行程序，利用执行反馈进行验证与恢复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: JARVIS是一个评估视觉手册引导的长程机器人装配的基准，并提出了一个基于工具与执行反馈的具身智能体。

papers.abstract: Foundation models now serve as reasoning layers for robot teams, but it remains unclear whether embodiment-specialized vision-language models (VLMs) preserve the social-reasoning capabilities of general-purpose VLMs. We evaluate Gemini Robotics-ER on SHREC, a benchmark of real human-robot social interactions, and compare it with published general-purpose VLM baselines. Robotics-ER outperforms GPT-4o-mini on error/competence detection but performs worse on detailed social-attribute judgments; adding a visual frame helps one task while hurting the other. These results suggest embodiment-specialized models may perform differently on social judgments that can be read more directly from observable interaction cues versus those requiring more inference about a person's internal state. Because the comparison spans model families, these differences cannot be attributed to embodiment specialization alone. This matters for multi-robot systems, where a shared foundation model could cause systematic social-perception errors to influence multiple coordination decisions. This work presents an initial evaluation, with broader cross-context and video-based analyses left for future work.

analysis.key_results: Robotics-ER在错误/能力检测上优于GPT-4o-mini，但在详细社会属性判断上表现较差；添加视觉帧对一个任务有帮助，对另一个任务有害。
analysis.limitations: 比较跨越不同模型家族，因此差异不能仅归因于具身专业化；该工作仅是初步评估，更广泛的跨情境和基于视频的分析留待未来。
analysis.main_contribution: 评估了Gemini Robotics-ER在SHREC基准上的社会推理表现，并与通用VLM基线进行对比，揭示了具身专用模型在不同社会判断任务上的差异。
analysis.method: 在SHREC基准上评估Gemini Robotics-ER，并与已发表的通用VLM基线进行比较。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文评估了具身专用的视觉语言模型在人机社交互动中的社会推理能力，并与通用基线进行对比。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接评估了具身视觉语言模型（VLA）在社会推理任务上的表现，对本站在具身智能体社会认知方面的研究具有相关性。

papers.title: Evaluating Social Reasoning in Embodied Vision-Language Models

papers.abstract: A failed gaming trajectory reveals that an agent needs intervention, but not necessarily how its execution harness should change. Effective harness adaptation therefore requires gathering diagnostic evidence, rather than merely proposing alternative recovery rules. We present KPHarness, a framework that adapts the external execution harness of a frozen vision-language-action model through knowledge-probing co-evolution. Recovery knowledge supplies context-specific intervention hypotheses that guide active probing; probe outcomes reveal when these hypotheses apply and provide evidence for refining both recovery knowledge and later probe selection. This reciprocal process allows the harness to improve not only which interventions it applies, but also how it investigates failures. KPHarness separates fast policy execution from a slow research loop that translates accumulated knowledge and probing evidence into bounded harness revisions. Each revision is compared with the incumbent under matched sandbox conditions and accepted only when the paired evaluation shows improvement. Recoveries supported by further validation are retained for cross-task reuse, while immediate interaction feedback and delayed episode-success credit update action- and knowledge-probing policies during adaptation. Experiments on Minecraft tasks spanning mining, combat, and crafting show improved task coverage over bare policy execution, a manually specified fixed harness, and knowledge-only harness evolution with non-adaptive probing. Evaluation on previously unseen tasks further shows improved task completion with the evolved harness, knowledge bank, and probing policies held fixed,

analysis.key_results: 在Minecraft的采矿、战斗和制作任务中，相比裸策略执行、手动固定框架和仅知识演化的非自适应探测框架，KPHarness实现了更高的任务覆盖率；在未见过的任务上，使用固定演化框架、知识库和探测策略也提高了任务完成度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了KPHarness框架，通过知识探测协同演化来自适应地调整冻结的VLA模型的外部执行框架，以提高长时程任务的任务覆盖率和完成度。
analysis.method: 将快速策略执行与慢速研究循环分离，通过知识支持的干预假设引导主动探测，利用探测结果精化恢复知识和探测策略，并以有界框架修订和配对沙箱评估来优化执行框架。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: KPHarness框架通过知识探测协同演化，自适应调整冻结的视觉-语言-行动模型的外部执行框架，以提升长时程游戏任务的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接作用于冻结的VLA模型的外部执行框架，关注长时程任务的适应与效率提升，尽管针对游戏领域，但方法论对于机器人VLA模型的错误恢复与高效推理具有借鉴价值。

Auto-K proposes and validates harness modifications using accumulated knowledge, while KPHarness additionally uses probing evidence and interaction feedback to adapt probe and knowledge selection. In the illustrated sand-mining example, Bare and Auto-K fail, whereas KPHarness recovers and completes the task.

figures.caption: Automatic harness evolution through knowledge–probing co-evolution. Action probes collect evidence about ambiguous failures, while knowledge probes test which recovery strategies apply. Probe evidence and accumulated knowledge guide harness proposals, which are compared with the incumbent through paired sandbox validation. Interaction outcomes improve both probing policies, and validated recoveries become transferable knowledge, while the VLA remains frozen.

papers.abstract: Learned post-training quantization (PTQ) calibration fits quantizer parameters on a small calibration set, and for a text embedder the natural supervision is retrieval relevance. We ask two questions that are usually conflated: how far to calibrate, and whether to calibrate at all. Across three embedders (e5-base-v2, BGE-M3, EmbeddingGemma-300m) at 4-bit weight quantization, 161 calibration runs, the outcome of a fixed procedure ranges from a gain to catastrophic degradation, and the driver is the dose of the update, measured as the functional displacement D_func of the quantized model from its uncalibrated start. On EmbeddingGemma the same learning-rate grid gives +1.47 to -71.53 points of in-domain NDCG@10 change; a label-free cosine objective collapses at the same dose (-69.52 vs -71.63), so the collapse is a property of learnable calibration rather than of retrieval supervision. Objective sensitivity is heterogeneous: on e5, ranking calibration is substantially more robust than cosine at matched displacement (+14.16 +/- 4.34 pp, 95% t-CI [+3.37, +24.96], three paired slates), whereas on BGE-M3 the ordering is directionally opposite but unresolved ([-5.18, +2.38]). Dose is the main axis but not a sufficient statistic: equal D_func reached along different paths differs by up to 1.61 pp. We therefore treat calibration as an optional intervention. A pre-registered rule that accepts a checkpoint only when a per-query paired confidence interval on a 25% calibration-validation split clears the uncalibrated baseline was run on 6 independent slates and five arms. It never selected a checkpoint below its slate's baseline (0 harmful selections in 30 decisions), retained 8 of 11 beneficial updates, and paid a mean oracle regret of 1.52 pp with one abstention that forfeited 11.13 pp, a safety-opportunity trade-off, not a free improvement. We report what remains open, including label efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 在EmbeddingGemma上，同一学习率网格导致域内NDCG@10变化从+1.47到-71.53；无标签余弦目标在相同剂量下崩溃（-69.52 vs -71.63），表明崩溃是学习式校准的本质属性；在e5上排序校准比余弦稳健性高（+14.16 ± 4.34个百分点），而在BGE-M3上方向相反但不显著；预注册规则在30次决策中零有害选择，保留了11个有益更新中的8个，平均oracle遗憾为1.52个百分点。
analysis.limitations: 报告了标签效率等方面仍待解决的问题；剂量不是充分统计量，不同路径达到相同D_func时性能差异可达1.61个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别出PTQ校准的剂量（以功能位移D_func度量）是导致性能从增益到灾难性退化的主要因素，并提出一种通过验证集置信区间选择校准检查点的干预规则。
analysis.method: 在三个文本嵌入器上进行4比特权重量化，使用学习式校准，并引入功能位移D_func来度量校准剂量；提出基于25%校准-验证分割的逐查询配对置信区间的接受规则。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究学习式训练后量化校准对文本嵌入器检索质量的影响，揭示校准剂量驱动性能崩溃，并提出基于验证的门控弃权规则。

papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video generative models trained on successful, goal-directed demonstrations tend to ignore the commanded action, rendering a plausible expert-like future regardless of what is asked of them. We trace this failure to training data that lack sufficient action influence. We analyze this metric and prove that it upper bounds the action influence that any model trained on that data can express. Expert demonstrations, whose narrow action distributions let next states be predicted without attending to the action, set a low ceiling that no amount of model capacity alone can raise. Raising it requires collecting different data. We introduce Action Influence Maximization (AIM), an algorithm for actively collecting training data for improving dataset action influence. We compare the performance and data-efficiency of AIM against exploration heuristics and intrinsic-motivation methods on simulated navigation and manipulation tasks. In pixel-based manipulation, AIM is the only method that consistently improves controllability: 500 actively collected episodes added to 3k demonstrations match a world model trained on 300k expert episodes on end-effector controllability, an $85\times$ reduction in data.

analysis.key_results: 在基于像素的操纵任务中，AIM是唯一持续提升可控性的方法：500个主动收集的片段添加到3k专家演示后，在末端执行器可控性上匹配了用300k专家片段训练的世界模型，数据量减少85倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 定义并分析了动作影响指标，证明训练数据上限定理，并提出Action Influence Maximization (AIM)算法主动收集训练数据以提高数据集动作影响。
analysis.method: AIM主动数据收集算法，在模拟导航和操作任务中与探索启发式及内在动机方法进行比较。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文针对动作条件视频生成模型忽略动作指令的问题，提出一种主动收集数据以最大化动作影响的方法，从而提升世界模型的可控性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接针对世界模型（WAM）的动作可控性问题，提出数据收集策略以提升模型对动作指令的响应能力，与本站WAM主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using a curriculum that gradually transitions from partial to fully masked inputs, we successfully transfer the multi-step refinement capabilities into one step. Across reasoning, math, code benchmarks on three model families DStill improves acceptance length by up to 28% and speedup by up to 25% over one-step DFlash, achieving up to 6.45x speedup over auto-regressive decoding.

analysis.key_results: 在三个模型家族上，DStill相较一步DFlash将接受长度提升最高28%，加速比提升最高25%，相比自回归解码达到最高6.45倍加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DStill两阶段蒸馏框架，将块扩散草稿模型的多步细化能力蒸馏为一步草案生成，在保持低推理延迟的同时提高接受长度和加速比。
analysis.method: 两阶段蒸馏：先训练草稿模型完成部分可见块，然后利用其细化轨迹训练学生模型一步预测最终完成，并使用从部分掩盖逐步过渡到完全掩盖的课程学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DStill提出一个两阶段框架，通过将草稿模型的多步细化能力蒸馏为一步预测，在块扩散推测解码中提高接受长度和加速比。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于语言模型的块扩散推测解码效率优化，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略。其蒸馏和一步草案生成技术可潜在迁移到机器人模型的推测解码加速，但摘要未提及此类应用。

papers.abstract: Neural image codecs face a fundamental trade-off between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality. Distortion-optimized codecs preserve pixel-wise fidelity but produce blurred reconstructions at low bitrates, whereas generative codecs leverage learned priors to improve perceptual quality but tend to exhibit saturating PSNR at higher bitrates and require separate models for different bitrate targets. We propose PerQ, which reframes perceptual reconstruction as inverse generative modeling with bounded support. Specifically, we define the quantization cell as the set of latents that yield the same transmitted symbols and derive a transport bound showing that reconstructions from this cell remain within a rate-determined radius of the codec output. This motivates performing generative reconstruction within the codec-induced quantization cell, rather than sampling from an unconstrained image prior. PerQ implements this principle by attaching a rate-conditioned flow-matching compensator to a frozen, multi-rate distortion-optimized backbone, enabling perceptual enhancement while preserving the backbone's coding performance. Experiments on Kodak and CLIC2020 show that PerQ achieves perceptual performance comparable to generative codecs such as MS-ILLM in LPIPS and FID, while maintaining competitive PSNR relative to distortion-optimized codecs such as ELIC. A single model checkpoint supports a wide bitrate range with fast decoding, and the compensator provides consistent gains across three different backbones. The implementation is available at https://jasminepp.github.io/PerQ/.

analysis.key_results: 在Kodak和CLIC2020上，PerQ在LPIPS和FID上达到与生成式编解码器（如MS-ILLM）相当的感知性能，同时保持与失真优化编解码器（如ELIC）相当的PSNR；单一模型支持宽比特率范围且解码快速，补偿器在三种不同骨干网络上均带来一致增益。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PerQ框架，将有界支撑的逆生成建模用于神经图像压缩中的量化误差补偿，实现感知增强同时保持骨干网络的编码性能。
analysis.method: 将感知重构视为在量化单元内进行逆生成建模，使用率条件流匹配补偿器附加到冻结的多率失真优化骨干网络上。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PerQ通过在有界支撑内进行逆生成建模（量化单元内补偿）来在神经图像压缩中同时改善感知质量与像素保真度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于神经图像压缩与模型量化领域，与机器人VLA/WAM无直接关系。其量化误差补偿方法在高效模型推理上有参考价值，但未涉及机器人行动预测或世界建模。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are sensitive to visual corruptions, but knowing that a corruption is typically harmful does not establish whether removing it would benefit the current episode. Furthermore, when several corruptions co-occur, deciding what to correct requires understanding which ones contribute to failure risk and how much their removal would help. We define this problem as failure attribution. Detecting corruption presence alone cannot answer this question, as corruptions can be present but relatively harmless, while directly measuring removal benefits requires costly paired policy rollouts with and without the corruption present. To address this, we introduce a factorized risk model that learns separate representations of the scene and corruptions, allowing us to estimate removal benefits through latent intervention from the current image and task instruction, without paired clean images or additional counterfactual rollouts. We evaluate our approach on OpenVLA and $\pi_{0.5}$ in simulation and $\pi_{0.5}$-DROID on a Franka robot. Our method outperforms monolithic and vision-language-model (VLM) baselines, including achieving approximately 3x lower attribution error than frontier VLMs. We also demonstrate our method adapts to execution context and corruption intensity, and can be used for online failure monitoring on hardware.

analysis.key_results: 在OpenVLA和π0.5模拟环境及π0.5-DROID Franka机器人上，方法优于单一模型和VLM基线，归因误差比前沿VLM低约3倍，并能适应执行上下文和损坏强度，用于硬件在线失败监测。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出失败归因问题及分解风险模型，通过场景与损坏的分离表示，从当前图像和任务指令估计移除损坏的益处，无需成对干净图像或反事实 rollout。
analysis.method: 因子化风险模型，学习场景和损坏的分离表示，通过潜在干预估计移除益处。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的视觉损坏提出了失败归因问题，并引入分解风险模型来估计损坏移除的益处。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究VLA模型在视觉损坏下的失败归因，属于VLA鲁棒性与评估，对机器人动作预测和操作有明确价值，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $\Psi_0$, $\omega$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

analysis.key_results: 在五个跨实体基准（DreamDojo、Ψ0、ω-HOME、Xp-Teleop、AgiBot）上取得最先进性能，并展示了零样本、少样本及全数据后训练效果；蒸馏后支持实时分钟级推演。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个以自我为中心的运动-操纵世界基础模型Ropedia W0，能够跨人类和机器人实体进行动作后果预测，并发布统一的多模态数据集Xp-Data和基准Xp-Teleop。
analysis.method: 构建包含10k小时人类自我中心数据和3k小时机器人数据的Xp-Data数据集，采用统一运动学表示（相机姿态编码运动、投影骨架编码操纵），并通过蒸馏实现实时长期推演。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个以自我为中心的运动-操纵世界基础模型Ropedia W0，利用人类和机器人数据实现跨实体预测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于世界动作模型（WAM），明确联合建模运动与操纵，提出跨实体世界基础模型，并强调在世界动作建模中的应用，属于WAM核心研究。

figures.caption: Xp-Data curation pipeline. Heterogeneous human and robot recordings pass through five stages. (1) Data sources : 14 public human egocentric datasets, 6,000 h of in-house four-camera recordings, and 13 public robot datasets. (2) Video filtering removes low-quality or task-irrelevant clips with a vision-language model. (3) Multimodal annotation produces geometry (metric camera poses via SLAM and DA3 [ 69 ] ), kinematics (human hands via WiLoR [ 91 ] and MANO [ 96 ] , robot keypoints via URDF forward kinematics, manual annotation, and correction), and semantics (hierarchical task, subtask, and atomic-action captions). (4) Quality check verifies completeness, correctness, and cross-modal consistency, pairing automated checks with a caption cascade (Gemini [ 25 ] annotation, Qwen [ 6 ] verification, and human review). (5) Training-clip construction cuts quality-verified subtasks into standardized 81-frame, 640 × 480 640\times 480 , 16 fps multimodal clips, yielding the unified cross-embodiment corpus.

papers.abstract: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在视觉触觉UniVTAC上达到90.3%成功率，在基于视觉的LIBERO-Long上达到99.6%成功率，并在使用双手夹爪和灵巧手的真实世界任务中优于现有方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入物理词概念，将原子动作词作为连续物理动态表示的结构化锚点，构建PhysWord基础模型，实现结构化潜在推理并用于动作生成。
analysis.method: 预测未来的原子动作词，并将其上下文的隐藏状态与从对应未来观测中推导的潜在目标对齐，构建包含视觉和可选触觉变体的时间结构化PhysWord空间。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PhysWord，一个基于物理词的推理-后-行动基础模型，通过原子动作动词作为语义锚点来结构化连续物理动态的潜在推理，用于机器人操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于VLA范畴，侧重于机器人操作中的视觉-语言-动作模型；通过结构化潜在推理（物理词）为动作生成提供多模态上下文，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

(a) PhysWord connects temporal perception and reasoning-and-action branches through shared attention in a MoT architecture, generating Physical Words autoregressively before denoising actions. (b) The hidden states of visual and tactile Physical Word variants receive joint action-label cross-entropy supervision and cosine alignment with future sensory latent targets. papers.abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

analysis.key_results: 五轴指标能区分公共基准平均分相近的系统；高总得分不一定伴随早期或高效增益；移除历史会降低后期成功率；冻结工作空间在未见布局上仍然有用；三个跨任务案例更早达到成功；观察到场景特定适应与可复用经验可以共存。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PhysRSI-eval五轴评估指标（首次尝试表现、效率、成功率、预算、失败改进），系统量化了视觉语言模型在18个操作任务中的物理递归自我改进能力，并提出物理桶假说（不同能力可能限制不同方面的改进）。
analysis.method: 在固定交互预算下，对多个视觉语言模型进行18个操作任务实验，利用五轴指标量化物理RSI；通过两个角度的观测性缩放研究（从公共能力预测相对性能、从早期物理反馈预测后期进展）以及工作空间干预实验分析改进机制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究系统考察了视觉语言模型在物理递归自我改进中的机制、缩放行为与泛化能力，提出PhysRSI-eval评估框架和物理桶假说。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究以视觉语言模型作为机器人操作策略（LLM-as-policy），深入分析其在真实操作任务中通过失败反馈进行递归自我改进的能力，直接属于VLA与机器人操作策略学习范畴，对理解VLA的适应性、泛化性和改进动力学具有重要价值。

papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal models have enabled GPT-6 Astra to perform robotic manipulation through in-context learning. Yet contact-rich control and tactile perception are often regarded as strengths of specialist policies, leaving open whether Astra can directly understand and use tactile observations. We provide, to our knowledge, the first demonstration that Astra directly interprets vision-based tactile images and uses their contact cues for manipulation. Tactile RGB images enter through its existing visual interface, enabling few-shot closed-loop control on nineteen simulated UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks with 210 sampled scene seeds per setting. With visuo-tactile input, Astra achieves mean success rates of 93.8% and 81.8%, exceeding the strongest reported specialist baselines in our comparison by 22.9 and 13.1 percentage points, respectively. Vision-only performance also leads these baselines, reaching 76.3% and 80.6%. Trajectory analysis reveals active probing, cautious grasping, contact-guided alignment, and recovery, alongside difficulties with tangential loading and corrective execution. Our findings challenge the exclusivity of specialist policies in contact-rich manipulation and show that fine-grained vision can partially compensate for missing touch. They also identify vision-based tactile sensing as an interface for scaling contact understanding with foundation models and reveal signs of benchmark saturation. These results motivate joint visual-tactile pretraining, harder contact-rich evaluations, and physical-robot validation.

analysis.key_results: 在视觉-触觉输入下，平均成功率分别为 93.8% 和 81.8%，比最强专用基线分别高出 22.9 和 13.1 个百分点；仅视觉输入也达到 76.3% 和 80.6%，同样领先基线。
analysis.limitations: 论文指出模型在切向载荷和纠正执行方面存在困难，并提到基准饱和现象，但摘要未明确说明具体局限。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次证明 GPT-6 Astra 作为通用多模态模型，能直接利用视觉触觉观测进行少样本闭环控制，并在接触丰富操作任务上超越最强的专用策略基线。

papers.abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

analysis.key_results: 在Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman和PushT四个环境中，Agima在训练未见过的更困难设置下表现出泛化性；仅用SFT训练的双箱Sokoban模型在四箱问题上解决率达40%，而仅动作规划器只有2%；RL后出现新行为，如仅在必要时前瞻、在关键决策点更多分支等。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Agima训练框架，训练单一全能模型在行动前想象并推理行动后果，从而在稀疏反馈或不可逆动作环境中做出更优决策。
analysis.method: 结合监督微调统一策略与世界模型，再通过智能体强化学习训练模型利用想象进行规划。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Agima框架，通过监督微调和智能体强化学习训练单一全能模型，在行动前生成并推理未来图像，以提升规划能力。

papers.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

analysis.key_results: 当前世界模型在目标转移下的重新组合中普遍出现性能失败，在动态和表示层面存在泛化差距。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AnyGoal 基准及开源库，通过目标转移任务变体研究世界模型的组合泛化能力，并指出当前模型在训练分布外重组时存在系统性能失败。
analysis.method: 构建目标转移任务变体，保持状态因子和动作在训练支撑内但组合在专家轨迹中欠表示，并在多个环境和世界模型家族上进行评估分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过组合泛化视角，研究世界模型在训练分布之外的动态预测与规划性能，并引入基准 AnyGoal 及开源库。

papers.abstract: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.

analysis.key_results: 在50对反事实孪生对的WorldState-Bench上，仅规则提示时最佳视频后端在两种情况下产生规定结局的比例为32%；MiniMax-H3指定结局后从32%提升到64%，完整harness达到92%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Stateful Harness框架和WorldState-Bench基准，证明将规则执行与视频渲染分离可显著提升隐藏状态下的规则遵循能力。
analysis.method: 分离世界演化与视频渲染：维护演化世界状态，用冻结视频模型渲染事件，再用生成片段更新世界状态；每轮解析用户动作并生成指令，用可编辑3D场景提供空间和相机引导。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Stateful Harness框架，将世界状态演化与视频渲染分离，使动作遵循依赖不可见隐藏状态的规则。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦世界模型（World Model），处理动作条件视频生成中隐藏状态下的规则遵循问题，对世界建模和视频生成有直接贡献，但未涉及机器人动作预测、操作或VLA。

papers.abstract: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).

analysis.key_results: 摘要未说明具体实验结果，主要贡献为概念框架与技术分类。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未明确说明局限，但指出实现物理AGI仍需应对从窄域自动化到通用化泛化的技术挑战。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了物理人工智能的统一框架，并构建了涵盖感知、建模、行动、学习与推理的技术体系。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本专著系统定义物理人工智能，梳理其技术图谱，并探讨其核心挑战与研究方向。

papers.abstract: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.

analysis.key_results: 在ARCTIC、HOT3D和EgoStandard数据集上，单个模型在覆盖感知平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）方面达到可比基线中最低；世界坐标系轨迹误差低于对比的SLAM基线；单张RTX A6000上前向传递吞吐量达93.4 FPS。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出V-JEPA Hand，一个简单的前馈视频模型，通过自监督V-JEPA 2.1编码器和基于查询的预测器，联合恢复双手运动与相机运动，并利用预测的相机运动将手部轨迹表达在统一的世界坐标系中。
analysis.method: 使用自监督V-JEPA 2.1编码器提取时空特征，基于查询的预测器解码出逐帧手部姿态、手部存在性与相机运动；模型端到端单阶段训练，混合使用伪标签视频和高精度3D标注；单次前向传递完成重建。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出V-JEPA Hand，一个自监督视频模型，联合重建第一视角视频中的双手运动与相机运动，以获取世界坐标系下的3D手部轨迹。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作虽未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但从第一视角视频中恢复世界坐标系下的手部运动与相机轨迹，属于机器人学习与具身智能中的世界建模和感知基础，可为机器人操作学习提供关键的状态估计与轨迹数据，与本站主题有一定相关性。

papers.abstract: General-purpose multimodal models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, demonstrate broad capabilities in embodied manipulation. Our analysis indicates that this generality is accompanied by strong spatial perception, as Astra can determine where to interact with task-relevant entities amid visual distractors. Because spatial perception connects high-level reasoning to the physical scene, we investigate scaling visual grounding to strengthen the perceptual foundation of general embodied operation. We develop a unified data pipeline that combines robot manipulation recordings with complementary visual data from diverse sources. After automatically annotating the robot recordings, the pipeline converts the collected data into verifiable grounding supervision. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on approximately 1.5 million samples produced by this pipeline yields ACE-Brain-0.6. The model outperforms GPT-6 Astra on four of seven public grounding benchmarks, with an overall average score of 75.41 compared with Astra's 73.68. Under a fixed Qwen3.5-9B fine-tuning setup, aggregate grounding performance improves steadily as successive data releases expand the training collection to cover a broader range of grounding scenarios. These results show that scaling verifiable grounding supervision from diverse sources can strengthen the spatial perception of an open 9B model for general embodied operation.

analysis.key_results: 在7个公开接地基准中4项超过GPT-6 Astra，总体平均得分75.41 vs 73.68；接地性能随训练数据扩展而稳定提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发统一数据管线，结合机器人操作记录和多样视觉数据，自动标注并转换为可验证的接地监督数据，微调Qwen3.5-9B得到ACE-Brain-0.6，在7个公开接地基准中4项超越GPT-6 Astra。
analysis.method: 构建数据管线自动标注机器人操作记录，融入多种视觉数据生成约150万接地监督样本，微调Qwen3.5-9B模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过扩展可验证的空间接地监督，加强了9B开源模型在通用具身操作中的空间感知能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对通用具身操作（embodied manipulation）的基础模型能力，通过大规模接地数据增强空间感知，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的基础能力强化，与机器人操作和通用机器人学习高度相关。

papers.abstract: General-purpose manipulation requires reliable behavior across embodiments, objects, and task demands. We introduce HandsOn, a composable simulation platform and benchmark for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. It supports five robotic arms, six dexterous hands, and approximately 200 rigid, articulated, and deformable assets in randomized scenes. The benchmark pairs 18,000 curated human demonstrations with 66 human-verified tasks: Core-50 supports demonstration-based learning and execution tests, while Transfer-16 evaluates asset and relation transfer, skill composition, and deformable manipulation without target-task training demonstrations. Qualitative real-robot rollouts illustrate sim-to-real transfer. Across diffusion, vision-language-action, world-action, and prompted VLM-based methods, the best trained multi-task policy achieves 29.1% Core-50 success. Without benchmark finetuning, GPT-6 using move_eef for palm-and-finger control achieves 5.2% on Core-50 and 1.9% on Transfer-16 over 660 trials. Trained-policy stage diagnostics expose failures in contact establishment, action coordination, and maintaining achieved goals, with additional sequencing errors in composed tasks. HandsOn provides a shared basis for investigating manipulation generalization and the limits of reliable physical interaction.

analysis.key_results: 最佳多任务策略在 Core-50 上成功率为 29.1%；未经基准微调的 GPT-6 使用 move_eef 控制在 Core-50 上为 5.2%，Transfer-16 上为 1.9%（共 660 次试验）；训练策略在接触建立、动作协调和维持目标等方面存在失败。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未明确说明局限，但诊断出的失败模式（接触建立、动作协调等）暗示当前方法的可靠物理交互能力有限。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了 HandsOn 仿真基准，覆盖五种机械臂、六种灵巧手和约 200 个刚体/关节体/可变形资产，并提供 18,000 条人类演示与 66 个人类验证任务（Core-50 和 Transfer-16）。
analysis.method: 通过随机化场景、任务配置和演示数据构建仿真平台；评估扩散、VLA、世界-行动和提示式 VLM 等多种方法，并利用训练策略的阶段诊断分析失败模式。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 HandsOn，一个支持跨具身灵巧操作的大规模仿真平台与基准，包含多样化资产、人类演示和任务，用于评估泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接评估包含 VLA（vision-language-action）和 world-action 策略在内的多类方法，并强调跨具身、跨任务的灵巧操作泛化；为 VLA、世界模型与机器人操作策略提供了统一的评测环境，但本身并非专门针对 VLA 或 WAM 的方法创新。

papers.abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) has achieved promising rate-distortion performance, but most methods lack scalability for diverse platforms with varying computational and storage constraints. Existing slimmable LIC methods achieve flexible complexity via consecutive-channel activation but suffer from two limitations: forced consecutive-channel selection degrades narrow-model performance at low bitrates, and the lack of stable variable-rate control limits adaptability to varying bandwidth. We propose a channel-level mask-guided slimmable image compression method. A learnable channel-wise mask with sparsity-promoting regularization enables non-contiguous top-w channel selection, letting narrow models use the most informative channels. After training, mask merging and channel reordering convert the model into a standard slimmable network via Mask-to-Slimmable (M2S) conversion, enabling efficient inference without architectural changes. For variable-rate control, we combine lambda- and width-conditioned modulation with quantization-step scaling and a progressive training pipeline stabilized by a freeze-then-fine-tune strategy. Experiments on Kodak across E2E, Hyperprior, and Checkerboard backbones show superior rate-distortion performance across widths and bitrates, with large gains for narrow models at low bitrates. At w=48, it achieves up to 19.22%, 24.11%, and 22.76% BD-rate savings over the same-width Slimmable baseline on E2E, Hyperprior, and CKBD, respectively. A single VBR model replaces 40 independent models, reducing storage by 14.8x to 15.9x. Code: https://github.com/sjtu-tcloud/MGSIC.

analysis.key_results: 在Kodak数据集上，三种骨干网络（E2E、Hyperprior、CKBD）的窄模型在低码率下率失真性能显著提升，w=48时BD-rate节省最高达24.11%；单一VBR模型可替代40个独立模型，存储降低14.8至15.9倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出通道级掩码引导的可伸缩图像压缩方法，通过可学习通道掩码和Mask-to-Slimmable转换实现非连续通道选择，并结合宽度和lambda条件调制实现稳定可变码率控制。
analysis.method: 使用稀疏正则化的可学习通道掩码选择非连续顶层通道，经掩码合并和通道重排序转换为标准可伸缩网络；可变码率控制通过lambda-和宽度条件调制、量化步长缩放及渐进式训练实现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种通道级掩码引导的可伸缩图像压缩方法，通过非连续通道选择和可变码率控制提升窄模型在低码率下的率失真性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文主题为图像压缩中的模型量化（可伸缩网络）和高效推理，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）无直接关系，但其通道剪枝和可变码率技术可能对机器人策略模型的压缩和部署具有借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.

analysis.key_results: 在自主赛车高保真仿真中，PIA 在不同赛道和表面变化下适应更快，圈速更低且失败更少；在真实全尺寸赛车上，PIA 在不到一小时的车载交互内实现可靠的少样本适应。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PIA 框架，通过结构化仿真先验实现快速适应，无需精确仿真器即可在真实系统上少样本学习高性能控制策略。
analysis.method: 使用异构低保真和高保真仿真轨迹预训练世界模型，然后通过不确定性正则化规划在目标域有限交互中适应，将仿真轨迹视为有偏先验并在线修正残差失配。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA)，一种离线到在线模型基强化学习框架，利用异构仿真轨迹预训练世界模型并通过不确定性正则规划适应目标域。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于模型基强化学习和世界模型在自主赛车中的应用，与 VLA 或 WAM 主题无直接关系，但其世界模型预训练与适应方法可能对机器人世界建模有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $\pi_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $\pi_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.

analysis.key_results: $\pi_{0.5}$在分布内、视角/空间偏移和分布外条件下均比Octo获得更高任务性能得分，且退化更小；本体感知信息对策略性能有影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个结合MuJoCo仿真环境、遥操作演示收集和预训练通用策略（Octo和$\pi_{0.5}$）适应的仿真到现实框架，用于农业抓取任务。
analysis.method: 利用MuJoCo构建多样番茄植株仿真环境，通过操纵杆遥操作收集专家演示，使用低层控制器执行动作，并用仿真和真实机器人演示对预训练VLA策略进行微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一个仿真到现实的机器人学习框架，通过任务特定演示收集和预训练策略适应来实现农业场景中的抓取操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心涉及预训练VLA策略在农业机器人操作任务中的适应，属于VLA在真实机器人操作中的应用研究，与本站点VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

analysis.key_results: 在Snapdragon 8 Elite上，与llama.cpp最快的NPU配置相比，Tandem将基于文本的屏幕描述的每步延迟降低30%，截图场景降低16%，文本步骤能耗降低33%，并将在模型加载时的待机功耗从0.76W降低到0.22W。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Tandem运行时，用于在移动NPU上高效服务混合线性注意力GUI代理，通过及时的循环状态保存、矩阵单元上的预填充和逐令牌回滚状态生成来降低每步延迟和能耗。
analysis.method: Tandem保存连续提示分歧处的循环状态以重用已处理的上下文；将大部分预填充保持在矩阵单元上，并通过短的逐令牌尾部生成回滚状态；验证内核为所有提议的令牌只读取一次权重块；在请求突发之间释放NPU功率投票而不卸载模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Tandem是一个针对混合线性注意力GUI代理的移动NPU运行时，通过重用循环状态和优化自适应解码来降低延迟和能耗。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于移动NPU上的高效GUI代理推理，属于投机解码和高效推理范畴，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作世界建模。

figures.caption: Workload-driven serving challenges for mobile GUI agents. Each step observes the screen and generates an action. (a) Consecutive prompts share a prefix but diverge in recent history or screen content, making chat-oriented checkpoints poorly placed. (b) Short outputs provide few opportunities to amortize the prefill overhead of speculative rollback states. Tandem retains matrix-based prefill and uses a short recurrent tail. (c) Between tasks, active NPU power requests can waste energy even when the model remains idle. Tandem releases these requests without unloading the model.

papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet adapting generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging. Unlike fixed-base or wheeled manipulators, humanoids must coordinate locomotion, posture, gaze, and dual-arm manipulation over a high-dimensional whole-body action space, where inaccurate base or waist motions can easily induce unstable and aggressive upper-body compensation. We propose HAF-VLA, a hierarchical action-flow framework for humanoid VLA control. Built upon a pretrained flow-matching VLA, HAF-VLA inherits the vision-language prefix encoder and action expert weights, and adapts them to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation with learnable stage embeddings and cross-stage KV-cache conditioning. Instead of generating the full action chunk in a single pass, HAF-VLA progressively denoises a shared whole-body action space: first locomotion and head commands, then waist refinement, and finally full-body manipulation. To preserve structural dependencies across stages, we introduce a cross-stage KV cache conditioning mechanism, enabling subsequent action generation stages to refine and augment their outputs based on the action representations from preceding stages. Experimental results across six real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the performance of existing models in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrating an effective pathway for adapting strong mobile-manipulation VLAs to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在六项真实世界任务上，显著提升了现有人形机器人移动操作模型的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HAF-VLA，一种分层动作流框架，用于将通用VLA策略适配到人形机器人移动操作，包括可学习阶段嵌入和跨阶段KV缓存条件化机制，以在共享全身动作空间中分阶段生成动作。
analysis.method: 基于预训练流匹配VLA，继承视觉语言前缀编码器和动作专家权重；采用层级式阶段去噪（先移动与头部命令，再腰部细化，最后全身操作），并引入跨阶段KV缓存条件化以保持阶段间结构依赖性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出HAF-VLA框架，将预训练流匹配VLA适配到人形机器人全身移动操作，通过分阶段动作去噪和跨阶段KV缓存条件化解决高维全身动作生成中的稳定性与协调问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA高度相关：论文直接针对人形机器人的视觉-语言-动作策略适配，涉及全身动作空间的分层生成与控制，属于机器人动作预测与策略学习的核心主题。

papers.abstract: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.

analysis.key_results: 在采样温度T=0时，在Gemma 4-12B上平均接受长度提升19.4%，解码速度提升17.9%（八个基准）；在四个目标模型和八个基准上平均接受长度提升15.2%，解码速度提升13.4%（使用预训练DFlash草稿器）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出无训练的ReAnchor方法，通过重用验证器在前一个草稿块中被拒绝位置后的隐藏状态，将预训练扩散草稿器重新锚定在移位位置，并行生成多个草稿块，从而改进预测并延长草稿范围。
analysis.method: 在扩散草稿器的基础上，利用被丢弃的验证器隐藏状态作为锚点，将草稿器重新锚定在移位位置；并行生成额外草稿块，扩展原始块内预测和块外覆盖；无需训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出无训练的ReAnchor方法，通过重用被丢弃的验证器隐藏状态将预训练扩散草稿器重新锚定在不同位置，并行生成草稿块以提升接受长度和解码速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究独立的推测解码效率优化，与VLA/WAM或机器人世界模型无直接关系；但其方法可潜在地加速任何基于自回归解码的模型，包括VLA或WAM中的语言/动作解码器。

papers.title: ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting
papers.title_zh: ReAnchor：利用被拒绝的验证器状态重新锚定扩散草稿器

papers.abstract: Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.

analysis.key_results: 在受控消融集上，ScopeMem 将正确决策被破坏的比例降至 5.6%，同时修复的错误数量优于所有 CE 训练前缀；在 AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey 和零样本 AITW 上超越所有评估的提示和潜在记忆基线，使冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B 达到或超过 GUI 专用智能体和 Qwen3-VL-32B 的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ScopeMem，一种学习修订范围的潜在记忆方法，其编码器根据模型初始答案生成前缀，训练时纠正错误同时保留正确决策，解决了 CE 训练前缀因无范围修订而破坏正确动作的问题。
analysis.method: ScopeMem 编码器以模型初始答案为条件生成前缀；训练目标是在修正错误动作的同时保留正确决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ScopeMem 提出一种潜在记忆方法，通过控制前缀生成范围，在修正冻结视觉语言模型（GUI 智能体）的错误动作的同时保留正确决策。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于 GUI 智能体的潜在记忆与高效推理，不直接涉及机器人或世界模型。但其核心思想——在冻结视觉语言模型中学习何时修订输出，保留正确预测——对 VLA（视觉语言动作模型）的高效推理和策略修正具有方法论参考价值。

Its 5.5-point accuracy gain (pp: percentage points) hides these harms. ScopeMem (right) learns to focus revisions on the actor’s errors, repairing 254 and harming 49.

papers.abstract: The limited onboard computing resources of robots make the inference demands of vision-language-action (VLA) models costly to accommodate. Reducing these demands through aggressive compression, however, can degrade manipulation performance beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone recovers. We present SPAR (Structural Pruning and Action Recovery), which simultaneously prunes the hidden and feed-forward intermediate dimensions of the large language model (LLM) backbone through pruning-aware tuning, then applies reinforcement learning (RL) to recover policy performance. Applied to $\pi_{0.5}$, SPAR reduces the language backbone from 2.34B to 0.09B parameters and the full model from 3.37B to 1.12B, removing approximately 96% and 67% of their parameters, respectively. At this compression level, RL raises average success across the four LIBERO suites from 84.55% to 93.45%, an 8.90-percentage-point gain. The compressed policy achieves a $1.98\times$ full-policy inference speedup over the unpruned model. These results identify substantial intermediate-dimension redundancy and show that post-pruning RL can recover manipulation performance in compact policies.

analysis.key_results: 将语言主干从2.34B压缩到0.09B，完整模型从3.37B压缩到1.12B；在四个LIBERO套件上平均成功率从84.55%提升到93.45%，推理速度提升1.98倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SPAR方法，对VLA模型π0.5进行结构剪枝和剪枝感知微调，并利用强化学习恢复策略性能，实现了大幅参数压缩和推理加速，同时提高了任务成功率。
analysis.method: 结构剪枝与动作恢复（SPAR）：对LLM主干的隐藏维度和前馈中间维度进行剪枝，剪枝感知微调，随后使用强化学习恢复策略性能。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SPAR通过结构剪枝和强化学习在保持操纵性能的同时大幅压缩VLA模型并提升推理速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的压缩与高效推理，属于机器人策略学习和高效推理的交叉领域，对部署高效VLA系统具有重要价值。

figures.caption: Overview of the SPAR Framework. Top: SPAR compresses the LLM backbone of a VLA policy, which integrates visual and language inputs to guide the action expert. Bottom: (1) Through pruning-aware tuning , SPAR jointly learns channel masks for the hidden dimension and the FFN intermediate dimension while adapting the policy to manipulation tasks. (2) These masks guide structural pruning , which removes inactive channels to form a smaller dense backbone. (3) After supervised fine-tuning of the compact policy, RL recovery further improves task performance through simulated interaction, updating the action expert and value head while keeping the pruned LLM backbone frozen.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: SPAR: Structural Pruning and Action Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Models
