papers.abstract: Human-collected robot manipulation data often mix successful behavior with retries, pauses, recoveries, and failures. Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning (AC-BC) can exploit such mixed-quality data, but only if the conditioning signal is both accurately constructed from offline trajectories and effectively incorporated into the policy's action-vector-field prediction. Existing pipelines can weaken this signal by thresholding estimator-derived advantage scores into noisy conditions, and by routing conditions through prompts that weakly affect the action vector field. We introduce ALIGN, a condition-aligned AC-BC framework for vision-language-action policies. ALIGN directly predicts categorical pairwise conditions in the policy-facing label space and injects them into a DiT action expert through AdaRMS modulation fused with flow time. We evaluate ALIGN on deliberately mixed real-robot datasets for ARX X5 bowl stacking and Franka key hanging, each combining standard demonstrations with retry-heavy trajectories. ALIGN improves condition fidelity, strengthens conditional vector-field separability, and achieves 90.0% and 56.7% closed-loop success, compared with 56.7% and 33.3% for the strongest AC-BC baseline. These results indicate that aligning conditions from estimation to action prediction is an effective way to extract robust manipulation policies from data in which success, recovery and error coexist.

analysis.key_results: 在 ARX X5 碗堆叠和 Franka 钥匙悬挂真实机器人数据集上，ALIGN 分别达到 90.0% 和 56.7% 闭环成功率，优于最强 AC-BC 基线的 56.7% 和 33.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ALIGN 框架，将优势条件行为克隆的条件信号从估计到动作预测进行对齐，提高混合质量数据下的操作策略稳健性。
analysis.method: 直接预测策略标签空间中的分类成对条件，并通过 AdaRMS 调制与流动时间融合注入 DiT 动作专家。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ALIGN 提出一种条件对齐的视觉-语言-动作策略，通过直接预测分类成对条件并注入 DiT 动作专家，更好地利用混合质量机器人数据。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作策略的条件对齐，属于 VLA 核心研究，利用混合质量机器人数据提升操作策略学习。

figures.caption: Overview of ALIGN. Left: condition estimation. Given a historical observation, the current observation, robot states, and the task instruction, the direct categorical estimator predicts the AC-BC condition c ^ t \hat{c}_{t} from an ordered observation pair. Right: AC-BC policy training with estimated conditions. The current observation stream is encoded by the VLM, while AdaRMS combines c ^ t \hat{c}_{t} with the flow-time embedding to generate per-layer modulation parameters for the DiT action expert, so the predicted action vector field is explicitly conditioned on the estimated training condition.

papers.abstract: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.

analysis.key_results: 在VideoXum和MixTyVSum基准上，RVLSM在多个模型设置和指标上优于零样本VideoLLM基线，并与最先进的微调模型竞争；RVLSM摘要中的命名实体与基准摘要的对齐更紧密。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出递归视频语言摘要模型（RVLSM），通过语义时间分解（STD）和自适应多模态工具调用（AMTC）实现长视频摘要。
analysis.method: RVLSM递归分解视频为语义一致的片段，将块级推理委托给VideoLLM子模型和外部工具，采用STD动态分区视频并调用AMTC路由机制选择性调用辅助模块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出首个递归视频语言摘要模型，通过语义时间分解和自适应多模态工具调用，改进长视频到文本的摘要生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对长视频理解与摘要，属于视觉语言模型的高效推理，但不直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Every driving scene is logged once, but driving is one-to-many: the scene determines which behaviors are feasible, while an instruction selects among them. A log records only the action taken, leaving no direct supervision for alternative feasible actions or instructions the scene cannot support. Consequently, a policy that ignores language and one that follows it without regard to scene constraints can fit the same data. We present Cartender, which learns from the drives not taken. Counterfactual Branching constructs matched and mismatched instruction-action pairs from real recordings without a simulator: a vision-language model proposes alternative futures and their selecting instructions, while unsupported instructions provide negative labels. A learned scene-language compatibility score regulates language conditioning in trajectory generation, and a reward-trained language residual re-ranks generated candidates over a scene-based score. The branches are used for training; instruction following is evaluated by swapping instructions under identical recorded inputs and measuring behavior rather than agreement with generated targets. On WOD-E2E, the best of four proposals achieves an RFS of 8.642 across 3,603 feasible instruction conditions. Across 8,974 admitted proposals, mean RFS is 8.203 versus 7.906 for matched logged trajectories, and 67% score higher than their logged counterpart. Compared with matched-only imitation using the same backbone, Cartender improves same-scene paired instruction success from 23.67% to 57.00% and RFS from 6.32 to 7.10; its gate reduces infeasible-instruction execution from 53.36% to 14.18%.

analysis.key_results: 在WOD-E2E上，最佳提案在3603个可行指令条件下RFS达8.642；在8974个准入提案中，平均RFS为8.203，高于匹配记录轨迹的7.906，67%的提案得分超过其记录对应项；与仅匹配模仿相比，同场景配对指令成功率从23.67%提升至57.00%，RFS从6.32提升至7.10；门控将不可行指令执行从53.36%降至14.18%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Cartender，利用反事实分支从真实驾驶记录中构造匹配与不匹配的指令-动作对，并引入场景-语言兼容性评分和奖励训练的语言残差，提升语言条件驾驶的可验证性。
analysis.method: 使用视觉-语言模型生成替代未来轨迹及选择指令，不支持的指令作为负标签；学习场景-语言兼容性评分调节轨迹生成中的语言条件，并利用奖励训练的语言残差对生成候选进行重排序。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Cartender通过反事实分支从未执行的动作中学习驾驶策略，实现可验证的语言条件驾驶。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对语言条件驾驶策略，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）范畴，但其核心贡献在于反事实数据构建和场景-语言兼容性建模，与VLA中指令跟随与场景约束的平衡问题密切相关，对本站主题有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

analysis.key_results: 在板卡上量化后模型保持了优秀的分割性能，且在代表性测试平台上对端到端处理链和并行工作流进行了表征。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并实现了一条通用的星载AI处理链，涵盖模型量化、场景级推理工作流以及基于unikernel和ORCHIDE的任务级编排，并通过野火分割、船舶检测和云分割三个应用进行了验证。
analysis.method: 将AI模型调优（波段选择、输入归一化）、量化为int8并移植到AMD Versal VCK190；使用模块化的分块-推理-拼接（tiler-inference-mosaicer）工作流将分块级模型扩展到整景；将每个步骤打包为unikernel并在ORCHIDE编排器下运行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一条通用的星载AI处理链，将模型量化到int8并部署在AMD Versal VCK190上，通过模块化分块-推理-拼接工作流和unikernel编排实现端到端场景级处理，并以野火分割等应用为例进行验证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文不涉及VLA或WAM，主要关注星载AI处理链中的模型量化（int8）和高效部署/编排。虽然量化技术对VLA/WAM的低比特部署有方法学参考价值，但本文未与机器人动作预测或世界模型直接关联。

papers.abstract: Modern robotic photography requires understanding photographic intent, planning camera motions, and producing aesthetically pleasing images in complex environments. We present RoboPhoto-VLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework that jointly models perception, reasoning, and camera control for autonomous robotic photography. RoboPhoto-VLA incorporates PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences. To facilitate training and evaluation, we construct OpenPhotography, a robotic photography dataset with language-guided demonstrations. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that RoboPhoto-VLA produces photographs better aligned with human aesthetic preferences while generalizing effectively to unseen subjects, viewpoints, poses, and complex photographic instructions.

analysis.key_results: 真实世界实验表明，RoboPhoto-VLA能生成更符合人类美学偏好的照片，并有效泛化到未见主体、视角、姿态和复杂摄影指令。
analysis.main_contribution: RoboPhoto-VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于自主机器人摄影，整合摄影意图理解、运动规划与美学优化。
analysis.method: PhotoCoT结构化动作规划与Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) 对齐人类美学偏好，并构建OpenPhotography数据集进行训练与评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RoboPhoto-VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于自主机器人摄影，结合结构化动作规划和美学偏好对齐。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接提出并训练一个VLA模型用于机器人摄影任务，属于VLA在具身智能中的典型应用，与本站主题高度相关。

The system then detects the user, identifies incomplete framing of the pose, and initiates adjustments to its position and angle (upper right). Next, RoboPhoto-VLA precisely adjusts its robotic arm and camera orientation to align with the desired composition (lower left). The lower-right panel displays the final unretouched photograph captured by RoboPhoto-VLA.

The architecture follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with PhotoCoT for structured photographic grounding and multi-step action planning; (2) Reinforcement Learning (RL) with ADPO for refining action selection to better align with human aesthetic preferences.

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，使用 DAPO-Math-17k 训练，ASE 相比 GRPO 在六个数学推理基准上的平均 Mean@8 分别提升了 4.87 和 1.87 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 Activation-Space Exploration (ASE)，一种在线方法，通过聚类激活差异构建结构化潜在探索向量库，并应用到后续采样中以探索替代推理路径。
analysis.method: 在 RLVR 框架下，聚类同一问题正确与错误响应间的激活差异，构建潜在探索向量库，并将不同向量应用到后续采样中。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 ASE 方法，通过聚类正确与错误响应的激活差异构建探索向量库，以多样化强化学习中的采样路径，提升数学推理性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究语言模型在数学推理任务上的强化学习探索策略，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人学习，与本站主题无直接关系。

figures.caption: Motivation and high-level overview of activation-space exploration. Standard GRPO samples all responses from one proposal distribution, whereas ASE uses outcome feedback to maintain multiple activation-space directions, routes responses through different proposals, and updates the actor and vector bank online.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: ASE pipeline. We replay successful and unsuccessful responses to read out hidden activations, cluster their pairwise differences to form exploration directions, match and smooth the directions across updates, and inject one selected direction into the residual stream for each routed response.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

papers.abstract: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.

analysis.key_results: 在SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG上，比SHANKS风格窗口基线提高了聚合推测工具覆盖率或检索重用；在FDBench v3上工具覆盖率提高16个百分点，平均最终响应延迟降低36.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入心跳思维机制，在语音理解过程中周期性地对最新部分转录进行推理，同时允许已进行中的推理和工具调用完成，实现跨语音更新的推测准备。
analysis.method: 定期调用推理器读取最新部分转录和已完成推理/工具结果的共享记录，以解决缺失参数并发起依赖调用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出心跳思维方法，利用语音输入过程中持续完成推测推理和工具调用，将等待时间转化为可复用的准备工作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语音代理中的推测推理和工具执行，不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM），与本站主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.

analysis.key_results: 在LifePhotoBench上，GeoEdit对6种主流MLRM实现了强大保护，在图像保真度上比视觉扰动基线高出0.59以上。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GeoEdit，一个对抗性去证据框架，通过图像编辑实现静默地理隐私保护，在保持图像可分享性的同时有效破坏MLRM的地理推理。
analysis.method: 结合结构化知识与对抗发现的地理线索识别高风险证据锚点，采用可学习策略迭代优化编辑决策，并将成功轨迹蒸馏为可迁移的自然语言见解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种对抗性图像编辑框架GeoEdit，通过最小编辑高风险证据锚点来破坏多模态大推理模型的地理推理链，从而保护隐私。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对多模态大推理模型的地理推理能力进行对抗性干扰，涉及视觉语言模型的空间推理，但不涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型训练；其对抗性编辑策略可潜在启发对VLA/WAM中视觉证据链的鲁棒性评估与攻击，但无直接结合。

Conversely, the daily life photo (b) inadvertently leaks sensitive location data via implicit geo-evidence, resulting in non-consensual exposure and severe doxing risks.

figures.caption: Comparison of geoprivacy protection mechanisms. (a) The unprotected image. (b) Image Obfuscation hides sensitive areas but ruins the visual experience. (c) Visual Perturbation tricks visual encoders to protect geoprivacy, but its adversarial nature is often lost during unpredictable image processing and causes noticeable artifacts. (d) Geo-Evidence Editing (Ours) blocks the localization reasoning chain to defend against both MLRMs and human analysis while keeping visual appeal.

papers.abstract: Tactile perception is crucial for precise robotic manipulation, providing an important foundation for dexterous, closed-loop force control. Among various tactile sensing techniques, magnetic tactile sensors stand out thanks to their fine-grained, three-dimensional force perception capability and strong robustness against visual occlusion. In this study, we discover a physical loophole called PhantomTac in magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can alter the magnetic field, thus spoofing the force interpreted by magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can stealthily deploy such an attack by simply attaching a thin (the thickness is around 0.5 mm), battery-free magnetic tag to the surface of an object. Hence, the attack tag can be easily concealed by a barcode sticker. Such an attack scheme is "deploy-and-forget" -- the attacker can deploy the tag and leave. When a robotic hand is picking up an object, it may severely damage the object. Specifically, spoofing the normal force can crush the object, whereas spoofing the shear force can lead to a loose grip, thus dropping the object. Compared with directly sabotaging the robotic hand, PhantomTac is much more concealed as the attacker does not need access to the device. We performed extensive reverse-engineering efforts to characterize the sensing mechanism of commercial-off-the-shelf tactile sensors and proposed a practical tag design. End-to-end evaluations conducted on real robots and robotic arms demonstrate that our attack can bypass existing anti-interference mechanisms and effectively hijack their closed-loop control processes, achieving an attack success rate exceeding 95% when the grasping-position offset is bounded within 8 mm. Finally, based on the limitations of existing anti-magnetic interference mechanisms, we propose a multimodal-consistency defense mechanism to mitigate such physical-layer security threats.

analysis.key_results: 攻击成功率超过95%（抓取位置偏移在8mm内），可绕过现有抗干扰机制。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现并利用磁性触觉传感器的物理漏洞，提出一种隐蔽、部署即忘的攻击方案，并设计多模态一致性防御机制。
analysis.method: 逆向分析商用触觉传感器特性，设计薄型无源磁标签进行磁场干扰，并评估其对机器人抓取控制的影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 发现磁性触觉传感器存在物理漏洞，可通过粘贴无源磁标签欺骗力感知，劫持机器人闭环抓取控制，成功率超95%。

papers.abstract: Adversarial vulnerability persists across modern vision architectures from CNNs to vision language models (VLMs), yet existing detection methods rely on heuristics without theoretical guarantees. We address the fundamental question of when adversarial perturbations can be provably detected from a geometric perspective. Our key insight is that adversarial perturbations cannot simultaneously preserve geometric structure across spaces with fundamentally different properties. Accordingly, we construct two such complementary metric spaces. First, we use a standard CNN embedding space $Z$, where adversarial samples exhibit significant displacement patterns. Second, we build a novel prime-quantized space $P$, that absorbs small perturbations through number-theoretic discretization, resulting in minimal displacement, while preserving discriminability. We then leverage the geometric discrepancies across spaces $Z$ and $P$ to detect adversarial samples. To the best of our knowledge, we establish the first rigorous separation theory for adversarial detection, proving that adversarial samples create unavoidable geometric inconsistencies across both spaces. Our framework provides theoretical guarantees including pixel-level absorption bounds, neighborhood diameter concentration, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) separation theorems, and practical risk control. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical predictions and achieve consistently strong detection performance across a wide range of attack types and model families.

analysis.key_results: 在多种攻击类型和模型家族上取得了稳定且强大的检测性能，验证了理论预测。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出结合素数量化空间和Gromov-Wasserstein度量的对抗样本检测方法，并建立了首个对抗检测的严格分离理论。
analysis.method: 构建两个互补的度量空间：CNN嵌入空间Z和素数量化空间P，利用对抗样本在这两个空间中的几何不一致性进行检测，并给出像素级吸收界、邻域直径集中性、Gromov-Wasserstein分离定理等理论保证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于素数量化空间与CNN嵌入空间几何差异的可证明对抗样本检测框架。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该文聚焦于通用对抗样本检测的量化方法，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略；但与量化技术相关，对高效推理和模型压缩有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: Embodied VLMs can execute increasingly complex manipulation tasks, yet execution errors can leave the environment in states that require replanning for recovery. Existing recovery methods either rely on inference-time mechanisms with fixed policies or learn from failure examples and reference corrections rather than verified action outcomes. To enable recovery learning through verifiable interaction, we introduce the Embodied Replanning for Recovery Environment (ERR-Env), which provides feedback on task progress and execution errors. We further construct ERR-Bench, a benchmark with held-out tasks spanning nominal, intermediate, and error states for evaluating recovery capability and execution reliability. We then propose Action-Grouped Turn-GSPO (AGT-GSPO), an online reinforcement learning method combining turn-level rewards for task progress and error states with action-grouped advantage estimation, and use it to train ERR-VLM, a compact 2B embodied VLM. Evaluation on ERR-Bench reveals a mismatch between task progress and execution reliability across diverse VLMs. AGT-GSPO improves ERR-VLM by 10.25 percentage points in Strict Success Rate for error-free completion and 22.95 percentage points in Recovery Rate, while ablations and zero-shot transfer further validate the effectiveness of our method.

analysis.key_results: 在ERR-Bench上，AGT-GSPO使ERR-VLM的严格成功率（无错误完成）提高了10.25个百分点，恢复率提高了22.95个百分点；消融和零样本迁移进一步验证了方法有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了ERR-Env环境、ERR-Bench基准，以及动作分组Turn-GSPO (AGT-GSPO)在线强化学习方法，用于训练紧凑的2B具身VLM，提升错误恢复能力和执行可靠性。
analysis.method: AGT-GSPO，一种在线强化学习方法，结合了任务进展和错误状态的回合级奖励与动作分组优势估计；在ERR-Env中进行可验证交互训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一个用于具身VLM错误恢复训练的交互环境、基准测试以及在线强化学习方法，显著提升了模型的恢复能力和执行可靠性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对具身VLA（Embodied VLM）的操纵任务错误恢复能力，提出环境、基准和训练方法，属于VLA领域的核心研究，与机器人动作执行和策略学习高度相关。

papers.abstract: Deep generative models provide an effective modern solution to alleviating the problem of data scarcity by synthesizing realistic time series. However, despite the considerable progress achieved by existing deep time series generators, two key challenges remain: (1) learning hierarchical representations for heterogeneous temporal patterns; and (2) coordinating the generation process of heterogeneous temporal dynamics. To address these key bottlenecks, in this work, we propose ORBIT, a unified deep generative framework for time series. Specifically, we develop two key components: the Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) and the Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer (FBAR). The former learns hierarchical representations by decomposing latent temporal representations into different frequency bands and applying residual quantization with increasing token budgets. The latter establishes a novel low-to-high frequency autoregressive direction, yielding a time series generation process that first constructs global temporal structures and then incrementally incorporates fine-grained temporal details. These compact designs not only disentangle heterogeneous temporal patterns for more effective representation learning but also mitigate potential interference among different temporal dynamics during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that ORBIT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance while exhibiting superior inference efficiency compared with advanced baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在多个真实世界基准测试中取得最先进整体性能，并展现出优于先进基线的推理效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出统一的深度生成框架ORBIT，包含Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE和Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer，用于层次化表示学习和低到高频的自回归生成。
analysis.method: Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE分解时间表示到不同频段并应用残差量化；Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer按低到高频顺序自回归生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该文提出ORBIT，一种结合频率层次VQ-VAE和频段自回归Transformer的时间序列生成框架，以提升生成质量和推理效率。

papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.

analysis.key_results: 将DiT-XL/2蒸馏到DiT-B/2后，在ImageNet 256×256上达到FID 2.58，实测相对DDIM-50加速2.25倍；消融实验支持轨迹监督和LTE路由优于随机决策且延迟接近。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TamedFlow方法，通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机化轨迹监督训练压缩DiT，并引入可学习轨迹估计器在推理时路由草稿，缓解组合差距。
analysis.method: 在训练阶段利用交叉架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机化轨迹监督；推理阶段使用可学习轨迹估计器决定是否接受草稿，被拒绝的草稿回退并由教师模型校正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对压缩扩散Transformer与学生自适应推理组合时的质量下降问题，提出轨迹感知蒸馏训练与推理时轨迹估计路由机制，实现无质量损失的加速采样。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于扩散Transformer的模型压缩与自适应推理，属于独立的高效推理技术，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，因此与本站主题无直接关系，但其轨迹感知蒸馏和路由机制可为未来VLA/WAM的高效推理提供方法论参考。

papers.abstract: Hosted LLM services increasingly expose model identity as a product claim, but external users and auditors often cannot inspect which model configuration served a request. We study an auditor-assisted regime in which a trusted auditor enrolls claimed identities and prepares verification material before deployment, while audit-time verification uses only the claimed identity and released output, without runtime access to model internals, inference logs, routing decisions, or provider metadata. We propose SUMMARK, a summary-channel watermarking framework that uses user-visible reasoning summaries as a keyed audit surface. During setup, SUMMARK constructs identity-specific vocabulary carriers, trains lightweight summary adapters, and calibrates per-identity thresholds. At deployment time, a keyed statistical test assesses whether the released summary is consistent with the claimed identity and, when needed, attributes the most likely enrolled identity. Across model families, scales, and task domains, SUMMARK reliably detects cross-family and cross-scale substitutions at low false-positive rates while preserving task-facing answer quality. We further study FP16->INT8/INT4 precision-consistency diagnostics and robustness under bounded post-processing, rewriting stress tests, and text-only spoofing, revealing both strong performance and clear failure boundaries. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/trinitr0toluene/Summark.

analysis.key_results: 跨模型族与规模可靠检测替换，低误报率且保持答案质量；FP16->INT8/INT4 精度一致性诊断有效，但在后处理、重写和文本欺骗下存在失败边界。
analysis.limitations: 摘要提到在有限后处理、重写压力测试和纯文本欺骗下存在清晰的失败边界。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SUMMARK，一种审计辅助的摘要信道水印框架，可在无运行时内部访问的情况下检测和归因托管 LLM 的身份替换。
analysis.method: 通过构建身份特定词汇载体、训练轻量摘要适配器并校准每身份阈值，使用键控统计检验验证摘要与声称身份的一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 SUMMARK 框架，利用用户可见的推理摘要作为密钥审计表面，以验证托管 LLM 的声称身份并检测模型替换。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于托管 LLM 的身份验证，涉及量化精度一致性诊断，与 VLA 或 WAM 无直接关系；但所提出的身份验证方法及量化鲁棒性评估可能为高效模型部署提供参考。

Given the claim and released summary, a trusted auditor tests whether the summary is statistically consistent with m m using secret verification material prepared offline. When answer and summary generation use separate pipelines, the guarantee is summary-channel consistency. End-to-end answer provenance requires additional coupling or deployment-side attestation.

papers.abstract: Integrating force awareness into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models involves not merely encoding wrench measurements as an additional modality, but determining when and how strongly physical interaction should influence robot action generation. Existing VLAs that use force typically inject it through a fixed pathway, without explicitly determining when it is relevant to the current action. This calls for an intermediate force relevance mechanism inside the VLA, in which visual-language context estimates the relevance of physical feedback to the current task before force enters the action pathway. FR-VLA addresses this gap with a Vision-Language Force-Reasoning Model that uses learnable force query tokens to derive a force admission signal grounded in visual-language context, and uses this signal to modulate an external tokenized force pathway for action generation. In real-world experiments on five contact-rich tasks across two robotic platforms, FR-VLA achieves the highest mean success rate over six evaluated stages, and trajectory visualizations show that its force admission varies with the interaction phase.

analysis.key_results: 在五类接触丰富任务和两个机器人平台上的真实世界实验中，FR-VLA在六个评估阶段中取得了最高的平均成功率；轨迹可视化显示其力准入信号随交互阶段变化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FR-VLA，其核心贡献是视觉-语言力推理模型：利用可学习的力查询token生成基于视觉-语言上下文的力准入信号，并以此调制外部token化的力通路，从而决定力反馈何时及多强地影响动作生成。
analysis.method: 使用视觉-语言力推理模型，通过可学习的力查询token生成力准入信号，并用该信号调制外部token化的力通路进行动作生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出FR-VLA，一种通过视觉-语言上下文自适应调节力反馈影响的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于接触丰富操作任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于VLA模型，引入力反馈的自适应推理机制，属于机器人操作和策略学习范畴，对VLA与物理交互的融合具有直接研究价值。

Measured wrench histories are encoded by the Force Tokenizer Module and enter the Action Expert only through the admission-conditioned action-side pathway. papers.abstract: We set out to reproduce a recent hallucination-mitigation result on the POPE benchmark. The LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline we measured, 82.21 F1 on the adversarial split, sat 1.21 to 8.67 points above the adversarial baselines we planned to compare against (81.00, 79.30, and 73.54). We looked at the evaluation code and found a readout choice that moves F1 on its own. A two-token logit readout decides yes versus no by comparing two vocabulary IDs, 3582 ("yes") and 1217 ("no"). Across 9,000 greedy-decode questions spanning all three splits, neither ID is generated even once. The model emits " Yes" (token 3869) and " No" (token 1939), because SentencePiece prepends a space byte after the prompt suffix "ASSISTANT:". Read with an eight-token lookup that covers the space-prefixed surface forms, LLaVA-1.5-7B scores F1 0.8221, 0.8498, and 0.8713 on the adversarial, popular, and random splits. That 6.13-point adversarial shift exceeds the adversarial gain reported by five of the six papers we surveyed. None of them states its readout, and our reference ran under 4-bit NF4 quantization, so we cannot say how much of any reported gain a matched evaluation would keep. That comparison stays unresolved until readout and precision are matched. On the fixed baseline we run nine inference-time corrections of our own (none beat it) and dissect why the adversarial split resists logit-level intervention. In a 3,000-question probe, wrong predictions draw more image attention than correct ones (Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\times10^{-24}$), the opposite of what grounding-based corrections assume. A four-readout audit across four further VLMs from three tokenizer families confirms the confound is protocol-level, not model-specific: porting the LLaVA-1.5 IDs verbatim drops F1 to 0.00 on the two disjoint-vocabulary models, whereas a tokenizer-derived readout holds between 0.80 and 0.92.

analysis.key_results: LLaVA-1.5-7B在三种split上F1分别为0.8221、0.8498、0.8713；错误的预测比正确的预测关注更多图像区域（Cohen's d=-0.46，p=1.4×10^-24）；直接移植token ID导致F1降至0.00，而tokenizer派生读取保持在0.80-0.92。
analysis.limitations: 无法确定已有论文报告的增益有多少是由匹配的评估保留的，因为参考运行使用了4-bit NF4量化，且比较尚未解决。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现POPE评估中的token读取方法存在系统性混淆，adversarial split的F1分数因读取方式不同可产生6.13点的变化，并提出tokenizer派生的读取方法可稳定评估。
analysis.method: 系统审计四个VLM和三个tokenizer家族，对比二token logit读取、八token查找等不同是/否提取方法，并进行3,000问题的注意力探针分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文系统审计了POPE基准中VLM幻觉评估的是/否token提取方法，发现token集选择对F1分数有显著影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于VLM幻觉评估基准的token提取方法，不涉及VLA或WAM，但与模型量化（4-bit NF4）有一定关联。

The two-token check inspects two IDs the model never produces in this context, so every comparison is between two candidates the decoder excluded. On the adversarial split that comparison reads 924 of the model’s 1,644 answers (56%) as yes, ‘No’

Under two-token evaluation, 660 of the 1,318 true-No predictions migrate to the FP cell, leaving precision at 0.6307. Under eight-token evaluation only 182 stay there, and precision is 0.8658. The model’s behaviour is identical across both matrices; only the readout changes.

papers.abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实世界任务中，PaceVLA在多种机器人形态下提高了执行效率，同时保持了任务成功率，包括长时序和灵巧操作任务。

papers.abstract: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

analysis.key_results: 在Simpler-WidowX上从58.7%提升至69.8%（+11.1个百分点），LIBERO上达到97.2%，真实世界任务达到52.8%，RMBench记忆依赖任务为21.6%。
analysis.limitations: 在较难的依赖多观测的任务上暴露有限历史窗口的局限性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CondenseVLA，一种多帧VLA策略，在解码端引入可学习历史压缩模块，将历史观测压缩为有限槽令牌，并通过辅助正则化减少槽冗余、鼓励互补注意力。
analysis.method: 使用可学习查询和多头交叉注意力将缓存的逐帧特征压缩为固定数量的槽令牌；通过惩罚槽注意力图重叠和去相关槽嵌入的正则化减少冗余。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CondenseVLA提出在VLA解码端增加可学习历史压缩模块，将多帧视觉特征压缩为固定槽令牌，以高效利用短期视觉上下文进行动作预测。

papers.abstract: Large-language-model register-transfer-level (RTL) generation has concentrated on how to train the model: fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning from a verifier. We argue this is the second-order question. On a bounded, formally specifiable task of generating single-error-correcting, double-error-detecting (SECDED) ECC memory wrappers, we hold the task, data, and correctness oracle fixed and vary two axes independently: the training regime (seven settings) and the output representation (four levels, from fully expanded flat Verilog to an eight-field configuration expanded by a deterministic generator). Because a reference generator exists, correctness is decided by formal equivalence over a design space of approximately ten million points, rather than sampled from a hand-written testbench. Two results follow. First, representation dominates: every representation close to raw RTL reaches a pass rate of at most 0.17, while the configuration reaches 0.83 with no training at all. Once the model emits the configuration, every training regime achieves a pass rate between 0.89 and 1.00. Second, raw RTL hits a hard output-length limit: a 512-bit design requires 44,237 tokens of flat Verilog compared with just 69 tokens for the configuration. Consequently, raw generation becomes infeasible above 32-bit data words rather than merely inaccurate. A model trained from scratch with fewer than 50 million parameters, combined with the verified generator, achieves 0.89 formal equivalence, compared with 1.00 for a 32-billion-parameter fine-tuned model, while using approximately 1600 times less inference energy per correct design. Inference energy also dominates amortized training energy. The lesson is to learn the interface, not the implementation.

analysis.key_results: 配置级表示无需训练即可达到0.83通过率，所有训练策略在配置表示下通过率为0.89-1.00；原始RTL表示最佳通过率仅0.17；512位设计需要44237个token的扁平Verilog，而配置表示仅需69 token；小于5000万参数的模型配合生成器达到0.89形式等价，32B微调模型为1.00，但前者每次正确设计的推理能耗低约1600倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 在固定任务、数据和正确性判定器的条件下，证明输出表示比训练策略更关键：配置级表示无需训练即可达到0.83通过率，而任何接近原始RTL的表示通过率最高仅0.17；同时配置表示将512位设计的输出长度从44237 token降至69 token，大幅降低推理能耗。
analysis.method: 在单纠错双检错(SECDED)ECC内存包装器生成任务上，固定任务与数据，独立改变训练策略（七种）和输出表示（四种，从扁平Verilog到八字段配置），使用形式等价验证和后端生成器评估生成正确性和效率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文在硬件RTL生成任务中发现输出表示对生成正确性和推理能耗的影响超过训练策略，低维配置表示结合小模型即可高效实现正确设计。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明VLDA在长时程一致性、鲁棒性和泛化性方面有所提升，验证了可执行Delta作为直接动作预测和完整未来状态建模的替代方案的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA)范式，将完整的未来预测重构为紧凑的可执行转移建模，核心是捕获潜在世界状态变化的Delta变量，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口。
analysis.method: 通过统一目标学习Delta，该目标由局部转移过滤器(LT-Filter)和全局转移锚点(GT-Anchor)组成；LT-Filter捕获任务相关的操作中心变化并抑制静态重构偏差，GT-Anchor提供粗粒度的未来级正则化以保持状态变化的整体方向；Delta驱动动作细化(DDAR)将Delta锚定在动作流形中，并将其作为结构化种子注入以指导动作去噪。在LoongForge开源框架中实现统一两阶段优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLDA范式，通过紧凑Delta变量建模可执行的状态转移，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口，以改进机器人操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA和WAM的不足，提出一种新的范式，将世界建模从完整状态预测转换为紧凑的可执行转移Delta，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口，旨在降低学习负担并提高机器人操作性能。

In stage II, Delta-Driven Action Refinement grounds Delta in the action manifold through Delta-to-Action Manifold Grounding and injects it into action denoising through Delta-Seeded Action Flow, enabling the Action Expert to generate action chunks.

papers.abstract: Time-series models increasingly condition on known future inputs. In controlled systems, some of these inputs are actions that can be changed, compared, and optimized before execution. A model must therefore do more than predict the realized future: it must predict how outcomes change under different actions from the same observed history and support reliable comparison of candidate plans. We introduce ActTime, an action-conditioned world model for time series. Over the observed history, ActTime updates variable-specific latent states through an action-conditioned transition and corrects them using observations. It then rolls the same transition forward under candidate actions to generate future trajectories. Training uses only factual trajectories, without paired alternative-action outcomes or planning supervision. We construct a simulator-grounded evaluation suite across building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management, covering factual prediction, intervention-effect prediction, offline decision making, and closed-loop planning. ActTime ranks first in 12 of 16 domain-task settings. Across eight methods, the mean pairwise model-ranking reversal rate is 17.8% between factual prediction and intervention fidelity, and rises to 28.4% between intervention fidelity and decision ranking. These results show that factual accuracy, intervention fidelity, and decision quality are related but not interchangeable.

analysis.key_results: ActTime 在16个领域任务设置中12项排名第一；事实预测与干预保真度之间的平均成对模型排名反转率为17.8%，干预保真度与决策排名之间为28.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ActTime，一种基于动作条件转换与观测校正的动作条件世界模型，能够从纯事实轨迹中学习干预效果与候选计划比较。
analysis.method: 在观测历史上进行动作条件的状态转移与观测校正，然后在候选动作下前向滚动同一转移生成未来轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ActTime 提出一种动作条件的时间序列世界模型，通过历史状态更新与候选动作前向滚动来预测干预效果并支持决策规划。

papers.abstract: Dynamic object manipulation requires robots to anticipate target motion while replanning fast enough to avoid executing outdated actions. Existing approaches either rely on fast reactive control without an explicit future target state or encode anticipated motion only implicitly. World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising alternative by coupling future visual prediction with action generation, but scene-level video objectives may underrepresent target dynamics that are critical for manipulation, while iterative video-action denoising introduces substantial latency. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-guided world action model for efficient dynamic robotic manipulation. Our key insight is to explicitly ground future visual imagination in predicted target-object motion and use the resulting future representation to condition action generation, while preserving this anticipation pathway after acceleration. Given a short history of object masks, a history-conditioned motion predictor forecasts future masks encoding the target object's trajectory. A lightweight Trajectory ControlNet then steers a pretrained video model toward trajectory-consistent futures. The resulting future representation conditions an action expert to predict executable action chunks. To enable one-step inference without breaking this interface, we introduce a decoupled distillation scheme that combines distribution matching for the video backbone, Trajectory ControlNet realignment, and action rollout distillation to support accurate one-step action prediction conditioned on the compressed future representation. Comprehensive evaluations in simulation and the real world show that TrajWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on dynamic object manipulation tasks while enabling efficient one-step video-action inference. Project page: https://kevingeng3.github.io/TrajWAM/.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界的动态物体操作任务中取得了最优性能，并实现了高效的一步视频-动作推断。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 TrajWAM，一种轨迹引导的世界行动模型，通过将目标物体的未来运动显式地融入未来视觉预测与动作生成，并设计解耦蒸馏方案支持高效的一步推断。
analysis.method: 使用历史物体掩码预测未来掩码，通过轻量级 Trajectory ControlNet 引导预训练视频模型生成轨迹一致的未来表示，并用该表示条件化动作专家预测动作块；此外，通过分布匹配、ControlNet 重对齐和动作展开蒸馏实现一步推断。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TrajWAM 提出一种轨迹引导的世界行动模型，通过预测目标物体未来运动来条件化视觉预测与动作生成，并采用解耦蒸馏实现高效的一步推断。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作与 WAM 主题高度相关，直接改进了世界行动模型在动态操作中的目标运动建模与推断效率，为 VLA/WAM 在机器人操作中的应用提供了新方法。

papers.abstract: Autonomous driving fundamentally demands dense understanding of visual, semantic, and geometric information, yet existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with sparse supervision such as language instructions or trajectory signals. This direct mapping from dense visual observations to sparse representations forces the model to compress or even discard critical scene information essential for safe driving. We argue that this limitation does not stem from insufficient model capacity, but from the lack of explicit mechanisms that encourage the formation of dense world representations in the latent space. In this spirit, we propose a novel paradigm for driving intelligence, Think Densely, Act Sparsely, and instantiate it with an efficient and interpretable framework, LECDrive (Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action autonomous Driving). The core idea is to mimic the hierarchical perception process of humans by embedding a progressive chain of latent expert cognition within the VLA model. Concretely, we inject a compact set of task-specific latent tokens as carriers, enabling the model to internalize dense knowledge from foundational vision models, including visual representations (DINOv3), semantic structures (SAM3), and spatial geometry (DepthAnything3), while maintaining efficient inference. This interdependent cognitive chain follows a curriculum learning principle, where supervision is progressively structured from representation to semantics and geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LECDrive consistently improves the performance of base VLMs across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks, covering key tasks such as object perception, state prediction, and trajectory planning. These findings suggest that constructing dense world models through structured latent expert chains is a promising direction for VLA-based autonomous driving.

analysis.key_results: LECDrive在多个自动驾驶基准上一致提升了基础VLM的性能，覆盖目标感知、状态预测和轨迹规划等关键任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新的自动驾驶智能范式“稠密思考，稀疏行动”，并实例化为名为LECDrive的框架，该框架在VLA模型中嵌入渐进的潜在专家认知链，以从基础视觉模型中内化稠密知识，同时保持高效推理。
analysis.method: 在VLA模型内部注入一组紧凑的任务特定潜在令牌作为载体，利用DINOv3、SAM3和DepthAnything3等基础视觉模型，按照课程学习原则从表征到语义再到几何逐步内化稠密知识。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LECDrive框架，通过注入潜在专家认知链来构建稠密世界表征，从而提升视觉-语言-动作自动驾驶模型的性能。

papers.abstract: Humanoid robots operating in human-centric environments must coordinate the entire body to traverse tight, cluttered spaces while maintaining balance. Existing methods often struggle to jointly consider dynamic stability and collision avoidance from high-dimensional perceptual inputs. Moreover, for humanoids, safe behavior is inherently multimodal: the same obstacle may admit multiple valid traversals, which is difficult to represent with a single deterministic policy. To address these challenges, we propose SWAP (Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy), a hierarchical framework that separates collision-aware decision making from stabilization. A high-level, perception-conditioned diffusion policy generates multimodal, collision-aware motion proposals, while a low-level whole-body RL controller tracks these proposals and maintains dynamic balance. To efficiently train the high-level policy, we obtain scalable supervision via hindsight labeling: we roll out the low-level policy under randomized commands, place obstacles only in the space that each executed motion did not sweep, so the motion is collision-free by construction, and re-render the perception the robot would have seen. At deployment, Monte Carlo sampling with simple cost signals steers the diffusion model toward safe, task-aligned behaviors without heavy reward tuning. Experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid show reliable avoidance with static and dynamic obstacles. Test-time steering further enables customization, improving targeted rewards (e.g., speed, orientation, or posture) by 34% on average while maintaining a high collision avoidance rate. Together, these results support a practical solution to humanoid whole-body collision avoidance with test-time steerability. Project website: https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实Unitree G1人形机器人上实现静态和动态障碍物的可靠避让；测试时转向平均提升目标奖励（速度、朝向或姿态）34%，同时保持高避碰率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SWAP框架，将碰撞感知决策与稳定控制分离，用感知条件的扩散策略生成多模态全身避碰运动，并利用事后标记获得可扩展监督，支持测试时转向自定义行为。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: SWAP采用分层框架，高层扩散策略生成多模态避碰运动提案，低层RL控制器跟踪并维持平衡，实现人形机器人在杂乱环境中的全身碰撞避让与测试时转向。

papers.abstract: Continuous vision-and-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated by goal-reaching success, assuming it reflects an agent's ability to execute language-grounded behavior. We show that this assumption can fail: permissive contact models in current simulators may mask physically infeasible actions, creating a physical executability gap between semantic competence and embodied realization. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA), a framework that aligns VLN policies with physically executable futures. We define visual-semantic traversability as the ability to predict instruction-conditioned trajectories that are semantically valid, geometrically feasible, and physically robust. VeSTA addresses this misalignment through two complementary mechanisms: improving executable support in trajectory generation and risk-aware selection among multimodal futures. Specifically, Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization uses strict-contact feedback to reshape the candidate distribution toward executable regions, while the Traversability Risk Critic learns a risk-adjusted scalar utility for candidate-wise future selection. Experiments on R2R and RxR reveal substantial dependence of existing VLN agents on simulator contact semantics. Under strict-contact evaluation, VeSTA substantially reduces collision-induced failures while preserving or improving goal-reaching performance, and controlled real-world robot experiments provide evidence that the learned preference transfers beyond simulation.

analysis.key_results: 在严格接触评估下，VeSTA显著减少碰撞导致的失败，同时保持或提高目标达成性能；仿真外的真实机器人实验表明学习偏好可迁移
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA)框架，通过Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization和Traversability Risk Critic两个机制，提高VLN策略的物理可执行性
analysis.method: 定义视觉语义可遍历性，利用严格接触反馈重塑候选分布，并学习风险调整的标量效用进行候选未来选择
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对视觉语言导航中评估指标与实际物理可执行性脱节的问题，提出VeSTA框架来对齐策略与物理可行的未来。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接关注视觉语言导航（VLN）中的物理可执行性问题，属于VLA范畴，但未涉及世界模型或机械臂操作；其方法改进了具身智能体在仿真和现实中的行动选择，与机器人学习密切相关

papers.abstract: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet activation outliers remain a key challenge for low-bit quantization. Existing global transformation methods overlook heterogeneous channel sensitivity to quantization noise, leading to suboptimal accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. To address this, we propose \textbf{Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization (LIRQuant)}, a sensitivity-aware framework that selectively applies transformations. LIRQuant identifies sensitive channels using a noise-weighted sensitivity metric, applying expressive learnable rotations only to these channels and lightweight fixed rotations to the remaining ones. This decoupled design reduces optimization complexity without sacrificing outlier smoothing capability. Extensive experiments across the LLaMA-2/3, Mistral, Qwen3, and Mixtral families demonstrate that LIRQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under the challenging W4A4KV4 setting. Meanwhile, LIRQuant calibrates LLaMA-3-8B in only 25 minutes with 20.3 GB peak GPU memory, achieving the fastest calibration and the lowest memory footprint among recent learnable-rotation methods, and its fused inference kernels deliver up to $2.3\times$ prefill speedup and $3.5\times$ memory saving over FP16.

analysis.key_results: 在 LLaMA-2/3、Mistral、Qwen3 和 Mixtral 系列模型上，LIRQuant 在 W4A4KV4 设置下达到最先进精度；校准 LLaMA-3-8B 仅需 25 分钟，峰值 GPU 内存 20.3 GB，为近期可学习旋转方法中最快且内存最低；融合推理内核相比 FP16 实现高达 2.3 倍预填充加速和 3.5 倍内存节省。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种敏感度感知的局部隔离旋转量化方法 LIRQuant，通过噪声加权敏感度指标识别敏感通道，并仅对这些通道应用可学习旋转，其余通道使用固定旋转，从而在降低优化复杂度的同时有效平滑异常值。
analysis.method: LIRQuant 结合噪声加权敏感度指标识别敏感通道，对敏感通道使用可学习旋转，对剩余通道使用轻量固定旋转。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 LIRQuant，一种敏感度感知的局部隔离旋转量化框架，通过仅对敏感通道应用可学习旋转来降低低比特量化中的激活异常值影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型的训练后量化，未直接涉及 VLA 或世界模型。但高效量化技术可应用于机器人策略模型或世界模型，为相关研究提供潜在借鉴意义。

papers.abstract: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fr\'echet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fr\'echet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.

analysis.key_results: 在预训练于253帧片段的MiniWorld-1B上，最多使用36个GPU小时在381帧片段上进行微调，生成的rollout在超过4000帧后仍保持稳定，并在机器人操作和相机控制探索中持续遵循动作。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Fr\'echet Forcing方法，利用来自短视频的真实数据统计，对世界模型及其多步采样器进行微调，实现超过4000帧的稳定长时程生成。
analysis.method: 结合流匹配损失的自生成历史生成锚定；利用潜变量统计的Fr\'echet距离实现上下文保真；在冻结感知空间中对真实帧使用Fr\'echet距离实现真实匹配。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Fr\'echet Forcing，通过在自生成历史、场景保真和真实匹配三项约束下微调流式世界模型，使其在远超训练时长的长rollout中保持稳定并遵循动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对机器人操作中的动作条件世界模型，解决长时程生成中的漂移问题，对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）的长期稳定预测具有核心价值。

figures.caption: 4,000-frame chunk-by-chunk rollouts from a single real frame on two DROID episodes (top four rows) and one Sekai scene (bottom two rows), following the commanded robot or camera trajectory. MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, cannot sustain longer rollouts: on DROID, saturated lattice texture spreads from the moving arm within 1,000 frames, and on Sekai the rollout darkens within the first 250 frames and then fades to black. MiniWorld-1B-FF, fine-tuned with Fréchet Forcing on 381-frame clips, stays coherent to frame 4,000, over 10 × 10\times the fine-tuning horizon.

papers.abstract: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.

analysis.key_results: 在六个环境中评估，2D导航任务TwoRoom和PointMaze中，在更难的规划设置下，成功率的提升最高达+54.7个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 利用潜在世界模型的随机正则化结构来消除潜在空间中的噪声，并基于状态动态矩阵的特征基进行潜在投影，以改善规划效果。
analysis.method: SIGReg假设潜在序列为高斯-马尔可夫过程，通过拟合状态动态矩阵A获得协方差；将A约束为正规矩阵以确保跨时间步的稳定特征基；将规划代价限制在不确定性最低的k维子空间。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SIGReg方法，利用世界模型潜在空间的正则化结构来剪除噪声，通过将规划代价限制在低不确定性子空间来改进潜在规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注潜在世界模型中的规划问题，属于世界模型和机器人学习范畴，但其核心贡献是改进潜在空间中代价计算的效率，并非针对VLA或WAM架构的直接研究。

papers.abstract: Extended reasoning has substantially improved multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on tasks requiring compositional and relational inference. However, multimodal grounding imposes a distinct requirement: reasoning must ultimately converge on a target-specific compact representation that supports precise localization. As reasoning trajectories grow longer, they often expand into broad scene narratives and peripheral relational details, which can dilute grounded perceptual evidence and lead to ambiguous or incorrect predictions. Motivated by the information bottleneck principle, we propose Think-Compress-Answer (TCA), a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes multimodal grounding into three phases: free-form reasoning, target-aware context compression, and answer generation conditioned on the compressed context. TCA is optimized through a multi-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with progressive rewards that establish the structured output protocol, minimize reasoning-specific information while preserving target-relevant content, and directly improve localization accuracy. This staged design enables MLLMs to retain the benefits of extended reasoning while distilling it into the minimal context required for grounding. Experiments across six multimodal grounding benchmarks show that TCA attains substantial zero-shot performance gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of reasoning compression.

analysis.key_results: 在六个多模态定位基准上取得显著零样本性能提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TCA框架，通过多阶段GRPO与渐进式奖励，在保留扩展推理优势的同时将其蒸馏为定位所需的最小上下文，从而提升多模态定位性能。
analysis.method: 基于信息瓶颈原理，设计三阶段协议：自由推理、目标感知压缩、基于压缩上下文的生成，并用多阶段GRPO与渐进式奖励优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Think-Compress-Answer（TCA）强化学习框架，将多模态定位分解为自由推理、目标感知压缩和基于压缩上下文的答案生成三个阶段，以提升定位精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对多模态定位任务提出推理压缩方法，未直接涉及VLA或WAM。其高效推理思想与本站关注的效率主题有间接关联，但对VLA/WAM无直接贡献。

papers.abstract: Visual world models have shown strong potential for robot planning, yet long-horizon manipulation remains challenging due to compounding prediction errors, large search complexity, and latent plans that the low-level controller cannot reliably reach. In this work, we introduce Vector-Quantized World Model (VQ-WM), a latent feedback motion planning framework that integrates discrete long-horizon search with continuous visual feedback control: a discrete latent predictor models transitions between vector-quantized latent states, allowing the planner to look far ahead and find a shortest path to the goal through discrete search and a continuous learned controller sequentially reaches the planned states through visual feedback, correcting deviations to mitigate compounding errors. Whereas most vector quantization uses Euclidean distance, we use a novel estimator of the first-passage-time as a quasi-metric, which aligns the planning abstraction with the controller's capabilities. We evaluate on the physical robot manipulation of the Tower of Hanoi puzzle: whereas existing state-of-the-art foundation models (VLAs, WAMs) only succeed when the solution trace in their training dataset, our method achieves 100\% success rate with only short-play data, demonstrate its ability to compose long-horizon solutions beyond the short demonstrated trajectories and execute them reliably. Our solution also outperforms strongest world-models by 13.3--85.3 percentage points on simulation benchmarks spanning manipulation and locomotion, demonstrating consistent progress and new capabilities.

analysis.key_results: 在物理机器人汉诺塔操作中达到100%成功率；在仿真基准（操作与移动）上比最强世界模型高13.3至85.3个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种潜在反馈运动规划框架VQ-WM，利用向量量化离散潜在状态进行长期搜索，并通过连续视觉反馈控制器可靠执行规划状态，同时引入基于首达时间的准度量来对齐规划抽象与控制器能力。
analysis.method: 离散潜在预测器建模向量量化潜在状态间的转移；规划器通过离散搜索寻找到达目标的最短路径；连续学习控制器通过视觉反馈逐步到达规划状态；向量量化距离采用首达时间的估计器作为准度量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出向量量化世界模型（VQ-WM），将离散长期搜索与连续视觉反馈控制相结合，用于机器人操作中的长期规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法与VLA和WAM直接相关：在汉诺塔任务上，现有最先进的VLA和WAM仅在其训练数据包含解轨迹时成功，而VQ-WM仅使用短时演示数据即可通过组合实现100%成功率，表明它在长期操作规划上优于VLA和WAM，并可能作为世界模型为基础的运动规划器用于机器人操作。

The planner performs discrete search over these vector-quantized states using a discrete latent predictor. A continuous controller then drives the robot toward each planned target in turn, using visual feedback to correct deviations along the way.

papers.abstract: Language-guided video generation often captures scene content while missing the requested motion. We present ViMoLa (Video Motion Language), which predicts a motion prior from language and injects it into a frozen image-to-video backbone. A spatial vector-quantized autoencoder compresses dense trajectories into 64 tokens from a 512-entry codebook; a 28M-parameter transformer predicts the tokens from text; and zero-gated cross-attention adapters condition every frozen Wan~2.2 DiT block through forward hooks. Trained on 462K videos from Something-Something~v2 and Kinetics-400, ViMoLa raises directional accuracy from 0.287 to 0.442 (chance 0.250), with similar measured generative quality. Across-prompt shuffled codes achieve 0.283, supporting the importance of prompt-matched token content. A low-rank adapter reaches 0.428 at 1.45% additional forward-pass FLOPs, and reusing the tokenizer and language model with newly trained CogVideoX adapters raises accuracy from 0.301 to 0.398. Control remains imperfect: oracle codes reach 0.531, compound-motion gains are smaller, and the adapter does not explicitly preserve token-to-patch assignments.

analysis.key_results: 方向准确性从0.287提升至0.442（随机水平0.250），生成质量相似；打乱代码准确率为0.283；低秩适配器在1.45%额外FLOPs下达到0.428；CogVideoX适配器从0.301提升至0.398。
analysis.limitations: 控制仍不完美：oracle代码准确率0.531，复合运动增益较小，且适配器未显式保留令牌到补丁的映射。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个离散运动令牌方案，通过空间向量量化自编码器将运动轨迹压缩为64个令牌，并用28M参数Transformer从文本预测，再通过零门控交叉注意力适配器注入冻结骨干网络，提升视频生成中的运动控制。
analysis.method: 使用空间向量量化自编码器压缩稠密轨迹为64个令牌，28M参数Transformer从文本预测令牌，并通过零门控交叉注意力适配器注入冻结的Wan2.2 DiT块，训练于Something-Something v2和Kinetics-400的462K视频。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ViMoLa，从语言预测离散运动令牌并注入冻结的图像到视频骨干网络，提升运动方向准确性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于视频生成中的运动控制，不涉及机器人VLA或世界动作模型（WAM）；其离散运动令牌和量化思想可能对世界模型中运动表征有一定参考价值，但无直接应用。

For “a bird takes off to the left and flies away from a tree branch,” ViMoLa (left) follows the prompted direction, while the frozen Wan 2.2 baseline (right) moves right and deforms the branch. figures.caption: ViMoLa overview. At inference, a text prompt is encoded by UMT5 and mapped by TextToMotionTransformer to 64 64 discrete motion-token indices over a 512 512 -entry codebook ( Text-to-Motion ). A frozen codebook lookup (SpatialMotionVQVAE) turns these into the 64 64 -patch motion field they encode ( Motion Tokenizer ). A zero-gated cross-attention WanMotionAdapter then injects the motion embeddings into every block of the frozen Wan 2.2 DiT through forward hooks ( Motion Adapter ); block shading and the bar chart show the learned per-block injection strength | tanh ⁡ ( α ) | |\tanh(\alpha)| , which varies across depth. Note the motion field: marker patches point right as prompted while the surrounding scene points left. The decoded grid illustrates the tokenizer representation; the adapter receives its embeddings without explicit patch positions. The frozen DiT then denoises and its VAE decodes the clip ( Output ), here “pushing white book marker left to right” on a held-out SSV2 example. The first frame conditions the backbone, not TextToMotionTransformer. Only the adapters are trained in the final stage.

papers.abstract: Underwater robots support a growing range of work, from inspecting offshore structures and pipelines to surveying reefs and accompanying divers. Most of these tasks, however, are still flown by hand by a pilot, which raises the question of whether they can be carried out autonomously instead. On land, vision-language-action (VLA) models already let robots carry out tasks autonomously from language instructions, which makes them a natural candidate for taking the pilot's place. Underwater, however, there is little data to train such models. We take inspiration from how these tasks are flown today: the pilot watches the camera image and steers with a joystick, whose commands the flight controller turns into motion. We therefore record the pilots and introduce AQUAACT, to our knowledge the first publicly available language-annotated underwater dataset pairing camera images with human joystick commands. It comprises 1.9 hours of real-world and 17.9 hours of simulated demonstrations, both flown by human pilots, together with the vehicle's inertial measurements. Experiments with AQUAACT show that its simulated demonstrations transfer to real data and greatly reduce the real demonstrations a policy needs. A closed-loop benchmark of seven policies in simulation, from imitation-learning baselines to VLA models, each trained with its default recipe, shows that these tasks remain far from solved: no policy completes more than a fifth of the episodes. Pretraining on land data gives large VLA models no advantage over small policies trained from scratch, a gap that land-trained models have yet to close underwater.

analysis.key_results: 模拟演示可迁移至真实数据，显著减少所需的真实演示；在闭环模拟基准中，无策略完成超过五分之一的回合；在陆地数据上预训练的大 VLA 模型相比从零开始训练的小策略没有优势。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 AQUAACT 数据集，这是首个公开可用的语言标注水下数据集，将相机图像与人类操纵杆命令配对，并提供闭环基准以评估七种策略。
analysis.method: 记录人类飞行员的水下遥操作演示，包括真实世界和模拟环境，并结合车辆惯性测量。在模拟中构建闭环基准，训练并比较七种策略（从模仿学习基线到 VLA 模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AQUAACT 是首个公开的语言标注水下数据集，将相机图像与人类操纵杆命令配对，并包含了模拟与真实演示。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接涉及 VLA 模型在水下机器人环境中的应用与评估，核心贡献是构建语言标注的水下数据集并基准测试 VLA 与模仿学习策略，与 VLA 主题高度相关，且数据集和基准可直接服务于水下 VLA 的研究。

papers.abstract: Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score the most recent tool steps in a single forward pass, and a threshold calibrated on successful runs turns that score into an abort decision without changing the executor. Trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and a SWE-bench Pro subset with GPT and Claude executors, StopLoss is compared against six general-purpose judges reading identical windows. Outcome supervision lifts failure prediction from near chance to a useful signal at the first check, at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost per check than any tested judge. This translates into savings: relative to completing every task, StopLoss lowers cost per retained solve by 4.5\% on Verified while preserving 99\% of successful runs, and by up to 31\% on the costlier Pro subset, reaching 48\% with a Qwen3-8B backbone, and in all four settings its cost per retained solve is below that of every judge policy. Outcome-trained small monitors can make failure recognition cheap enough for early stopping to pay for itself.

analysis.key_results: 在SWE-bench Verified上，StopLoss将每次保留成功解的成本降低4.5%，同时保留99%的成功运行；在SWE-bench Pro子集上最多降低31%，使用Qwen3-8B骨干可达48%；在所有设置中，其每次保留成功解的成本均低于所有对比的裁判策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入一个轻量级的外部监控器StopLoss，利用轨迹结果监督训练小型语言模型来预测失败，并通过校准阈值提前终止可能失败的运行，以最小开销实现资源节省。
analysis.method: 利用已完成轨迹的最终结果对早期局部窗口进行标注，训练一个小型语言模型对最近工具步骤进行单次前向评分，并用成功运行校准的阈值将评分转换为中止决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: StopLoss是一个小型外部监控器，通过从已完成轨迹和验证结果中学习失败识别，在运行可能失败时提前终止，从而节省资源。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文的核心是独立的高效推理方法（提前停止/推测性解码思想），不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人世界模型。但StopLoss作为一种低成本推理监控与提前终止方案，可为机器人策略推理中的成本控制提供方法借鉴。

papers.title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
papers.title_zh: StopLoss：教智能体预测失败并提前停止

papers.abstract: Post-training compression of pretrained medical segmentation models commonly uses quantization, pruning, or distillation to reduce model size and computational cost. Existing medical segmentation quantization studies mainly evaluate Dice, model size, memory, and latency, but this is incomplete for safety-critical use because compressed models should also preserve uncertainty signals that indicate unreliable predictions. We study this problem in compressed MRI/CT segmentation and formalize why Dice can remain stable while uncertainty changes. Motivated by this failure mode, we propose score-guided aggregate-validated mixed precision (SGAV-MP), a post-training compression framework that selects layer precisions under reliability constraints. SGAV-MP ranks quantization actions with a compact benefit-risk score and accepts them only after full-model reliability validation on a calibration set. Across five 2D backbones and three 3D benchmarks, SGAV-MP preserves FP32-level Dice and high uncertainty-map agreement, achieving $3.59\times$--$7.8\times$ compression in 2D and $4.73\times$--$7.82\times$ in 3D. We also report backend-supported TensorRT deployment measurements separately to distinguish runtime execution from reliability-preserving storage compression.

analysis.key_results: 在五个 2D 骨干网络和三个 3D 基准上，SGAV-MP 保持 FP32 级 Dice 和高不确定性图一致性，实现 2D 3.59×–7.8× 压缩和 3D 4.73×–7.82× 压缩。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SGAV-MP 后训练压缩框架，在可靠性约束下选择层精度，从而在保持 FP32 级 Dice 和不确定性图一致性的同时实现高压缩比。
analysis.method: score-guided aggregate-validated mixed precision (SGAV-MP)，使用紧凑的收益-风险分数对量化动作排序，并在校准集上进行全模型可靠性验证后接受。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 在医学图像分割的后训练压缩中，提出一种在可靠性约束下选择层精度的混合精度量化框架，以保持分割精度和不确定性信号。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究聚焦医学图像分割的模型量化与可靠性保持，不涉及 VLA、机器人世界模型或机器人动作预测；与本站主题无直接关系，但其可靠性约束的混合精度量化方法对高效部署的推理优化有一定参考价值。

SGAV-MP improves compression beyond INT8 while preserving uncertainty correlation, whereas INT4 degrades it. The broken y-axis shows both INT4 and the SGAV-MP frontier.

papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation with dexterous hands has attracted growing attention in research on robotic action models. However, few studies have developed benchmarks specifically tailored for dexterous manipulation, leaving the dexterous manipulation capabilities of existing models insufficiently characterized. In this paper, we present BiDex-100, a simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation that combines broad task coverage, multi-dimensional evaluation, and high-DoF hand embodiments. Concretely, the benchmark comprises 106 tasks organized along five capability axes: generalization, instruction following, limited demonstrations, long horizon, and memory. Each task is paired with an out-of-domain variant featuring controlled visual and spatial changes, allowing systematic assessment of robustness. In addition, the benchmark supports two embodiments and provides 8,080 success-validated teleoperated demonstrations, totaling 6.25 million frames. We evaluate seven recent Vision-Language-Action models under a unified protocol, establishing baselines for capability-specific performance, robustness, and data efficiency. The website is available at https://BiDex-100.github.io/BiDex-100/.

analysis.key_results: 在统一协议下评估了七个最近的视觉-语言-动作模型，建立了能力特定性能、鲁棒性和数据效率的基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BiDex-100基准，结合广泛任务覆盖、多维度评估和高自由度手部形态，为双臂灵巧操作提供系统评估平台。
analysis.method: 构建106个任务，沿泛化、指令跟随、有限演示、长时程和记忆五个能力轴组织，每个任务配有域外变体，并提供8080条遥操作演示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: BiDex-100是一个包含106项任务、两种高自由度灵巧手、8080条演示的双臂灵巧操作仿真基准，并系统评估了现有视觉-语言-动作模型的能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接服务于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的评估，属于机器人动作模型与仿真评估领域，与本站主题高度相关，但不涉及世界模型或高效推理技术。

papers.title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
papers.title_zh: BiDex-100：涵盖100+仿真任务的双臂灵巧操作综合基准

papers.abstract: Shared autonomy is a control paradigm that combines human cognitive abilities with robot precision to enable effective remote manipulation in complex environments. A key challenge is how to adapt the level of autonomy using information extracted from the human, task, and/or environment. In this paper, we propose a novel arbitration strategy that dynamically adjusts the level of autonomy in the system using the entropy of a belief distribution derived from a multimodal intent inference. Human intent is modeled with a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN), which updates beliefs over goals given real-time operator gaze data and robot arm motion during teleoperation. We then formulate the blending of human input and autonomous control as a Model Predictive Control (MPC) problem, where the system's autonomous behavior is guided by the belief distribution. This approach enables continuous, gradual transitions across the full spectrum of autonomy levels, from direct teleoperation to full autonomy. To validate our approach, we conducted experiments to compare the performance of our proposed algorithm against two MPC-based shared autonomy methods. Compared to the baselines, our approach achieved reductions of at least 61% in object retrieval time, 44% in trajectory length, and 60% in human control input. Participants reported high perceived control, predictability, intent recognition, and responsiveness, along with low workload.

analysis.key_results: 与两个基于MPC的共享自治基线相比，对象检索时间减少至少61%，轨迹长度减少44%，人类控制输入减少60%；用户报告高感知控制、可预测性、意图识别和响应性，以及低工作负载。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新颖的仲裁策略，利用多模态意图推断得到的信念分布熵动态调整自治程度，并通过模型预测控制实现从直接遥操作到完全自治的连续渐变过渡。
analysis.method: 使用动态贝叶斯网络（DBN）对人类意图建模，结合实时眼动数据和机器人手臂运动更新目标信念；将人类输入与自主控制的混合形式化为模型预测控制（MPC）问题。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于多模态意图推断的共享自治策略，利用动态贝叶斯网络更新目标信念，并通过模型预测控制动态调整自治程度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于共享自治与意图推断在机器人操作中的应用，与视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界模型（WAM）的直接关联较弱。但其意图建模与动态调整自治程度的思想对未来VLA/WAM在共享自治中的集成具有潜在的方法论价值。
