papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant scalability challenges in long-video understanding due to quadratic attention complexity and context window constraints. Existing retrieval-based approaches typically rely on supervised learning from static keyframe annotations. However, these label priors often fail to align with the actual information required by downstream MLLMs for complex reasoning, creating a misalignment between the training target and inference needs. To bridge this gap, we propose a probabilistic framework that reformulates frame selection as latent-variable inference. We first initialize a lightweight policy using supervised learning to capture general visual saliency. Then, we treat a frozen MLLM as a task environment and use its answer likelihood as dense task evidence to refine the policy via Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Within this formulation, the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over ground-truth answer tokens provides a principled dense reward, while a prior-matching KL term preserves semantic consistency with the elicited label prior. This process transitions the selection principle from static label priors to task evidence. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that our selector achieves competitive accuracy with MLLM-based scorers while retaining the inference efficiency of lightweight methods. The selector is trained once with a frozen MLLM environment and transfers directly to multiple downstream MLLMs without retraining. Code is available at \url{github.com/Miraclecsc/Frame_Selection_GRPO}.

analysis.key_results: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench数据集上，所提选择器达到与基于MLLM的评分器相当的精度，同时保留轻量方法的推理效率；训练一次后可直接迁移到多个下游MLLM而无需重新训练。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种概率框架，将帧选择重新定义为潜变量推断，通过贝叶斯GRPO使用冻结MLLM的任务证据（答案似然）优化轻量策略，弥合训练目标与推理需求之间的不一致。
analysis.method: 先用监督学习初始化轻量策略捕捉视觉显著性；再将冻结MLLM视为任务环境，利用其答案似然作为稠密证据，通过贝叶斯组相对策略优化（GRPO）细化策略；其中负对数似然提供稠密奖励，先验匹配KL项保持语义一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种基于贝叶斯GRPO的概率框架，将长视频理解的帧选择从静态标签先验转向任务证据，在保持轻量级效率的同时达到与MLLM评分器相当的精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于多模态大模型长视频理解的高效帧选择，未直接涉及VLA或世界模型；但与本站主题相关的价值在于其探索了基于冻结大模型反馈的策略优化方法，可为机器人策略学习中样本/帧的高效选择提供借鉴。

figures.caption: The overall framework of our methods. (a) Keyframe Selector. The lightweight selector ( f θ f_{\theta} ) comprises stacked Video-Text Fusion Transformers. It modulates frame features with query semantics to output importance logits, then parameterizing a Plackett-Luce distribution. (b) Stage I: Label Prior Elicitation. We utilize keyframe label annotations to construct a Label Prior . The selector is trained via pairwise ranking loss to align its predicted logits with the label logits, establishing a robust initialization. (c) Stage II:Task-Evidence Posterior Inference. We freeze the MLLM and treat it as a frozen task environment. The selector performs Group Sampling to propose discrete frame subsets ( 𝐳 \mathbf{z} ). The MLLM evaluates these subsets to provide dense NLL rewards ( R R ) and advantages ( A A ). The policy is refined via Bayesian GRPO to maximize task evidence while maintaining KL-regularization towards the label prior.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: World models offer increasingly rich environments for exploration, yet intervening in a world while observing the consequences from freely chosen viewpoints remains challenging. We tackle these challenges by introducing UniState, a framework for controllable world simulation built on a unified world-state representation. This representation unifies spatial memory and user interventions. Users specify object motion directly within spatial memory, while independently choosing the camera trajectory from which the resulting world state is observed. This unification makes the relationship between the scene and the requested changes explicit, removing ambiguity between object motion and viewpoint change from the control specification. Crucially, specifying an intervention does not require prescribing every resulting movement: the video model can synthesize additional motion within controlled objects and plausible interactions with their surroundings. We develop training and sampling strategies that help generated videos follow the specified object motion and camera trajectory while preserving this capacity to generate responses beyond the prescribed transformations. Experiments demonstrate more accurate joint object and camera control than the existing methods, alongside qualitative evidence that intervention-induced scene changes persist across rollouts.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明，与现有方法相比，在联合物体和相机控制方面更准确，并有定性证据显示干预引起的场景变化在后续rollout中持续存在。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出统一世界状态表示，将空间记忆与用户干预结合，实现可控世界模拟，支持独立控制物体运动和相机轨迹。
analysis.method: 基于统一世界状态表示，将物体运动直接嵌入空间记忆，允许独立选择相机轨迹，并通过训练和采样策略使生成视频遵循指定物体运动和相机轨迹，同时保留生成额外合理运动的能力。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: UniState提出一个统一世界状态表示与干预机制的可控世界模拟框架，可独立指定物体运动和相机轨迹，生成符合干预且能自然演化的视频。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于世界模型（World Model）方向，提出可控世界模拟框架，可生成物体运动和相机视角可控的视频。与VLA/WAM主题直接相关，可为机器人世界建模和策略学习提供可控模拟环境。

papers.abstract: Onboard inference latency creates a mismatch between the trajectories predicted by vision-language-action (VLA) policies and the ongoing motion of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). We present AeroDASH, an asynchronous VLA framework for continuous language-conditioned flight. A B-spline policy is initialized through supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations, providing continuous trajectory references in position and yaw. During execution, trajectory fusion removes the expired prediction prefix and connects the remaining segment to the active reference with derivative continuity while limiting trajectory deformation. To account for deviations induced by asynchronous execution, execution-aware group relative policy optimization (GRPO) further adapts the policy using trajectory-level rewards. On the UAV-Flow test set, AeroDASH achieves a success rate of 76.56%, exceeding OpenVLA-UAV and AeroDASH w/o GRPO by 38.1 and 20.1 percentage points, respectively. Execution experiments show that AeroDASH sustains motion during inference and reduces acceleration, jerk, and speed fluctuations relative to asynchronous tracking of waypoint sequences. We further demonstrate language-conditioned flight with onboard inference and asynchronous trajectory execution. The code will be released upon acceptance.

analysis.key_results: 在UAV-Flow测试集上成功率达76.56%，超过OpenVLA-UAV和AeroDASH w/o GRPO分别38.1和20.1个百分点；执行实验显示降低加速度、加加速度和速度波动。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AeroDASH框架，集成了B样条策略监督微调、在线轨迹融合与执行感知GRPO，解决VLA策略预测与无人机运动之间的延迟不匹配。
analysis.method: 使用专家演示监督微调初始化B样条策略；执行时采用轨迹融合移除过期前缀并以导数连续性连接剩余段；利用执行感知的组相对策略优化（GRPO）调整策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AeroDASH提出一种异步VLA框架，通过B样条策略和轨迹融合克服机载推理延迟，实现连续语言条件无人机飞行。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA在无人机上的部署，解决推理延迟导致的轨迹错位问题，对VLA在实际机器人系统中的异步执行具有重要参考价值。

papers.abstract: For practical motion generation, it is essential to handle multimodality (multiple actions can be correct for the same observation) while maintaining low inference cost and strong generalization from limited demonstrations. We introduce an attentive mixture-density policy trained with the Energy Score that represents future visuomotor trajectories as explicit probability distributions with a single forward pass. Concretely, we output Gaussian mixture parameters for joint commands (and optionally attention points) and optimize them with the Energy Score (computed as a sum of 1D CRPS under a diagonal covariance assumption) instead of the negative log-likelihood (NLL) to avoid MDN singularities and gradient-scale instabilities. Our architecture couples explicit spatial attention with mixture-density outputs, enabling robust multimodal behavior selection under visual noise and small-data regimes. On an 8-DOF manipulator, the method generates distinct avoidance trajectories and stabilizes learning in obstacle avoidance. Moreover, in a randomized moving-object grasping task, where spatiotemporal multimodality and fast timing decisions are required, the proposed model outperforms Diffusion Policy by 15-25% under several unseen conditions, demonstrating superior generalization and real-time feasibility.

analysis.key_results: 在8自由度机械臂上生成不同的避障轨迹并稳定学习；在随机移动物体抓取任务中，在多种未见条件下比扩散策略性能高15-25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入一种用能量分数稳定的注意力混合密度策略，将未来视觉运动轨迹表示为显式概率分布，单次前向传播即可生成多模态输出，并能从有限演示中实现强泛化。
analysis.method: 输出关节指令的高斯混合参数（可选注意力点），并使用能量分数（对角协方差假设下的一维CRPS之和）优化，避免负对数似然的奇异性和梯度不稳定性；架构显式结合空间注意力与混合密度输出。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种使用能量分数训练的注意力混合密度策略，通过单次前向传播输出多模态轨迹分布，在低推理成本下实现机器人运动的鲁棒多模态行为选择。

papers.abstract: World models are increasingly judged by how well they rank plausible futures, yet plausibility alone is the wrong target. The same scene can evolve under many latent rules, and a future that is smooth and physically valid under one rule can be incoherent under the rule actually in force. We formalize the resulting failure, operator-blindness, and show that it is systematically hidden by standard evaluation: a scorer can attain near-perfect generic ranking while separating current-world from other-world futures no better than chance. We introduce Operator-Mismatch Contrastive (OMC) learning, whose semantic hard negatives are valid-but-wrong-operator trajectories, and a matching protocol that measures world-relative coherence directly. On a controlled synthetic benchmark with in- and out-of-distribution operator parameters, across two trajectory-scoring backbones, and on feature-level external validation with CoPhy ballsCF, OMC raises operator-sensitive scoring far above a chance baseline that nonetheless achieves 0.99 generic top-1. We prove that the wrong-operator negative is necessary both for the protocol to detect the failure and for the objective to fix it, and position OMC as an auxiliary coherence signal (a trajectory-coherence scorer, not a generative model, planner, or control agent) that can be attached to existing world-model representations.

analysis.key_results: 在受控合成基准（分布内和分布外算子参数）和CoPhy ballsCF特征级外部验证中，OMC大幅提升算子敏感评分，远超仍能达到0.99通用Top-1的随机基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 形式化“算子盲区”问题，并提出算子不匹配对比学习（OMC）以及直接衡量世界相对一致性的评估协议。
analysis.method: 算子不匹配对比学习（OMC），使用“有效但算子错误”的轨迹作为语义硬负样本，并配套世界相对一致性评估协议；在合成基准和CoPhy ballsCF上进行验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文揭示世界模型的算子盲区问题并提出算子不匹配对比学习，以世界相对一致性来评估未来轨迹。

papers.abstract: Emerging Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are moving beyond representation learning towards latent world models that support prediction, planning, and control. Yet their latent worlds naturally lack a human-interpretable interface. In this Perspective, we argue that as JEPA latents become internal states for prediction and action, interpretability must move beyond what they encode to how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction. To this end, we envision a four-stage research agenda, involving Ground, Structure, Verify, and Act, to guide this shift toward actionable latent-world understanding. Within our framework, existing JEPA interpretability efforts provide early evidence for Ground, while systematic analysis of latent structure, causal verification, and intervention remains largely unexplored. Overall, this Perspective aims to call for a broader latent-world interpretability agenda that shifts attention from decoding representations toward understanding, validating, and acting on latent worlds.

papers.abstract: General purpose multimodal language models (LMs) are increasingly capable of directly controlling robotic arms (e.g., by commanding end effector poses) to manipulate their environment. Tracking the development of these capabilities is important for understanding their potential benefits, such as improving industrial automation, and risks, such as enabling malicious users to produce dangerous chemical or biological agents. To this end, we investigate the ability of frontier multimodal LMs to directly control physical robotic arms. We evaluate seven models at multiple reasoning-effort settings on six manipulation tasks taken from the RoboDojo benchmark. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic comparison of a broad range of frontier LMs across a common suite of manipulation tasks on physical hardware. We find that current frontier models can directly control real robotic arms to perform a variety of manipulation tasks but are not yet precise or efficient enough to complete them within a practical action budget. However, these capabilities are improving rapidly: performance increases on our benchmark between July and September 2026 (inclusive) correspond to a performance doubling time of 44.5 days, while the best recorded execution rate increased by a factor of 4.4 and the lowest recorded execution cost fell by a factor of 6.2. These trends raise the possibility that the Bitter Lesson is coming to robotics; the capabilities of embodied general purpose LMs may one day be comparable to those of more specialized models.

analysis.key_results: 当前前沿模型能够直接控制真实机械臂完成多种操作任务，但在实际动作预算内尚不够精确或高效；2026年7月至9月间性能翻倍时间为44.5天，最佳执行速率提高4.4倍，最低执行成本降低6.2倍。

papers.abstract: The success of chain-of-thought (CoT) in complex reasoning can be attributed to a textual scaffolding effect: explicit intermediate results can be examined, reused, and composed to support subsequent reasoning, much as scaffolding supports a building under construction. However, mainstream multimodal LLMs lack an equivalent scaffold for visual distinctions that are difficult to express in concise verbal descriptions. We therefore ask: Can native visual representations become first-class citizens alongside language, providing a visual scaffold for reasoning? We define native multimodal reasoning as reasoning in which native visual representations and language jointly carry reusable intermediate states. As a concrete implementation, the visual scaffolding mechanism we proposed lets the MLLM autonomously initiate a retrieval action at any reasoning step. A lightweight retriever selects native visual features, which are then incorporated directly into the evolving CoT and remain available to subsequent steps. To evaluate this mechanism under controlled visual demands, we introduce NMR-Bench, comprising Burden Counting and Path Tracing. With 88M added parameters (approximately 2%) on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking, our model achieves 66.43% and 72.50% accuracy, respectively, surpassing the evaluated GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro baselines. Controlled interventions show that changing selected visual content affects task accuracy and can redirect subsequent visual selection even when intervening text is held fixed. These findings show that native visual states can function as intermediate reasoning material and point toward reusable scaffolds for additional modalities.

analysis.key_results: 在NMR-Bench的Burden Counting和Path Tracing任务上分别取得66.43%和72.50%的准确率，超过GPT-5.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro基线；干预实验表明视觉内容改变会影响任务准确率和后续视觉选择。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出视觉脚手架机制，允许MLLM在推理任意步骤自主发起检索，将轻量检索器选择的原生视觉特征融入思维链，并引入NMR-Bench基准进行评测。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出视觉脚手架机制，使多模态大模型在思维链推理中检索并复用原生视觉特征，并构建NMR-Bench基准进行评估。

papers.abstract: Vision-language navigation is moving into photorealistic, physically simulated scenes, where the leading zero-shot agents put a vision-language model in the control loop to choose every move and stop. Robots favour small models, whose abilities are uneven: Qwen3-VL-4B can judge whether a single view looks like the goal, but its route reasoning is at chance, its distance estimates nearly constant, its stop votes unreliable. Our agent therefore asks it two perceptual questions per step, which direction looks like the goal and whether the view justifies stopping, plus one gated frontier query on route-bearing instructions, and treats the answers as evidence, not actions: a route-blind semantic field over a bird's-eye map accumulates the directional scores through a tempered update, a skeleton graph supplies frontiers and geodesic distances, and a two-stage terminator turns stop votes into termini through a trail-consistency gate and a budget-forced return. With every baseline re-run in one installation at one budget, the agent exceeds all four zero-shot baselines of the VLNVerse subset in mean success on both granularities, though the paired interval against the strongest coarse-grained baseline includes zero. Termination is the dominant lever in ablation, thirteen attempts to give the model more of the navigation establish no reliable gain, and the agent runs on a Unitree Go2 quadruped with off-board inference. Code, per-episode logs and a robot video will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/structure-over-reasoning-PAGE.

analysis.key_results: 在VLNVerse子集上超过全部四个零样本基线（两种粒度），并在Unitree Go2四足机器人上实现真实世界运行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于小型视觉语言模型（Qwen3-VL-4B）的零样本导航智能体，通过结构化的证据积累（路线盲语义场、骨架图、两阶段终止器）克服小模型的推理能力不足，实现优于基准的导航性能。
analysis.method: 每步向视觉语言模型提出两个感知问题（方向判断与停止判断）及一个门控前沿查询，将回答作为证据积累到鸟瞰图上，利用骨架图和两阶段终止器进行决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种零样本视觉语言导航智能体，通过向小型视觉语言模型提出感知问题并将回答作为证据而非动作，实现了在真实机器人上的导航。

papers.abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $\pi_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上，VLA-Rolling在所有16个模型-基准组合中降低了动作块推理成本，最高加速1.48倍；在14个组合中提高了成功率，最高提升15.08个百分点。

analysis.method: 三阶段轻量推理：动作尾部继承、逐动作置信度估计、置信度引导的重噪与去噪预算分配，底层VLA模型保持冻结。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VLA-Rolling提出一种轻量推理框架，通过继承未执行的动作尾部并自适应分配去噪预算，在冻结VLA模型的前提下同时提升推理效率和任务成功率。

papers.abstract: The throughput gains of speculative decoding depend on the trade-off between acceptance length and execution latency. We ask when additional acceptance is worth the cost of obtaining it. We establish a comparison protocol spanning training, inference, and evaluation, remeasuring released checkpoints and retraining six drafter recipes on shared target-generated data across ten benchmarks and two target models. Alignment changes the picture: gaps that appear large in published comparisons shrink substantially under shared training and inference conditions. This narrowing motivates two deeper questions: how is acceptance improved at different costs, and when do these gains improve throughput? We find that acceptance can be improved through nearly free objective and context changes or more expensive token-to-token conditioning. DCore illustrates the former route as a strong baseline with little additional measured drafting overhead. The payoff is conditional: task uncertainty and serving conditions affect acceptance returns, execution costs, and the preferred drafter and budget. These findings inform future drafter design and deployment choices.

analysis.key_results: 对齐后差距大幅缩小；接受率可通过低成本的DCore方法提升；吞吐量收益受任务不确定性和服务条件影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 建立跨训练、推理和评估的比较协议，重新测量已发布检查点并在共享目标生成数据上重训六种草稿模型，揭示对齐条件后原本较大的性能差距显著缩小，并提出DCore作为低成本强基线。

papers.abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

analysis.key_results: 在同规模模型中（Gemma4-31B、Qwen3.6-27B）在工具使用、多步规划和智能体任务完成上取得最先进性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并开源Muse Glimmer 30B模型，以约4-bit量化实现单GPU高效推理，在工具使用、多步规划和智能体任务完成等基准上达到同规模最优。
analysis.method: 训练一个带感知编码器的30B因果语言模型，接受文本和图像输入，集成多步推理、可靠工具使用和失败恢复，并量化为约4-bit精度以支持本地部署。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入开源30B参数因果语言模型Muse Glimmer，集成感知编码器、4-bit量化与多步推理、工具使用和失败恢复能力，面向消费级硬件上的自主智能体任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是独立的高效推理工作，通过4-bit量化在消费级硬件上部署大规模语言模型，未直接涉及VLA或世界模型；但量化技术对VLA/WAM的端侧部署具有方法借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. Finally, the use of human-interpretable reverse-geocoded strings and residual-quantized semantic IDs provides a more interpretable representation of geographic location than existing approaches. Code and model weights to be released soon.

analysis.key_results: 方法在多个下游任务上一致提升现有位置编码器性能，且RevGeoRQ进一步超越当代位置编码器。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并设计了RevGeoRQ架构，同时使用残差量化语义ID提供可解释的地理表示。
analysis.method: 使用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号，应用于现有位置编码器架构；提出RevGeoRQ自定义架构，采用残差量化语义ID表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并引入RevGeoRQ架构及残差量化语义ID表示。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究地理位置编码器，采用残差量化技术，与本站VLA/WAM主题无直接关系；但残差量化语义ID表示对量化方法在空间表示学习中的应用具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, gives the agent a thin harness: one command line that turns its commands into robot motion and makes no decisions of its own. On the robot, the agent keeps doing what it does best: it reads output, writes code and runs tests. Two agents of the same model share the work. An acting agent runs each episode. After a failure, an optimizer agent reads the full record of the episode, with every command, image and message, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools, each with its own tests. What the agents learn stays as code, and no demonstrations or training are needed. At run time, the tools use only what a real robot also has: RGB images, camera calibration and the state of the arms. They find objects by triangulation between camera views. Because these inputs are the same in simulation and on hardware, the tools move to a real robot with a different arm after only a small change for the arm. We build the tools on ten layouts of one seed per task with Codex and GPT-6-Astra and freeze them; the eight Open tasks share one set of tools. In RoboDojo's official evaluation on a hidden seed, 50 episodes for each of the 42 tasks, HexaShell reaches 46.9% success and a progress score of 53.2, the state of the art on the official RoboDojo leaderboard. The limit is contact, not reasoning: memory tasks reach 81.0%, but precision tasks only 32.0%. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo官方评测中，42个任务各50轮，达到46.9%成功率和53.2进度分，为官方排行榜最优；记忆类任务成功率81.0%，精密类任务仅32.0%。
analysis.limitations: 性能瓶颈在接触操作而非推理；精密操作任务成功率较低（32.0%）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HexaShell，一个将VLM转用于机器人控制的薄型接口，通过让代理编写代码工具实现跨仿真到真机的泛化，并在RoboDojo基准上取得最优成绩。
analysis.method: 使用两个VLM代理分工：一个执行，一个优化；代理通过命令行接口控制机器人，通过三角测量定位物体，并编写带测试的工具；工具在仿真和硬件上共享，迁移到不同机械臂只需小改。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出HexaShell，一个薄型接口，让VLM代理直接控制机器人并通过角色分工和工具学习在仿真与真实间迁移，在RoboDojo排行榜上取得最优成绩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接面向VLA（视觉-语言-动作）智能体在真实机器人操作中的应用，提出以代码作为策略表示的新方法；虽然不显式构建世界模型或动作世界模型，但其工具学习和跨仿真-真实迁移的方法对机器人学习策略有直接价值，可视为一种替代传统VLA行为克隆的途径。

papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) have expanded the manipulation and whole body capabilities of individual robots. Yet a single robot remains limited by its embodiment, and many real world tasks require capabilities that can only emerge through cooperation. Existing multi robot frameworks largely emphasize task decomposition, allocation, and replanning, while providing limited support for adapting executable coordination when physical execution deviates from the intended behavior. We present CoEvolve, a framework that represents team coordination as executable code over fixed robot motor skills. CoEvolve introduces Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution, where a multimodal foundation model instantiates coordination strategies through motion primitives, semantic objectives, temporary robot roles, and bounded execution parameters. Physical verification evaluates each executed transition, rejected behaviors trigger structured coordination revision from an accepted checkpoint, and verified experience is retained to guide subsequent decisions. We evaluate CoEvolve with two simulated Unitree G1 humanoids transporting a freely supported rigid payload through constrained corridors. Across 15 base task runs with three multimodal backbone families, CoEvolve completes 8 tasks, with every backbone achieving end to end success. Additional evaluations yield verified placement on two additional corridor layouts and after both same-backbone and cross-backbone experience initialization, while exposing persistent limitations in motion precision and contact stability. These results support executable coordination as a practical interface for adapting long horizon multi robot collaboration under shared physical constraints.

analysis.key_results: 在15个基础任务中完成8个，所有三种多模态骨干均实现端到端成功；在两种新走廊布局上验证了放置，并展示了同骨干和跨骨干经验初始化的有效性。
analysis.limitations: 运动精度和接触稳定性方面存在持续局限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种将团队协调表示为可执行代码的框架，并引入验证引导的协调进化机制，使多机器人系统能够在物理约束下自进化协调策略。
analysis.method: Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution，通过多模态基础模型实例化运动原语、语义目标、临时角色和有界执行参数，结合物理验证与结构化修订。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoEvolve通过可执行代码协调多机器人团队，并利用验证引导的进化框架适应物理执行偏差。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接利用VLA模型的能力来生成和演进化人形机器人的协调代码策略，将VLA与多机器人协作执行相集成，与机器人动作生成和策略学习高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn a wide range of robotic skills, but combining separately trained skills remains challenging. The original training data may be unavailable for joint retraining, while directly merging model weights can cause interference. We propose NestedVLA, which consolidates independently fine-tuned VLA policies without access to their original training data. Instead of merging all updates into one checkpoint, a hypernetwork embedded in the VLA generates action-expert weight updates for a selected task. Each task's compressed vision-language model update is stored separately, and both updates are added to a frozen base VLA to instantiate the corresponding policy. We evaluate NestedVLA by consolidating three policies fine-tuned with reinforcement learning on MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and CALVIN. It achieves 66.7% average success, improving on the strongest model-merging baseline by 41.1 percentage points. It performs within 1 percentage point of per-task fine-tuning on ManiSkill and substantially narrows the gap on CALVIN. In this three-policy setting, total storage is 1.5x that of a single full checkpoint. Code is available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在MetaWorld、ManiSkill和CALVIN上整合三个强化学习微调策略，平均成功率66.7%，比最强模型合并基线提高41.1个百分点；在ManiSkill上性能与单任务微调相差1个百分点以内，在CALVIN上大幅缩小差距；三策略设置下总存储是单个完整检查点的1.5倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NestedVLA，一种无需原始训练数据即可整合独立微调VLA策略的方法，通过超网络为选定任务生成动作专家更新，并将压缩的视觉-语言模型更新分开存储。
analysis.method: 在冻结的基础VLA上嵌入超网络，为选定任务生成动作专家权重更新；每个任务的压缩VLM更新单独存储，并与基础模型相结合实现策略实例化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: NestedVLA通过超网络生成动作专家权重更新，将独立微调的VLA策略整合到一个框架中，无需访问原始训练数据。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦VLA模型，解决多技能策略整合问题，核心贡献在于无需原始数据的技能融合与生成机制，对VLA在机器人技能学习中的实用化有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models' real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. These findings suggest directions for improving real-time multimodal agents, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.

analysis.key_results: 在Wall Clock下最佳成功率为44%，最佳Pass^3为36%；时间成本限制成功率，更高的推理努力在时间压力下效果混合。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Realtime-Bench基准，通过Wall Clock、Paused Clock和Token Clock三种时钟协议，系统评估模型在实时交互中延迟对任务成功的影响。
analysis.method: 构建动态任务套件，对比Wall Clock（真实推理延迟）、Paused Clock（理想无延迟）和Token Clock（按生成token推进模拟时间）下的智能体表现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入Realtime-Bench，一个评估实时多模态智能体在动态环境中及时行动能力的基准测试。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于实时交互中的推理延迟与时间约束，对VLA/WAM系统在真实机器人场景中的实时决策效率具有间接参考价值，但并非直接针对VLA或WAM。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models present a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation, but closed-loop deployment is often limited by inference efficiency: at each timestep, high-resolution, often multi-view images are encoded into hundreds of visual tokens that dominate transformer computation and latency. Token compression via attention is a natural solution but is challenging for VLA control because (1) decision-critical tokens are determined by the task, not generic visual saliency, and (2) the token budget varies substantially across steps, so static metrics and budgets waste computation or discard control-critical tokens. We introduce FastVLA, a training-free, task-aware, and temporally adaptive visual token compression framework. At each step, FastVLA scores token importance via task-to-vision attention and adaptively sets the compression rate from the importance-distribution uniformity, measured by an inverse-Simpson metric with online sliding-window calibration. We evaluate FastVLA on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and CogACT across LIBERO and SIMPLER, and on a physical Franka Research 3 robot. In simulation, it reduces LLM-backbone FLOPs by 35-59\% and action latency by 9-32\% (a 1.09$\times$-1.46$\times$ speedup) while maintaining task success, achieving a comparable or better efficiency-performance trade-off than existing plug-and-play token compression/pruning/reuse baselines. On the real robot, it cuts action-prediction latency by 20\% (1.25$\times$ speedup) at comparable success. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/FastVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 和 SIMPLER 仿真中，LLM 主干 FLOPs 降低 35-59%，动作延迟降低 9-32%（1.09-1.46 倍加速），成功率保持；在 Franka Research 3 真机上，动作预测延迟降低 20%（1.25 倍加速），成功率相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 FastVLA，一个训练无关、任务感知、时间自适应的视觉 token 压缩框架，通过任务到视觉注意力打分与基于逆辛普森指标的在线滑动窗口校准，动态设置压缩率，提升 VLA 模型闭环部署的推理效率。
analysis.method: 任务到视觉注意力打分评估 token 重要性；逆辛普森指标衡量重要性分布均匀性；在线滑动窗口校准自适应设定每步压缩率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FastVLA 提出一种无需训练、任务感知且时间自适应的视觉标记压缩框架，在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低 VLA 模型的推理延迟和计算量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型（OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、CogACT）的推理效率问题，提出视觉 token 压缩方法，属于 VLA 推理加速的专门优化，与本站 VLA 主题高度相关，不直接涉及 WAM。

papers.abstract: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.

analysis.key_results: 在六个3D基准上平均准确率53.2%，比基础Qwen模型提升22.0%，超越Gemini 3.6 Flash，相比现有开源3D方法使用少50-70%的输入帧，并在未见领域平均提升5.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ACT3D模型，通过强化学习使视觉语言模型学会主动探索3D环境，无需多视图或3D表示，并基于最终答案正确性塑造探索策略。
analysis.method: 初始轨迹监督微调后使用强化学习，奖励主要由最终答案正确性驱动，模型通过迭代推理、导航和视点重定向来交互式探索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过仅使用单张图像输入，让视觉语言模型在与3D环境交互中学习思考和主动探索，从而提升视觉问答的准确性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究视觉语言模型在3D环境中的主动探索和策略学习，对世界模型和机器人学习中关于环境交互与信息获取的策略有价值，但与机器人动作预测或世界动作模型无直接关联。

papers.abstract: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which runs the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head on the device to build a deep chain and uses one SLM pass to add alternative branches. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An {\epsilon}-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three runs of each system on Spec-Bench show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-{\epsilon}. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

analysis.key_results: 在Galaxy S26 Ultra上，相比服务器端MTP自推测，HyCo在Spec-Bench上减少38.6%的GPU时间，在32K摘要上减少29.2%；与SLM-only草稿相比，节省多9.0个百分点，交付速度1.9倍；与Cloud+MTP的裁判评分差为+0.2（95% CI: -0.9至+1.3）；无松弛时节省分别为27.7%和11.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HyCo混合草稿生成框架，利用设备上的服务器模型MTP头与小型语言模型协同构建深层草稿树，减少移动NPU上的重复推理，提高推测解码效率。
analysis.method: 服务器返回隐藏状态、输入嵌入和键值对以支持设备端MTP头；使用量化、受限词汇表和1K令牌窗口适配移动NPU；引入ε阈值规则放宽对验证器采样分布的精确保持。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HyCo通过将服务器模型的多令牌预测头部署到设备端并结合小型语言模型单次推理，实现移动-云推测解码的深度链与分支构建，从而降低服务器计算成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于通用推测解码的效率优化，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但与本站关注的模型效率主题（推测解码、量化）有交集，可为其在机器人推理中的潜在应用提供方法参考。

papers.abstract: Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency, leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency. Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters. Our Orbia benchmark provides a systematic basis for diagnosing 3D inconsistency and developing more persistent video world models.

analysis.key_results: 构建了涵盖室内外环境及六种探索-回访协议的720个实例，并评估了27个文本、动作和相机条件模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Orbia基准，首个针对交互式世界模型3D一致性进行系统和全面评估的基准。
analysis.method: 通过受控探索与回访，将评估组织为输入保持、生成内容持久性和3D自一致性三个维度，并使用注册RGB-D参考、注释锚点、跨视图深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性及留出高斯渲染等方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Orbia是首个系统评估交互式世界模型中3D一致性的基准，通过受控探索和回访从输入保持、生成内容持久性和3D自一致性三个维度进行评测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接针对世界模型（WAM）的3D一致性评估，对机器人世界建模和具身智能中的环境一致性研究具有重要价值，但未涉及VLA或动作预测。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

analysis.key_results: 在涵盖数学、代码生成和对话的七个基准上，使用 Qwen3.8-27B 在单个 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上相比自回归解码平均实现 3.16 倍加速；在每个基准上均优于 DSpark，平均吞吐量提升 7.97%，接受长度提升 8.50%。
analysis.main_contribution: 首个利用混合线性注意力（HLA）循环状态进行位置特定上下文检索的投机解码方法 ReaDy。
analysis.method: 为每个草稿位置使用学习到的查询从目标模型的已提交循环状态中检索补充上下文，并通过轻量级状态读取器以残差更新方式集成到草稿表示中，同时采用低秩状态读取和融合算子减少计算与 I/O 开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ReaDy 利用混合线性注意力模型的循环状态为投机解码中的每个草稿位置检索上下文，从而提升草稿质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对投机解码这一独立的高效推理主题，未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人学习，因此与本站主题无直接关系，但该方法可潜在应用于任何基于混合线性注意力架构的自回归模型，包括未来可能的具身模型。

papers.abstract: Action-chunking vision-language-action (VLA) models predict sequences of future robot actions. Under fixed-horizon execution, the robot executes a fixedlength prefix of each predicted chunk before invoking the policy again, leaving the remaining predictions unused. For a given number of executed actions, short execution horizons require more policy calls. Extending the execution horizon amortizes policy inference cost over more actions. However, uniformly applying long horizons across episodes can limit opportunities for precise corrections. To address this limitation, we propose PICES (Perturbation-Informed Chunk and Execution Horizon Selection), a training-free method that jointly selects an action chunk and the number of actions executed before the next policy call. Within a single policy call, the action expert generates a batch of action chunks from multiple initial noise samples and their locally perturbed counterparts, using the same conditioning features across all samples. PICES exploits differences between corresponding actions in each nominal chunk and its counterpart to determine candidate-specific execution horizons and select a nominal chunk for execution. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that PICES achieves speedup by up to 2.3x in wall-clock policy inference time on Jetson Orin and Thor relative to fixed horizon baselines while improving the success rate.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务中，相比固定水平基线，PICES在Jetson Orin和Thor上实现最高2.3倍的策略推理时间加速，同时提高了成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出训练无关的PICES方法，在单次策略调用中利用多个噪声样本及其扰动对应项之间的差异，联合选择动作块和执行水平，从而加速VLA推理。
analysis.method: PICES，基于扰动信息的块与执行水平选择：动作专家从多个初始噪声样本及其局部扰动对应项生成批量动作块，利用名义块与对应项之间的动作差异确定候选特定执行水平并选择名义块执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PICES方法，通过联合选择动作块和执行水平，在保证成功率的同时加速VLA模型推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型的推理加速，通过动态调整执行水平减少策略调用次数，属于VLA高效推理的核心研究。

(b) PICES uses multiple initial-noise samples and their perturbations to determine execution horizon of nominal action chunk. Our method reduces the number of policy calls required to complete the same episode, from four to two in the illustrated example. (c) Success rate versus speedup comparison across methods, showing that PICES achieves wall-clock inference time speedup while preserving success rate.

papers.abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present VLX-GO, a vision-language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces. Code is available at https://github.com/om-ai-lab/VLX-Go.

analysis.key_results: 在干扰跟踪成功率上，完整多阶段训练达到55.80%（基线OmTrackVLA为41.54%），在线精化后进一步提高到58.22%，碰撞率降低1.99个百分点，在对比方法中取得了最高的干扰和模糊跟踪成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLX-Go，一个多阶段训练的视觉-语言航点策略，用于在干扰人群中鲁棒地跟踪指定人员，并通过在线策略精化进一步提升性能。
analysis.method: 结合冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时序上下文、Transformer主干和轻量级航点预测头；训练依次进行视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理微调和跟踪任务专业化，并使用过滤的预言机标签进行在线策略精化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种视觉-语言航点策略VLX-Go，通过多阶段学习（视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理、跟踪专业化）和在线策略精化，提升有人环境中人员跟随的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在具身跟踪任务中的应用，与VLA主题核心相关；未涉及世界模型（WAM）。

figures.caption: VLX-Go architecture and training workflow. (A) Frozen DINOv3 and SigLIP features are concatenated and pooled into 188 visual tokens: 31 × ( 2 × 2 ) 31\times(2\times 2) for history and 8 × 8 8\times 8 for the current frame. A vision–language adapter projects these features into a transformer backbone; temporal/view indicators, instruction tokens, and a learnable action query complete the input. A three-layer MLP decodes the action state into eight robot-centric waypoints. (B) Three offline stages train the adapter, then the backbone and adapter, and finally the backbone, adapter, and waypoint head. (C) DAgger collects policy rollouts, labels visited states with the oracle, filters the labels, and fine-tunes on aggregated rollouts and demonstrations. papers.abstract: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.

analysis.key_results: 在模型基动作判别中，SonoWorld在高达74.8%的试验中正确将目标导向探针运动排在等幅反向运动之上；通过用户研究验证了可控性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SonoWorld，一个因果超声世界模型，从无标签临床视频学习视频动态，并通过小型EM跟踪数据集将其接地到6-DoF控制，为机器人超声提供数据驱动的交互式环境。
analysis.method: 三阶段训练：在大规模无标签多器官超声帧上预训练潜动作条件视频扩散模型；使用小型EM跟踪甲状腺数据集将视频动态接地到度量探针位姿；应用分布匹配蒸馏实现因果、长时程自回归生成，并在推理时选择性缓存驱逐token。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个因果、位姿可控的超声世界模型SonoWorld，用于机器人超声数据采集与策略评估。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文核心是构建可位姿控制的超声世界模型，属于机器人世界模型研究，可直接为机器人超声数据采集和策略评估提供仿真环境，与VLA/WAM主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B上跨视觉和文本任务，相比原始自推测方法一致提升高达11%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SP²ec（Single-Peak SPeculative decoding），一种免训练的bandit算法，在自推测解码中自适应调整草稿配置，并理论保证墙钟时间遗憾（wall-time regret）最小化。
analysis.method: 利用自推测方法中观察到的单峰吞吐模式，采用bandit算法动态选择草稿配置，显式最小化每个查询的墙钟时间遗憾。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SP²ec，一种免训练的自适应bandit算法，在自推测解码中动态调整草稿配置以加速视觉语言模型推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦视觉语言模型的推测解码加速，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模。但该自适应推测解码方法对具身模型的推理效率优化具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和三个真实世界操作任务上平均真实世界成功率达88.3%（最强基线为76.7%）；在WorldArena中三项动作条件世界建模任务均领先；AC-WM联合训练改善所有动作接口的生成，PAIR将OOD成功率从63.3%提升到76.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniW(A)M框架，利用混合专家扩散Transformer统一动作条件世界建模和多种WAM变体，并设计PAIR插件式自适应接口路由器，在冻结骨干网络的情况下根据目标任务块场景选择合适接口。
analysis.method: 基于扩散Transformer的混合专家模型，共享专家捕捉通用动态，原子能力专家跨接口复用；部署时通过PAIR从少量目标任务块场景中学习接口选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一的世界与世界-动作模型混合专家框架UniW(A)M，共享物理动态并通过自适应接口路由平衡任务成功率和执行效率。

papers.abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

analysis.key_results: 在EWMBench、WorldOlympiad和WorldArena上排名第一；受控研究表明动作条件、几何交互和共享表示中的多功能训练具有益处。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Thinker-WM，一个统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享的中间Unified Dynamics Transformer联合建模和生成RGB、度量深度和机器人动作，支持联合视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推理、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成和逆动力学等多种功能。
analysis.method: 采用模态特定编码器和解码器，将外观、几何和动作转换到统一的动态表示，由共享参数共同演化；训练数据包括约20K小时自我中心视频、10K小时真实机器人数据和1K小时仿真数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Thinker-WM是一个统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享中间动力学Transformer联合建模和生成RGB、度量深度和机器人动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文属于世界建模（WAM）核心主题，统一表示包含动作，与机器人动作预测和具身智能直接相关。

papers.abstract: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.

analysis.key_results: 八种开源和专有MLLM在MMTA上均存在将时间序列表示为文本导致的长序列和细粒度对齐弱化问题，尤其在长视频设置中；TimeOmni-v改善了长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了覆盖九个领域的三模态时序分析基准MMTA，标准化异构数据并设计成功加权指标；评估八种MLLM揭示时间序列文本化导致的表示与对齐瓶颈；提出TimeOmni-v模型扩展以提升长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.method: MMTA基准采用视频+时间序列和图像+时间序列两种布局，统一为共享模式并包含领域特定提示、来源文档和成功加权指标；TimeOmni-v模型引入专用时间序列编码器、时间位置对齐、模态感知标记布局和预测头。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个包含时间序列、文本和视觉的三模态基准MMTA，用于评估多模态大模型在分类和预测任务上的表现，并发现时间序列文本化导致的表示瓶颈，进而提出TimeOmni-v模型改进长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作为多模态时序分析建立基准并改进表示效率，涉及机器人等应用领域，但未直接针对VLA或世界模型；其时间序列编码与对齐方法可能对具身模型的时间序列处理有参考价值，但无直接关系。

papers.abstract: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models can be run using frameworks such as vLLM and MLX, with quantized versions available to reduce memory usage.Inference code and links to model weights are available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/Startlux-Decision .

analysis.key_results: 在Decision Index 0.3公开子集上，Instant模型比最强可比规模开放权重决策模型高出7.4-16.9分；27B AutoThink达到73.4分。RLCD²将推理跟踪在生成限制内终止的比例提高最多48个百分点，平均推理长度减少最多65%。在DecisionPivot上，AutoThink比Instant对应模型准确率高出11.5-18.4分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了StartLux-Decision决策模型，包括Instant（单遍）和AutoThink（自适应推理）变体，以及RLCD²强化学习方法，用于校准决策置信度并控制推理令牌长度，同时保持准确性。
analysis.method: 三阶段训练管线：共享能力训练、变体专业化、AutoThink推理监督与强化学习；RLCD²使用冻结模型和proper scoring rules优化决策概率质量并惩罚过长推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出了从0.8B到27B参数的决策模型系列，结合单遍高效预测与自适应推理，并引入RLCD²方法以校准推理长度并提高效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文主要关注决策模型中的高效推理与量化，未直接涉及机器人操作、视觉语言动作（VLA）或世界模型（WAM）。其量化版本和高效推理方法可能对资源受限的机器人部署具有潜在借鉴意义，但摘要未明确建立与机器人或体现智能的联系。

papers.abstract: A central goal of vision-language model (VLM) distillation is to transfer both the teacher's language capabilities and its visual understanding. However, existing methods primarily supervise the student's output, leaving visual understanding implicit. Our analysis reveals that a student can match the teacher's answer without relying on the same visual evidence, raising the question: how can we ensure the student responds to the visual information that actually determines the answer? To this end, we propose \textbf{Cross-World On-Policy Distillation (CW-OPD)}, which explicitly supervises the student's response to changes in visual evidence. For each example, CW-OPD constructs two visual worlds that share the question and scene context but differ in answer-critical evidence, yielding different answers. We perform on-policy distillation in both worlds and distill the teacher's cross-world belief transition, encouraging the student to match not only \emph{what} the teacher predicts but also \emph{why} its prediction changes with the evidence. A gradient analysis shows that this term is invariant to errors shared by both worlds and supplies a corrective signal invisible to endpoint matching alone. In this way, CW-OPD makes reliance on the relevant visual evidence an explicit distillation target rather than an implicit consequence of output matching. To diagnose whether a model truly grounds its answers in visual evidence, we introduce CWBench, which measures cross-world consistency via Cross-World Pair Accuracy (CWPA). Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that CW-OPD outperforms the strongest baseline by \textbf{1.2} points on average, and the 4B student exceeds DeepSeek-V4.1 (552B) by \textbf{22.4} CWPA points on CWBench. Code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/CWAD.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3.5-4B上平均超过最强基线1.2个点，4B学生模型在CWBench上超过DeepSeek-V4.1 (552B) 22.4个CWPA点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Cross-World On-Policy Distillation (CW-OPD)框架和CWBench基准，使视觉证据依赖成为显式蒸馏目标而非隐式结果。
analysis.method: 构造两个共享问题和场景但答案关键视觉证据不同的视觉世界，进行在线策略蒸馏，并蒸馏教师的跨世界信念转移。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出跨世界在线策略蒸馏方法，通过监督学生对视觉证据变化的响应来显式蒸馏视觉理解，并引入CWBench基准来衡量跨世界一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法针对通用视觉语言模型蒸馏，未明确涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，但其跨世界一致性和视觉证据蒸馏思想对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界模型（WAM）的视觉 grounded 训练具有迁移价值。

papers.title: Distill the Visual Evidence, Not Just the Answer: Cross-World On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models

papers.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevantant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. Human videos supervise all three future-World streams, whereas robot trajectories additionally provide action supervision, enabling transfer without human action labels or retargeting. Experiments on RoboCasa, CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over RGB-only and robot-data-only baselines. Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales. These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboCasa、CALVIN ABC→D 和真实世界操作上相比仅 RGB 和仅机器人数据的基准取得一致提升；在固定机器人监督下，RoboCasa 性能随带可供性标注的人类视频规模单调提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AffordanceWAM，一种可供性感知的生成式世界动作模型，在统一的流匹配目标下联合预测未来 RGB 观测、标量可供性、可供性热图和连续动作，并实现从人类视频到机器人的跨域迁移。
analysis.method: 在预训练视频扩散 Transformer 上，使用分立参数化的世界专家和动作专家，通过掩码联合自注意力耦合，联合预测未来 RGB、标量可供性字段、可供性热图和连续机器人动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出可供性感知的生成式世界动作模型，通过标量可供性字段和可供性热图在预测的未来世界中联合生成机器人动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文以世界动作模型（WAM）为核心，通过可供性表示将世界建模与动作生成联合，并利用人类视频进行跨域迁移，与本站 VLA/WAM 和机器人世界建模主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM layers and action representations. The Layer Mixture Router dynamically forms mixtures of cached VLM representations, while Action-State Reread reuses earlier action representations. Across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks, LayerRoute consistently improves StarVLA-$\pi$ and $\pi_{0.5}$, achieving up to 7.2 gains on LIBERO Long with only 0.31% / 3.87% additional parameters. Ablation studies validate the benefit of action-conditioned layer routing, while routing analyses reveal structured allocation patterns across action layers and task settings.

analysis.key_results: 在多个仿真和真实世界基准上，LayerRoute一致提升StarVLA-π和π0.5，在LIBERO Long上获得最高7.2的提升，且仅增加0.31%/3.87%的额外参数。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入LayerRoute，一个动作条件表示路由接口，包含Layer Mixture Router和Action-State Reread，能自适应访问VLM层和动作表示，在LIBERO Long等基准上提升StarVLA-π和π0.5的性能。
analysis.method: 通过Layer Mixture Router动态形成缓存的VLM表示的混合，并通过Action-State Reread重用早期的动作表示，实现动作条件化的层路由。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LayerRoute动作条件表示路由接口，动态混合VLM层表示并重用动作状态，以提升VLA策略性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中表示访问的灵活性进行改进，通过自适应路由VLM层和动作状态，属于VLA策略核心架构的优化，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents require more than retrieval over stored conversations: they must preserve source evidence, revise outdated knowledge, and distinguish relevant memories from sufficient support for an answer. We present ECHO (Embodied Context & History Orchestration), an auditable dual-path memory system. A fast path captures immutable events and serves multi-route recall, while asynchronous workers consolidate experience into revisable state and rebuild derived indexes. Source provenance, temporal authority, and answer realization are explicit boundaries. The service supports original-source packets with evidence-use checks and disables model-based reranking by default. For the latest reported accuracy, the authors confirm mixed retrieved inputs comprising original dialogue and memory summaries, answered by Qwen3-8B with NF4 quantization. In the latest author-supplied five-system aggregate evaluation, ECHO reports 56.27% answer accuracy, 98.04% source Hit@10, 93.58% macro source Recall@5, and 13.92% hallucination flags, with 19.54 ms mean retrieval latency. Its reported accuracy exceeds Mem0 by 4.53 percentage points in this snapshot. The results are descriptive aggregates; matched question-level evaluation and generation latency remain to be established. We separate these observations from earlier published experiments and engineering regressions.

analysis.key_results: 在最新的五系统聚合评估中，ECHO 报告 56.27% 答案准确率、98.04% 源 Hit@10、93.58% 宏源 Recall@5、13.92% 幻觉标记，平均检索延迟 19.54 ms；其报告准确率比 Mem0 高 4.53 个百分点。
analysis.limitations: 结果为描述性聚合；问题级评估与生成延迟尚未建立；作者将观测结果与早期实验及工程回归分离。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ECHO（Embodied Context & History Orchestration）双路径记忆系统，将不可变事件快速存储与异步经验合并为可修订状态，并显式区分源出处、时间权威性与答案实现边界。
analysis.method: 双路径记忆系统：快速路径捕获不可变事件并支持多路由召回；异步工作器合并经验为可修订状态并重建派生索引；服务使用原始源包与证据使用检查，默认禁用基于模型的重排序；答案由 Qwen3-8B 结合 NF4 量化生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 ECHO 双路径记忆系统，通过快速事件存储与异步经验合并实现可审计的长程智能体记忆，其中模型使用 NF4 量化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是长期记忆系统，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界建模；其使用 NF4 量化以获得高效推理，与模型量化主题有直接关联，但对本站支持的 VLA/WAM 主题无直接方法论贡献。
