papers.abstract: World models for autonomous driving should anticipate the consequences that matter for driving decisions rather than reconstruct every detail of future scenes. However, predictive representations alone are not guaranteed to distinguish candidate actions that lead to different planning outcomes.We propose DA-WAM, a decision-aligned world action model that couples a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) with candidate-level trajectory scoring. During joint training, the JEPA objective grounds future representations in observed scene dynamics, while the planning objectives encourage these representations to capture distinctions relevant to safety and utility. An action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent for each candidate trajectory, and a multi-head trajectory scorer uses the corresponding latent to estimate planning factors and overall utility. In addition, safety-critical post-training with hard negatives further improves discrimination between geometrically similar trajectories with different safety outcomes. DA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among learned camera-based planners on NAVSIM-v1, NAVSIM-v2, and Bench2Drive. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of each component in driving decision-making.

analysis.key_results: 在NAVSIM-v1、NAVSIM-v2和Bench2Drive上取得基于摄像头的学习型规划器的最先进性能；消融实验验证各组件的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DA-WAM，一种决策对齐的世界动作模型，将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与候选级轨迹评分相结合，实现安全与效用感知的未来表示学习。
analysis.method: 联合训练JEPA目标与规划目标，使用动作条件预测器为每个候选轨迹生成未来潜在表示，并由多头轨迹评分器估计规划因子和整体效用；结合安全关键后训练与困难负样本增强判别。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种决策对齐的世界动作模型DA-WAM，通过将JEPA预测表示与候选轨迹评分耦合，提升自动驾驶决策性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究属于世界动作模型（WAM）方向，直接面向自动驾驶决策，通过决策对齐的未来潜在表示提升规划安全性，对本站主题具有高度相关性。

figures.caption: Candidate--representation coupling in driving decisions. Schematic comparison of (a) trajectory prediction without an explicit future-representation input to the scorer, (b) joint trajectory and latent prediction without explicit candidate-wise pairing, (c) multiple candidates evaluated using a shared future representation, and (d) DA-WAM, which computes a candidate-conditioned representation for each trajectory and scores the corresponding trajectory--representation pair. The scorer receives the trajectory together with its associated representation and scene context. The panels illustrate conditioning structures rather than an exhaustive classification of prior work.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of DA-WAM. The online visual encoder produces shared scene tokens. A shared action-conditioned predictor constructs compact tokens for each candidate trajectory, and the scorer evaluates each candidate together with its associated tokens and scene context. A training-only dense decoder and a stop-gradient EMA target provide future-feature supervision for the expert-matched candidate.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
papers.title_zh: DA-WAM：面向驾驶世界模型的决策对齐未来潜在表示

papers.abstract: A central goal in robot learning is to move beyond task-specific human data collection toward robots that improve through autonomous interaction. Yet fully autonomous learning remains difficult with current policies: sparse rewards and weak zero-shot exploration often prevent online learning from discovering successful behavior. As a first step towards fully autonomous learning, we propose the minimal-data adaptation regime, in which a pretrained robot policy must learn a new task from as little as one demonstration followed by autonomous online interaction. We establish that, although pretrained policies fail zero-shot on many new tasks, a single demonstration suffices to direct their behavioral prior to coarse task-following behavior, albeit with unreliable performance. From this insight, we isolate the key design principles required to convert coarse task-following into reliable task success. These include (1) the surprising efficacy of pretrained VLA representations to support sample-efficient value learning from online interaction (2) the sufficiency of residual policy learning to learn corrective behavior and (3) the need for careful data-balancing to prevent exploration collapse. As a representative of these principles, we propose MiDAS, a simple offline-to-online RL recipe that combines few-demonstration behavior cloning with value-based residual learning over frozen VLA representations. Across LIBERO and RoboCasa tasks, MiDAS substantially improves performance from single-demonstration initializations, including policies that succeed only rarely, validating the principles highlighted above. On a bimanual YAM platform, starting from a brittle initial policy, MiDAS improves task success after approximately six hours of online interaction.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和RoboCasa任务中，MiDAS从单次演示初始化大幅提升性能，包括原本很少成功的策略；在双臂YAM平台上，从脆弱的初始策略开始，约六小时在线交互后提高任务成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了最小数据适应设置，并确立了将粗略任务跟随转化为可靠任务成功的关键设计原则：利用预训练VLA表征进行样本高效值学习、残差策略学习以及防止探索崩溃的数据平衡。
analysis.method: MiDAS: 离线到在线强化学习配方，结合少量演示行为克隆与基于冻结VLA表征的值基残差学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文探讨了预训练VLA策略在单次演示和在线交互的最小数据环境下适应新任务所需的原理，并提出MiDAS方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接围绕预训练VLA策略的高效适应展开，使用冻结的VLA表征进行值学习和残差策略学习，对VLA在真实机器人上的快速部署和持续学习具有直接方法学价值。

figures.caption: Overview of minimal-data adaptation. A single demonstration is sparse and underdetermined on its own, but pretrained VLA representations turn it into a useful anchor for adaptation. Few-demo behavior cloning narrows the search space to a task-relevant region around the demonstration, and online residual RL then expands local success by learning value-guided corrections on top of the warm-started base policy.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Performance of different representations in online adaptation. We see that (a) No pretraining, in the form of a Resnet backbone fine-tuned from scratch, collapses; (b) Generic visual pretraining, in the form of frozen DINO features helps, but takes longer to converge; (c) Pretrained VLA representations of π 0.5 \pi_{\text{0.5}} are highly sample efficient, consistent with the hypothesis that action-aligned pretraining can substantially improve the sample efficiency of downstream online adaptation.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: What Does It Take For A Generalist Robot Policy To Adapt From Minimal Data?
papers.title_zh: 通用机器人策略从最小数据中适应需要什么？

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by enabling unified reasoning across perception, language, and planning. However, existing approaches lack mechanisms to exploit past failures or adapt to distribution shifts, causing the model to persistently underperform on similar scenarios where it has previously failed. In this paper, we propose DriveVLA-M0, a retrieval-augmented VLA with failure-aware latent memory. We construct a latent memory pool that stores failure cases along with their structure scene representations and expert trajectory labels, and design a dedicated Retrieve Model that decouples static road structure and dynamic agent interactions to enable structurally grounded retrieval. At inference time, retrieved cases are injected into the model via a lightweight decoupled LoRA-based test-time training (TTT) mechanism, allowing targeted and scenario-specific correction without modifying the backbone. Extensive experiments on NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmark demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving 94.1 PDMS on Navtest and 47.0 EPDMS on Navhard with only 26.44 ms TTT backward latency overhead. Furthermore, we show that DriveVLA-M0 scales effectively with additional memory, enabling training-free performance gains through memory expansion. The code is available at https://github.com/ZebinX/DriveVLA-M0.

analysis.key_results: 在 NAVSIMv1 和 NAVSIMv2 基准上，达到 94.1 PDMS（Navtest）和 47.0 EPDMS（Navhard），测试时训练反向传播延迟开销仅 26.44 ms，且通过记忆扩展可实现免训练的性能提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DriveVLA-M0，一个具有故障感知潜在记忆的检索增强 VLA 模型，能够利用过去的失败案例，在推理时通过轻量级 LoRA 测试时训练进行场景特定的修正，无需修改主干网络。
analysis.method: 构建存储故障案例及其结构化场景表示和专家轨迹标签的潜在记忆池；设计检索模型解耦静态道路结构和动态智能体交互；推理时通过解耦的 LoRA 测试时训练机制注入检索案例。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种检索增强的 VLA 模型 DriveVLA-M0，利用故障感知潜在记忆和基于 LoRA 的测试时训练实现自动驾驶中的场景特定修正。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型在自动驾驶中的性能提升，通过故障感知记忆增强和测试时训练实现自适应修正，属于 VLA 领域的高相关研究，特别是对机器人策略学习和高效推理的交叉方向具有参考价值。

figures.caption: We propose DriveVLA-M0, a failure-aware memory augmentation VLA framework. (a) Classic VLA: VLMs perform scene reasoning in vision-language space and pass intermediate features to an Action Decoder for planning. The red trajectories indicate the model’s likely selections. (b) Ours: We retrieve structurally similar failure cases using Retrieved Model from a latent memory pool and inject them into the Action Decoder via LoRA-based test-time training for scenario-specific correction. (c) Performance: DriveVLA-M0 achieves SOTA on Navtest (NAVSIMv1, blue) and Navhard (NAVSIMv2, orange).
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of DriveVLA-M0. (Top) [M] Memory Generation: Scenarios where the base model underperforms are identified via oracle simulation scoring, and their intermediate features are stored in latent memory 𝕄 \mathbb{M} . (Bottom) [I] Inference with TTT: At test time, structurally similar cases are retrieved from 𝕄 \mathbb{M} based on the current scene features, and the retrieved contents are used to fine-tune the Action Decoder via Decoupled LoRA. Specifically, cases retrieved by map features are utilized to adapt the Map (Static) LoRA branch, while cases retrieved by agent features are used to adapt the Agent (Dynamic) LoRA branch, enabling targeted and scenario-specific planning correction.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: DriveVLA-M0: Failure-Aware Memory Augmentation for Autonomous Driving
papers.title_zh: DriveVLA-M0：面向自动驾驶的故障感知记忆增强

papers.abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) can clone a voice from seconds of audio. Yet the quality comes from billion-parameter diffusion transformers whose size and multi-step sampling put them out of reach of the on-device, assistive, and real-time applications that need them most. Post-training quantization (PTQ) shrinks such models without retraining, but it has been built for language and vision, not speech. At 4 bits, a strong quantizer leaves intelligibility close to full precision but consistently erodes speaker timbre, so error rates stay low while the voice drifts from the target speaker. We ask why quantization hurts speech, where the damage lives, and whether it can be repaired without retraining. To find out, we run the first 4-bit weight-and-activation (W4A4) PTQ study of a TTS diffusion transformer at 1B and 3.5B. The timbre cost comes from both the weight and the activation quantization, but only the activation part has the timestep structure a precision schedule can exploit. We therefore introduce TTS-Q, which selects hard-to-quantize items from task-matched calibration candidates and applies a budget-balanced mixed-precision schedule that assigns higher precision to late-step feed-forward activations. TTS-Q recovers timbre best at both scales, at no cost to intelligibility. Separately, the deployed calibrated-W4A4 reference reduces peak memory on GPU, providing a practical reference for resource-constrained TTS deployment.

analysis.key_results: TTS-Q在两种规模下均恢复音色最佳，且不牺牲可懂度；校准W4A4参考减少GPU峰值内存。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次对1B和3.5B文本到语音扩散Transformer进行W4A4训练后量化研究，提出TTS-Q方法，通过任务匹配的校准样本选择和预算平衡的混合精度调度，修复量化导致的说话人音色损失。
analysis.method: TTS-Q：从任务匹配的校准候选中选择难量化项，并应用预算平衡的混合精度调度，为后期前馈激活分配更高精度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文首次对文本到语音扩散Transformer进行4位权重与激活量化研究，提出TTS-Q方法以修复量化对说话人音色的损害。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于文本到语音扩散Transformer的量化，不直接涉及视觉语言动作模型（VLA）或世界模型（WAM）。但其针对扩散模型训练后量化的方法（如混合精度调度）可能对VLA/WAM中的扩散组件优化具有借鉴价值。

figures.caption: Overview of TTS-Q. Coverage-guided calibration sampling selects conditions in a reference-speaker embedding space. After initial local reconstruction, speaker identity distillation compares teacher and student speech under matched text, voice prompt, and initial noise. Local reconstruction remains active on cached teacher states. The dashed purple path carries identity gradients through the frozen decoder and speaker encoder. The lower inset shows a detached prefix (student for LongCat, teacher for F5) and differentiable sampling tail. Only quantization parameters are updated. Waveforms and embedding geometry are schematic.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: TTS-Q: Speaker-Aware Post-Training Quantization of Text-to-Speech Diffusion Transformers
papers.title_zh: TTS-Q：文本到语音扩散 Transformer 的说话人感知训练后量化

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual state transitions and robot actions. However, existing WAMs are constrained by limited temporal context, coarse episode-level language supervision, and predominantly text-only conditioning, which hinder task-progress tracking and fine-grained language-video-action grounding while limiting visual-context reasoning and cross-embodiment transfer. In this paper, we introduce WorldScape Policy 2.0, a controllable WAM with reasoning-augmented long short-term memory. Its causal short-term visual memory supplies recent observations as DiT prefill to preserve local interaction dynamics, while its long short-term event memory organizes historical VLM outputs into global-history, local-active, and event-boundary representations for progress-aware retrieval. The retrieved history augments perception and autoregressively generated planning tokens, yielding an implicit subgoal condition for autonomous planning; semantic forcing further transfers event-level instruction semantics into this latent planning pathway. To establish fine-grained multimodal controllability, we construct ManipEvent-5M, an event-grounded embodied pretraining dataset containing nearly 5 million event segments with aligned action trajectories, episode-level task instructions, segment-level subtask captions, goal images, and video demonstrations. These designs provide a unified interface for autonomous planning from high-level instructions and controllable execution from fine-grained text, goal-image, or video-context prompts. Experiments in both simulation and real-world platforms demonstrate superior capabilities in long-horizon autonomous planning, fine-grained instruction following and in-context adaptation.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界平台上展示了在长时程自主规划、细粒度指令跟随和上下文适应方面的优越能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了WorldScape Policy 2.0，一个具有推理增强长短期记忆的可控世界行动模型，并贡献了事件基的ManipEvent-5M预训练数据集，实现了细粒度的多模态可控性和长时程自主规划能力。
analysis.method: 通过因果短期视觉记忆（DiT prefill）和事件基长期记忆（历史VLM输出组织成全局历史、局部活跃和事件边界表示）来增强感知与规划token生成；引入隐式子目标条件和语义强制机制；利用ManipEvent-5M数据集进行预训练，支持文本、目标图像和视频上下文提示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出一个可控的世界行动模型（WAM），通过因果短期视觉记忆和事件基长期记忆实现推理增强的长短期记忆机制，并结合新构建的ManipEvent-5M数据集支持自主规划与细粒度可控执行。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于世界行动模型（WAM）的建模与改进，属于本站核心主题。它联合建模视觉状态转移和机器人动作，通过记忆机制和上下文学习提升长时程任务和细粒度控制能力，为WAM的自主规划与可控执行提供了有效的方案和数据集。

figures.caption: Comparison of different WAM paradigms. Existing models use (a) static observations, (b) short-term visual history, or (c) full-history visual memory without progress-aware reasoning or multimodal control. (d) WorldScape Policy 2.0 introduces multimodal controllability and reasoning-augmented long short-term memory, enabling interactive video-action modeling for long-horizon robotic manipulation.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of the WorldScape Policy 2.0 framework. Built on the event-based ManipEvent-5M pretraining data, WorldScape Policy 2.0 encodes observations together with interchangeable text, goal-image, and video-demonstration prompts into a unified causal video-action modeling pipeline. The model couples short-term visual transitions with long-term reasoning-augmented event memory, enabling implicit subgoal planning and joint video-action prediction. This design supports both autonomous planning from coarse task instructions and controllable manipulation from fine-grained subtask captions or visual prompts.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory and In-Context Learning
papers.title_zh: WorldScape Policy 2.0：赋能可操控的世界行动建模，结合推理增强记忆与上下文学习

papers.abstract: Diffusion-based virtual try-on (VTON) often relies on segmentation-derived masks that become unreliable when the reference garment differs substantially from the target person's clothing. Existing methods may also lose fine details and commonly focus on single-garment transfer. We present TAMF-VTON, an inference-time mask-free framework built on Qwen-Image-Edit-2509. Given a person image, one or more garment images, and a text instruction, it performs single- or multi-garment transfer without masks, parsing maps, pose representations, or spatial controls at inference. Its central component is token-wise sparse Mixture-of-Experts adaptation, which provides input-dependent capacity without predefined expert roles. Timestep-weighted frequency supervision regularizes high-frequency reconstruction, while adaptive offline data construction supplies cross-category and cross-silhouette training tuples; neither is used at inference. TAMF-VTON achieves the best scores on most reported paired and unpaired metrics among evaluated VTON baselines on the standard single-garment VITON-HD and DressCode benchmarks. Selected qualitative results illustrate multi-garment composition, subject-to-subject transfer, diverse scenes, body-shape variation, and illumination changes. With INT4 on an RTX 4090, TAMF-VTON generates 1K-resolution images under 15 seconds and 2K-resolution images under 30 seconds. Our project can be accessed via https://www.style3d.ai/ai-photoshoot/virtual-clothing-try-on.

analysis.key_results: 在VITON-HD和DressCode基准上，多数配对和非配对指标优于现有方法；INT4量化后在RTX 4090上生成1K分辨率图像小于15秒，2K分辨率图像小于30秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TAMF-VTON，一个推理时无需掩码、解析图、姿态表示或空间控制的单/多服装虚拟试穿框架，核心是令牌级稀疏专家混合适配与时步加权频率监督。
analysis.method: 利用Qwen-Image-Edit-2509作为基础模型，采用令牌级稀疏专家混合适配提供输入依赖的容量，结合时步加权频率监督正则化高频重建，并用自适应离线数据构造提供跨类别和跨轮廓训练样本。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个基于Qwen-Image-Edit-2509的无需掩码的虚拟试穿框架TAMF-VTON，通过令牌级稀疏专家混合适配和离线数据构建实现单/多服装转移，并在INT4量化下实现高效推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于虚拟试穿任务中的高效推理与模型量化，与机器人VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和世界模型（WAM）无直接关联。其高效量化策略（INT4）可作为通用推理加速技术的参考，但对本站支持的具身智能主题无直接应用价值。

figures.caption: Qualitative results of TAMF-VTON across diverse virtual try-on scenarios. The first row shows single-garment transfer from a flat-lay product image to a studio person image. The second row demonstrates more challenging settings, including multi-garment composition, in-the-wild try-on, and subject-to-subject garment transfer. TAMF-VTON preserves non-try-on regions and exposed body parts with strong spatial consistency, maintaining the original background, person identity, and body structure while faithfully transferring fine-grained garment details.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of the TAMF-VTON architecture. Multimodal inputs are encoded as visual and textual tokens, concatenated, and processed by the MoE-augmented Qwen-Edit backbone (left). Frequency-domain supervision minimizes high-frequency spectral discrepancies during training (right). Only the MoE routing and expert parameters are updated, while the original backbone remains frozen.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: TAMF-VTON: Token-Wise Sparse Adaptation for Mask-Free Virtual Try-On
papers.title_zh: TAMF-VTON：基于令牌稀疏自适应掩码无关的虚拟试穿框架

papers.abstract: Visual navigation policies built on large pretrained models increasingly rely on large cross-embodiment datasets and expressive action-generation mechanisms. In this paper, we ask whether a pretrained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) can be adapted efficiently for robot navigation by rethinking the representation and construction of navigation actions. We introduce GemNav, a visual navigation policy that represents each robot-local waypoint coordinate as a categorical distribution over discrete metric value bins and soft-decodes it into a continuous coordinate for execution. This probabilistic representation retains likelihood information over alternative coordinate values while providing a compact action space suitable for robot navigation. We further construct training trajectories using metric-distance goal sampling rather than fixed future frame offsets, exposing the policy to varying physical navigation horizons independent of dataset frame rate and robot speed. GemNav is trained on a single 8.7-hour public SCAND dataset, roughly three orders of magnitude smaller than competing cross-embodiment datasets. Extensive offline and closed-loop experiments show improved out-of-distribution generalization over frame-based sampling and substantially more reliable obstacle navigation than a matched continuous regression head. The same policy transfers without per-platform retraining across unseen environments and three physically distinct robot platforms.

analysis.key_results: 在单个8.7小时的SCAND数据集上训练，数据量比竞争性跨具身数据集小约三个数量级；离线实验显示比基于帧采样有更好的分布外泛化性；闭环实验中比匹配的连续回归头具有更可靠的避障导航；同一策略可在未见环境和三种物理异构机器人平台上无需每平台重新训练直接迁移。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新的导航动作表示方法，将机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标；同时采用度量距离目标采样构建训练轨迹，使策略对物理导航距离变化具有不变性。
analysis.method: 将每个机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标；使用度量距离目标采样而非固定未来帧偏移构建训练轨迹；采用多模态大语言模型作为策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GemNav提出一种基于多模态大语言模型的视觉导航策略，将机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标，从而在紧凑动作空间中保留似然信息。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在机器人导航中的应用，通过离散令牌化的动作表示和度量距离目标采样，为VLA在导航任务中的高效训练和泛化提供方法，与本站的VLA主题高度相关。

figures.caption: GemNav overview. Left: Metric-distance-based goal sampling produces eight-waypoint targets over varying physical navigation horizons, reducing dependence on frame rate and demonstrator speed. Center: LoRA adapts the vision and language towers for image, 2D pose, or image+pose goals. A task-specific prediction head jointly produces categorical coordinate distributions for eight waypoints and a navigation state in a single forward pass; soft decoding yields continuous metric waypoints (one coordinate pair shown). Right and bottom: The same checkpoint transfers without per-platform retraining to unseen environments on Spot, ANYmal, and WAVE ROVER, with the latter two being unseen embodiments.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: GemNav: Discrete-Token Visual Robot Navigation using a Multimodal Large Language Model
papers.title_zh: GemNav：利用多模态大语言模型实现离散令牌视觉机器人导航

papers.abstract: Can the robot use a plate to cut a cake if no knife is available? Tool use greatly expands robot capabilities, but to use tools creatively beyond their intended functions, the robot faces the challenge of $\textit{open-world affordance grounding}$: select an open-category object to act as a tool and localize its specific region of action. To this end, we introduce GROW$^2$ (GROunding Which and Where), which leverages object parts as a natural abstraction to split the grounding process hierarchically into semantic and geometric levels, thus bypassing the need for data-heavy, end-to-end training. Semantically, GROW$^2$ harnesses the commonsense reasoning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to parse a natural-language task instruction, select a suitable object as the tool, and identify task-relevant parts on the tool and the target object. Geometrically, vision foundation models then ground the selected parts into precise 3D regions from a single RGB-D image. Experiments on established benchmarks show that GROW$^2$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on affordance prediction benchmarks. Further, it achieves zero-shot generalization over open-category objects and outperforms baselines in both simulated and real-world robot tool use experiments.

analysis.key_results: 在既有可供性预测基准上超越最先进基线；在开放类别物体上实现零样本泛化，并在仿真与真实机器人工具使用实验中优于基线。

papers.abstract: Multi-task robot manipulation policies are challenging to learn from demonstration because traditionally a single network must select among qualitatively different action modes from a multimodal demonstration distribution, conditioned on language and visual context. A wrong mode selection means executing the wrong task or an action infeasible in the scene. Tokenizing continuous actions into a learned discrete codebook separates these modes at the representation level, offering structural advantages for multi-task learning. We propose VQActFlow, a multi-task manipulation policy that tokenizes action chunks and generates code sequences via Variational Flow Matching. VQActFlow maintains an explicit preference over action modes throughout generation. Inference-time guidance acts on this preference to steer mode commitment. We instantiate this with classifier-free guidance over language conditioning, which steers the policy toward the instructed action mode, and a learned codebook critic that supplies a complementary feasibility signal. We evaluate VQActFlow on three platforms: the LIBERO simulation benchmarks, a Unitree G1 humanoid performing whole-body pick-and-place, and an ALOHA-style bimanual platform performing contact-rich tasks. Across these benchmarks, VQActFlow outperforms both continuous and discrete baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 仿真基准、Unitree G1 人形机器人全身抓取放置以及 ALOHA 式双臂接触丰富任务上，VQActFlow 优于连续和离散基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 VQActFlow 多任务操作策略，将动作块量化为离散码本，并通过变分流匹配生成码序列；引入推理时引导，在语言条件上使用无分类器引导，并利用学习到的码本批评器提供可行性信号来引导模式承诺。
analysis.method: 将连续动作块量化为学习到的离散码本，结合变分流匹配生成动作码序列；在推理时通过语言条件上的无分类器引导和码本批评器引导模式选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VQActFlow 通过向量量化动作块并结合变分流匹配生成动作码序列，实现对多任务机器人操作中动作模式的显式引导。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习范畴，通过向量量化动作表示与流匹配生成，在多任务机器人操作中显式建模动作模式，显著提升了策略性能和任务选择性。

papers.abstract: We present ZeroDex, a zero-shot framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that grounds language instructions into executable 3D task plans from calibrated multi-view RGB images. Our framework builds on the grounding ability that vision-language models (VLMs) already exhibit in 2D and lifts their predictions into 3D through multi-view fusion, which extends VLM grounding beyond image-space keypoints to the metric 3D quantities that manipulation actually requires: contact points, placement targets, and tool-motion anchors. Because execution is driven by these 3D groundings rather than a learned policy, the system preserves the VLM's open-world generalization, without collecting demonstrations or post-training for a specific task or embodiment. The VLM decomposes a complex instruction into a sequence of atomic tasks, each executed by a primitive from a small reusable library that covers manipulation tasks including pick-and-place and tool-use: for tool-use, we retrieve an object-centric atomic action corresponding to the inferred skill category and align its stored 6D tool trajectory to the grounded keypoints; for dexterous execution, we expand the lifted grasp keypoint into a task-conditioned grasp affordance region and generate feasible grasp-motion pairs with an arm-hand motion generator. Real-world experiments show improved 3D grounding accuracy and higher task success than zero-shot visual-prompting and constraint-based baselines, both of which ground from a single RGB-D view, and our demonstration-free system outperforms VLA policies fine-tuned on 100 task demonstrations. We further demonstrate long-horizon manipulation, where execution verification and replanning recover from intermediate failures, and show that the system generalizes to unseen objects and tool-use tasks in novel scenes.

analysis.key_results: 真实世界实验表明三维对齐准确性和任务成功率优于单视角视觉提示和约束基线，且零样本系统性能超过基于100个任务演示微调的VLA策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ZeroDex框架，将视觉语言模型的2D语义对齐能力通过多视角融合提升到三维，实现零样本长时程灵巧操作，无需任务演示或后训练。
analysis.method: 利用视觉语言模型将复杂指令分解为原子任务序列，通过多视角RGB图像融合提取三维关键点（接触点、放置目标、工具运动锚点），并使用小型可重用原语库执行每个原子任务，包括拾放和工具使用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ZeroDex是一个零样本长时程灵巧操作框架，利用视觉语言模型的2D语义对齐能力，通过多视角融合将其提升到三维空间，从而生成可执行的3D任务计划。

papers.abstract: We introduce flow control of vision-language-action (VLA) models, a simple and effective way to steer VLA actions in real time through generic inputs, such as a keyboard. This method can be used out-of-the-box and does not require retraining or fine-tuning VLAs. It enables relatively crude user inputs to steer a VLA to align with user intent. Flow control writes the user input into the initial condition of the VLA's flow matching action expert. Because the flow is deterministic, integration retains information about the user input while moving it toward the action distribution learned during training, so that the generated actions reflect the user's intent (high fidelity) and stay close to the VLA's own unsteered actions (high conformity). We demonstrate that flow control has many desirable properties: (1) flow control accurately and responsively steers robot actions with user inputs, (2) it is robust to suboptimal user inputs, (3) it enables users to steer VLAs to achieve significantly higher success rates and faster task completion, and (4) fine-tuning a VLA on flow control trajectories improves the autonomous policy. Together, these results provide a simple and intuitive way for users to help steer VLA actions, increasing task performance. Project page and videos: https://jcykao.github.io/flowcontrol/.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明流控制能够准确响应地引导机器人动作，对次优用户输入具有鲁棒性，使用户能够显著提高成功率和任务完成速度，且基于流控制轨迹微调VLA可改善自主策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入流控制方法，通过将用户输入写入流匹配动作专家的初始条件，实现实时引导VLA动作，同时保持高保真度和高一致性。
analysis.method: 流控制：将用户输入写入VLA流匹配动作专家的初始条件，利用确定性流积分将输入信息移向学习到的动作分布，生成既符合用户意图又接近原始策略的动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种无需重训练或微调的流控制方法，通过实时用户输入（如键盘）引导视觉-语言-动作模型的动作生成，提升任务表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA模型的实时交互控制，通过流匹配特性实现无需重新训练的用户引导，属于VLA高效推理与人类交互的核心主题，与本站VLA研究方向高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage the rich world knowledge of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to enable instruction-following robotic manipulation. However, the structural mismatch between VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies often hinders the learning of precise perception-action mappings. To address this challenge, we propose AffordanceVLA, a scalable, unified framework that introduces structured affordance learning as a task-oriented and object-centric intermediate representation to establish a more precise and robust perception-action mapping. Specifically, we progressively model manipulation priors through three complementary components - Which2Act, Where2Act, and How2Act - which jointly produce spatially grounded, semantically conditioned, and action-coupled intermediate representations, thereby naturally bridging vision, language, and action. We integrate these modules into a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture and adopt a three-stage progressive training curriculum that leverages 8.8M affordance-centric grounding and pointing samples, translating scalable vision-language supervision into improved robotic manipulation. To overcome the scarcity of dense affordance labels in robotic datasets, we also develop a robust automated data augmentation pipeline. Extensive experiments on ID & OOD simulation and real-world demonstrate that AffordanceVLA outperforms strong VLA baselines across diverse manipulation scenarios, validating structured affordance learning as a scalable and robust bridge that integrates multi-source vision-language supervision while connecting pretrained VLM semantics to embodied robot control.

analysis.key_results: 在 ID 和 OOD 仿真及真实世界的大量实验中，AffordanceVLA 在多种操作场景下优于强 VLA 基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AffordanceVLA 框架，通过 Which2Act、Where2Act、How2Act 三个互补模块引入结构化可供性学习，并采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构和三阶段渐进训练课程，将大规模视觉-语言监督转化为改进的机器人操作能力。
analysis.method: 通过三个互补组件（Which2Act、Where2Act、How2Act）建模操作先验，生成空间接地、语义条件和动作耦合的中间表示；采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构和三阶段渐进训练；利用 8.8M 可供性为中心的接地和指向样本进行训练；开发自动化数据增强流程以克服机器人数据集中密集可供性标签稀缺的问题。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AffordanceVLA 提出结构化可供性学习框架，以任务导向、对象中心的中间表示桥接视觉、语言与动作，从而提升机器人操作策略的精确性和鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise for robotic manipulation, yet most existing policies operate reactively by directly regressing actions from current observations, without explicitly modeling future dynamics. This limits their ability to generalize under out-of-distribution perturbations. To address this issue, we propose ELAN4D, an embodiment-centric, 4D-aware training framework that enhances VLA policies with future robot keypoint tracks as predictive spatio-temporal supervision. Using only forward kinematics from proprioceptive states, we derive 3D displacement tracks of robot keypoints, such as joints and the end-effector, with negligible preprocess cost. These tracks provide metric and compact supervision without requiring external trackers or reconstruction. A plug-and-play auxiliary branch with a lightweight track decoder injects this 4D signal into the action expert while preserving the pretrained vision-language backbone through gradient isolation. The track decoder is discarded during inference, leaving the base policy interface unchanged. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that ELAN4D consistently improves over strong VLA baselines, achieving the best overall performance and substantial gains under out-of-distribution perturbations, including camera, background, and layout shifts. These results highlight the effectiveness of embodiment-centric 4D supervision for building more robust and generalizable manipulation policies.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0和真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，ELAN4D持续改进强VLA基线，实现最佳整体性能，并在相机、背景和布局变化等分布外扰动下取得显著增益。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ELAN4D，一个实施例中心、4D感知的训练框架，通过即插即用的辅助分支以未来机器人关键点轨迹作为额外监督，提升VLA策略的鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.method: 利用前向运动学从本体感知状态推导机器人关键点的3D位移轨迹，通过轻量级轨迹解码器将4D信号注入动作专家，同时通过梯度隔离保留预训练的视觉-语言骨干，推理时丢弃轨迹解码器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出ELAN4D框架，通过从本体感知状态推导的未来机器人关键点3D位移轨迹作为预测性时空监督，增强VLA策略的泛化能力。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet they still struggle to generalize to unseen tasks that necessitate transferring relevant experience across objects, scenes, and action patterns. This paper proposes VLA-Pro, a plug-and-play framework designed to enhance cross-task generalization by storing task-relevant procedural memories at training time and transferring these memories during inference. Specifically, VLA-Pro stores task-specific LoRA adapters as parameterized procedural memories during training. At inference time, VLA-Pro retrieves relevant procedural memories based on the current multi-modal context and dynamically fuses these memories for generating the current action chunk. Experiments on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-Pro consistently improves cross-task generalization across multiple backbones, achieving up to a 207% relative improvement in simulation and increasing real-world success rate from 5.8% to 65.0%. These results suggest that procedural memory retrieval and adaptation provide an effective mechanism for transferring manipulation experience to novel tasks while preserving modularity and execution stability.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin、RLBench及真实世界操作任务上，VLA-Pro在多种骨干网络下一致提升跨任务泛化，仿真中相对提升最高207%，真实世界成功率从5.8%提升至65.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种即插即用的VLA-Pro框架，通过存储任务相关程序记忆并在推理时动态检索与融合，显著提升VLA模型在未见任务上的跨任务泛化性能。
analysis.method: 训练时将任务特定LoRA适配器存储为参数化程序记忆；推理时根据多模态上下文检索相关程序记忆并动态融合生成当前动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA-Pro框架，通过训练时存储任务特定LoRA适配器作为程序记忆并在推理时检索融合，提升视觉-语言-动作模型跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于VLA模型的跨任务泛化，属于本站核心主题；提出的程序记忆检索与迁移机制对VLA策略学习具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies increasingly rely on asynchronous inference to hide model latency behind ongoing robot motion. During inference, the robot continues executing its current action chunk while the next chunk is generated from the observation available at inference start. By the time the new chunk is executed, the robot or scene may have changed, so an action that fits the prediction-time state can be misaligned with the execution-time state. Training-time methods modify the policy input or supervised target based on the expected execution delay, but do not directly supervise how actions should change as the scene evolves between prediction and execution. Runtime repair methods improve chunk continuity or modify actions during deployment, but can still leave actions aligned with the prediction-time state rather than the execution-time state. Our key insight is that execution-time observations are unavailable when the online prediction is made but are available in recorded trajectories during offline training, making the prediction-execution mismatch observable during training. We propose DEFLECT, an offline post-training framework that turns this temporal contrast into preference supervision for a policy acting from stale inputs. Across Kinetix, LIBERO, and three real-robot tasks, DEFLECT improves delay robustness across the evaluated VLA policies and settings. At the longest supported delay, it improves success by 4.2 percentage points over VLASH on Kinetix and by 22.7 points over naive asynchronous execution with GR00T N1.7 on LIBERO.

analysis.key_results: 在Kinetix、LIBERO及三个真实机器人任务上提升了延迟鲁棒性；在最长支持延迟下，Kinetix上成功率比VLASH提高4.2个百分点，LIBERO上比GR00T N1.7的朴素异步执行提高22.7个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DEFLECT离线后训练框架，将预测-执行时间不匹配转化为对来自滞后输入的策略的偏好监督，从而直接教导动作应如何随场景演化而变化。
analysis.method: 离线利用记录轨迹中可用的执行时观测，构建时间反事实偏好，对在滞后输入上行动的策略进行偏好学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DEFLECT利用离线轨迹中的执行时观测构建时间反事实偏好监督，提升视觉-语言-动作策略在异步推理下的延迟鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in egocentric video understanding, but their ability to reason cooperatively from multiple embodied viewpoints remains largely unexplored. We study this problem through multi-robot cooperative dynamic spatial reasoning, where a model must answer spatial, temporal, visibility, and coordination questions by integrating synchronized egocentric videos from a team of moving robots. To support this setting, we introduce CoopSR, the first benchmark for this task, together with EgoTeam, a multi-robot egocentric QA dataset. EgoTeam contains 114,227 QA pairs spanning 19 question types, four difficulty tiers, and three team sizes in Habitat and iGibson, along with a real-world test set of around 2,326 QAs collected using two quadruped robots. We further propose SG-CoR (Spectral and Geometry-Aware Cooperative Reasoner), an MLLM framework for fine-grained cooperative spatial reasoning. SG-CoR combines dynamics-aware multi-robot frame sampling, spectral- and geometric-guided view fusion, and geometry- and motion-informed prompt distillation, enabling the model to benefit from privileged robot-pose supervision during training while requiring only egocentric videos at test time. Across 22 MLLM baselines, SG-CoR consistently improves cooperative reasoning, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned baseline by +3.87% on Habitat and +7.12% on iGibson. It also shows stronger generalization to unseen team sizes and real-world robot tests. Code can be found at https://github.com/KPeng9510/seeing-together.git.

analysis.key_results: SG-CoR在22个多模态大语言模型基线上一致提升协作推理性能，在Habitat上优于最强微调基线+3.87%，在iGibson上优于+7.12%，并展现出对未见团队规模和真实世界机器人测试更强的泛化能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个多机器人协作空间推理基准CoopSR、多机器人自我中心问答数据集EgoTeam，以及SG-CoR多模态大语言模型框架。
analysis.method: SG-CoR框架结合动态感知的多机器人帧采样、基于谱与几何的视角融合，以及几何与运动信息引导的提示蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作引入首个多机器人协作动态空间推理基准CoopSR和数据集EgoTeam，并提出SG-CoR框架以提升多模态大语言模型在协作空间推理任务上的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦多机器人自我中心视频的空间推理与协作，属于具身智能和视觉-语言-动作领域，其方法对多智能体下的VLA模型、机器人策略学习以及协作世界理解具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a lightweight draft model propose speculative windows of candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. In practice, speculative efficiency is often bottlenecked by hard-to-draft positions, where an early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the speculative window. Most learning-based drafters are still optimized with token-level supervised objectives, even though speculative utility is inherently window-level and prefix-sensitive. We propose PPOW (Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing), a reinforcement learning framework that shifts drafter optimization from token-level imitation to window-level optimization. PPOW combines a Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, a Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, and Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing, which prioritizes informative windows with high confidence-weighted draft-target divergence. PPOW achieves average acceptance lengths of 6.29-6.52 and speedups of 3.39-4.36$\times$ across multiple model families and benchmarks under a unified decoding protocol. These results show that performance-driven window-level optimization is a practical approach to improving speculative decoding efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 在多个模型家族和基准上，统一解码协议下实现了平均接受长度6.29-6.52和加速比3.39-4.36倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PPOW（Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing），一个强化学习框架，将草稿模型优化从token级模仿转向窗口级优化，结合成本感知加速奖励、分布近似奖励和自适应分歧感知窗口，提升投机解码效率。
analysis.method: PPOW框架，包含Cost-Aware Speedup Reward、Distribution-Based Proximity Reward和Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing，用强化学习训练草稿模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PPOW框架，用强化学习替代传统的有监督微调，通过窗口级优化提升投机解码的接受长度和加速比。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于投机解码的效率优化，不直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其高效推理方法可能对机器人策略模型（如VLA）的部署具有潜在参考价值。

papers.title: Performance-Driven Policy Optimization for Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Windowing

papers.abstract: Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在15项原子任务、6项组合工作流和3项双手任务的基准测试中，AugSmolVLA在正常和高曝光条件下均优于ACT、X-VLA和原始SmolVLA，尤其在精确放置、透明物体操作、组合工作流和视觉退化场景。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BioProVLA-Agent系统，集成协议解析、视觉状态验证和具身执行，并开发AugSmolVLA在线增强策略提升湿实验室视觉扰动下的执行稳定性。
analysis.method: 系统由LLM协议代理、VLM-RAG验证代理和VLA具身代理组成，通过轻量级策略执行经验证的子任务；AugSmolVLA针对透明器皿、反射、光照变化和过曝进行在线增强。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个由VLA模型驱动的经济型、协议驱动、视觉增强的具身多智能体系统，用于生物实验室操作，并开发了在线增强策略AugSmolVLA以提升在视觉干扰下的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是VLA模型在生物实验室操作中的应用，不涉及WAM（世界模型），但通过多智能体闭环节点和AugSmolVLA轻量化策略，对机器人策略学习和高效推理具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving receive navigation commands and hazard notices as disconnected text fragments, forcing the model to discover on its own which environmental constraints are relevant to the current maneuver. We introduce Causal Scene Narration (CSN), which restructures VLA text inputs through intent-constraint alignment, quantitative grounding, and structured separation at inference time with zero GPU cost. To test CSN across different model states and safety layers, we evaluate it alongside training-time preference alignment (PL-DPO-NLL) and runtime supervision as experimental conditions. A multi-town CARLA evaluation (16 routes, 8 towns, N=5, 95% bootstrap CIs) shows that CSN yields relative improvements in CARLA Driving Score (DS, route completion weighted by infraction penalty) of +31.1% on original LMDrive and +24.5% on the PL-DPO-NLL variant. A controlled ablation separating information content from text organization reveals that information content carries most of CSN's gain across both model weights (+6.17 DS on original LMDrive; +6.88 DS on PL-DPO-NLL). While causal structure accounts for an estimated 39.1% (95% CI [6.6%, 71.4%]) of the gain on original LMDrive versus 13.5% on PL-DPO-NLL, the structural share on the aligned model and the cross-configuration asymmetry remain statistically inconclusive at N=5 due to wide bootstrap intervals. A perception noise ablation further confirms that CSN's benefit survives distance errors up to +/-5 m, speed noise up to +/-30%, and 20% actor miss rates. Finally, we report a negative result on combining CSN with runtime supervision: a naive direction-conflict monitor never fires on this benchmark and, when paired with CSN, degrades DS via passive control clamping that truncates CSN-guided evasive maneuvers. Code is available at https://github.com/LiYun0607/CausalSceneNarration.

analysis.key_results: 在CARLA多城镇评估中，CSN将LMDrive驾驶得分提高31.1%，将PL-DPO-NLL变体提高24.5%；内容信息是主要增益来源，结构作用因置信区间宽而不确定；感知噪声下鲁棒；与运行时监督的简单组合产生负面结果。
analysis.limitations: 结构增益在PL-DPO-NLL上不显著；结合运行时监督的简单方向冲突监控器导致性能下降；样本量N=5导致统计功效有限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出因果场景叙述（CSN），通过意图-约束对齐、量化 grounding 和结构化分离，在推理时重构VLA模型的文本输入，无需训练或GPU成本。
analysis.method: CSN将导航命令和危险提示重构为因果结构的文本，并在推理时使用；与训练时偏好对齐（PL-DPO-NLL）和运行时监督结合评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出因果场景叙述（CSN），在推理时零GPU成本重构VLA模型的文本输入，以提升自动驾驶性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接研究VLA模型的性能提升，通过优化文本输入结构来增强视觉-语言-动作模型的泛化与安全性，属于VLA的核心主题，对本站的VLA研究具有直接相关性。

papers.abstract: We introduce Latent-WAM, an efficient end-to-end autonomous driving framework that achieves strong trajectory planning through spatially-aware and dynamics-informed latent world representations. Existing world-model-based planners suffer from inadequately compressed representations, limited spatial understanding, and underutilized temporal dynamics, resulting in sub-optimal planning under constrained data and compute budgets. Latent-WAM addresses these limitations with two core modules: a Spatial-Aware Compressive World Encoder (SCWE) that distills geometric knowledge from a foundation model and compresses multi-view images into compact scene tokens via learnable queries, and a Dynamic Latent World Model (DLWM) that employs a causal Transformer to autoregressively predict future world status conditioned on historical visual and ego status representations. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v2 and HUGSIM demonstrate new state-of-the-art results: 89.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 28.9 HD-Score on HUGSIM, surpassing the best prior perception-free method by 3.2 EPDMS with significantly less training data and a compact 104M-parameter model. The code and model weights have been open-sourced at https://github.com/yukki555/Latent-WAM.

analysis.key_results: NAVSIM v2上89.3 EPDMS，HUGSIM上28.9 HD-Score，超越最佳先前感知自由方法3.2 EPDMS，使用显著更少的训练数据和104M参数模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Latent-WAM框架，结合空间感知压缩世界编码器和动态潜在世界模型，在NAVSIM v2和HUGSIM上取得新SOTA，以104M参数和更少训练数据超越先前最佳感知自由方法。
analysis.method: 空间感知压缩世界编码器（SCWE）蒸馏基础模型几何知识，将多视图图像压缩为紧凑场景token；动态潜在世界模型（DLWM）使用因果Transformer自回归预测未来世界状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Latent-WAM，通过空间感知压缩世界编码器和动态潜在世界模型，在紧凑模型与少数据下实现端到端自动驾驶的先进轨迹规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文以潜在世界动作建模（WAM）为核心，通过压缩世界表示和动态预测实现自动驾驶规划，与本站WAM主题高度相关，并关注数据和计算效率。

figures.caption: Overall architecture of Latent-WAM. The framework consists of three modules: (1) Spatial-Aware Compressive World Encoder (SCWE) compresses images into compact scene tokens with geometric distillation for spatial understanding; (2) Dynamic Latent World Model (DLWM) predicts future world states from historical scene representations and ego status; (3) Trajectory Decoder forecasts 4-second trajectories. SCWE and DLWM jointly optimize the vision backbone. Notably, DLWM is used only during training and discarded at inference, while its prediction objective enriches the vision backbone, enabling the trajectory decoder to directly use SCWE representations for planning.

papers.abstract: A fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy can easily place the alphabet soup in the basket on command, just as it saw during fine-tuning. However, if the basket is shifted five centimeters to the left, it drops the soup off the table. We developed an interpretability pipeline to investigate what such a policy is computing. Injecting task A's activations into the action expert while the policy looks at task B's scene makes pi0.5 execute task A's motor trajectory in 99.6\% of episodes ($n{=}1{,}968$). The injected program is bound to absolute workspace coordinates and ignores the visible scene, which provides a mechanistic account of the perturbation brittleness that concurrent benchmarks report. The binding holds on a physical UR10e: directed replay redirects the commanded task in 26/26 rollouts in one direction and 18/26 in the other, with no-injection and random-direction controls at the floor, and once the source object is moved 10--15\,cm the arm grasps and releases at the recorded coordinates in 50/50 trials, picking up the wrong block when one sits there and closing on empty air when none does. Applying the same interventions to six VLAs on LIBERO, MetaWorld, SimplerEnv, and ALOHA over 420{,}000+ rollouts yields three further findings: every architecture encodes the instruction, and four of the five weight it below vision whenever the scene alone identifies the goal; under the standard replacement write-back the SAE pooling that preserves behavior is architecture-specific (pi0.5 per-token, SmolVLA indifferent), and goal selection and motor generation separate into VLM and expert pathways wherever the two are distinguishable. We release \textbf{Action Atlas} (https://action-atlas.com), an interactive platform covering all 520+ trained SAEs, 79 identified concepts, and the scored UR10e rollouts. Code: https://github.com/CWRU-AISM/action-atlas

analysis.key_results: 注入任务A的激活可使pi0.5在99.6%的episodes中执行任务A的轨迹；物理UR10e上定向重放成功率26/26和18/26；移动源物体10-15cm后，50/50试验在记录坐标处抓取；每个架构编码指令，四个模型将指令权重置于视觉之下；目标选择与运动生成在可区分时分离。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一套可解释性流水线，定位并操控VLA策略中的内部特征，证明注入任务A的激活可使pi0.5在任务B场景中执行任务A的轨迹，并发现模型将指令编码与视觉信息分离。
analysis.method: 因果干预、稀疏自编码器（SAE）、激活注入、定向重放，并在多个基准（LIBERO、MetaWorld、SimplerEnv、ALOHA）上对六种VLA模型进行超过420,000次实验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文通过因果干预和稀疏自编码器，对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行可解释性分析，揭示了模型的内部工作机制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文主题为VLA策略的可解释性分析，通过因果干预揭示VLA内部特征如何绑定绝对坐标并导致分布外脆弱性，对理解VLA的工作机制和提升鲁棒性具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Current methods in robot learning are fundamentally bottlenecked by one or more of: hand-designed rewards, simulation modeling, or action supervision (e.g. teleoperation) each requiring significant domain expertise, engineering effort, and robot-operator labor. Towards reducing these bottlenecks, this work pursues observational learning via Inverse Reinforcement Learning from Observation (IRLfO) in which only access to task observations (e.g. video) is assumed. Due to the challenging setting and limitations of RL methods, IRLfO has thus far remained impractical for real-world robot learning. Here, we present the first IRL method to learn visual manipulation in the real world from scratch, and the first real-world demonstration of positive online transfer across visual manipulation tasks from scratch. In under 40 minutes, MPAIL2 learns pick-and-place from scratch to 82%, where RL and BC with equal interaction and demonstration budgets reach only 0% and 12% despite their reward and action supervision. Interactive project page with training videos: https://uwrobotlearning.github.io/mpail2/

analysis.key_results: 在40分钟内，MPAIL2学习拾放任务成功率达到82%，而具有相同交互和演示预算的RL和BC仅分别达到0%和12%
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了首个能够在真实世界中从零学习视觉操作任务的逆强化学习方法（IRLfO），并展示了第一个真实世界中跨视觉操作任务的正向在线迁移
analysis.method: 在线世界建模 + 逆强化学习从观察（IRLfO）

papers.abstract: As neural networks continue to scale, low-precision quantization is widely adopted in edge accelerators, but conventional multi-threshold activation hardware requires 2^n-1 thresholds for n-bit integer outputs, leading to rapidly increasing hardware costs. We propose GRAU, a Generic Runtime-Reconfigurable Activation-Requantization Unit that fuses batch normalization, nonlinear activation, and requantization through piecewise-linear fitting with Power-of-Two slopes. GRAU requires only basic comparators and 1-bit right shifters, while supporting mixed-precision quantization and runtime switching among post-accumulation functions, including modern nonlinear activations such as SiLU and GELU. Compared with multi-threshold activation-requantization units, GRAU reduces LUT consumption by approximately 90% or more while improving hardware efficiency, flexibility, and scalability. We further explore the trade-off between accuracy and hardware cost across different approximation settings and provide an open-source toolchain for GRAU-aware network training.

analysis.key_results: 与多阈值激活再量化单元相比，GRAU将LUT消耗降低约90%或更多，同时提升硬件效率、灵活性和可扩展性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GRAU，通过2的幂斜率分段线性拟合融合批归一化、激活和再量化，仅需基本比较器和1位移位器即可支持混合精度和多种激活函数，并大幅降低LUT消耗。
analysis.method: 使用2的幂斜率分段线性拟合，实现批归一化、非线性激活和再量化的融合，硬件上仅需比较器和1位右移器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种融合批归一化、非线性激活和再量化的通用运行时可重构激活再量化硬件单元GRAU，以支持混合精度量化并降低硬件成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于量化神经网络加速器的高效硬件设计，不直接涉及VLA/WAM或机器人策略，但作为模型量化技术，可为VLA/WAM模型在边缘设备的部署提供潜在的能效和面积优化。

papers.abstract: World-model-based imagine-then-act becomes a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches typically support either purely image-based forecasting or reasoning over partial 3D geometry, limiting their ability to predict complete 4D scene dynamics. This work proposes a novel embodied 4D world model that enables geometrically consistent, arbitrary-view RGBD generation: given only a single-view RGBD observation as input, the model imagines the remaining viewpoints, which can then be back-projected and fused to assemble a more complete 3D structure across time. To efficiently learn the multi-view, cross-modality generation, we explicitly design cross-view and cross-modality feature fusion that jointly encourage consistency between RGB and depth and enforce geometric alignment across views. Beyond prediction, converting generated futures into actions is often handled by inverse dynamics, which is ill-posed because multiple actions can explain the same transition. We address this with a test-time action optimization strategy that backpropagates through the generative model to infer a trajectory-level latent best matching the predicted future, and a residual inverse dynamics model that turns this trajectory prior into accurate executable actions. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate strong performance on both 4D scene generation and downstream manipulation, and ablations provide practical insights into the key design choices.

analysis.key_results: 在三个数据集上，模型在4D场景生成和下游操作任务上均表现强劲。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种具身4D世界模型，实现由单视角RGBD输入生成几何一致的任意视角RGBD，并通过跨视图、跨模态特征融合增强一致性；同时提出测试时动作优化策略和残差逆动力学模型，解决逆动力学病态问题。
analysis.method: 设计跨视图和跨模态特征融合以联合鼓励RGB与深度一致性并强化跨视角几何对齐；在测试时通过生成模型反向传播优化轨迹级隐变量，并结合残差逆动力学模型将轨迹先验转化为动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种具身4D世界模型，可从单视角RGBD生成任意视角的多视角RGBD并进行3D融合，并通过测试时动作优化与残差逆动力学将预测未来转化为可执行动作。

papers.abstract: One-Step Diffusion Models have demonstrated promising capability and fast inference in video super-resolution (VSR) for real-world. Nevertheless, the substantial model size and high computational cost of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) limit downstream applications. While low-bit quantization is a common approach for model compression, the effectiveness of quantized models is challenged by the high dynamic range of input latent and diverse layer behaviors. To deal with these challenges, we introduce LSGQuant, a layer-sensitivity guided quantizing approach for one-step diffusion-based real-world VSR. Our method incorporates a Dynamic Range Adaptive Quantizer (DRAQ) to fit video token activations. Furthermore, we estimate layer sensitivity and implement a Variance-Oriented Layer Training Strategy (VOLTS) by analyzing layer-wise statistics in calibration. We also introduce Quantization-Aware Optimization (QAO) to jointly refine the quantized branch and a retained high-precision branch. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method has nearly performance to origin model with full-precision and significantly exceeds existing quantization techniques. Code is available at: https://github.com/zhengchen1999/LSGQuant.

analysis.key_results: 在真实世界视频超分辨率任务上，量化后模型性能接近全精度模型，且显著优于现有量化技术。
analysis.main_contribution: 针对一步扩散视频超分辨率模型，提出LSGQuant量化框架，结合动态范围自适应量化器、面向方差的层训练策略和量化感知优化，显著优于现有量化方法。
analysis.method: LSGQuant包含动态范围自适应量化器（DRAQ）、方差导向的层训练策略（VOLTS）和量化感知优化（QAO），联合保留高精度分支进行校准和训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LSGQuant，一种层敏感度引导的量化方法，用于压缩一步扩散视频超分辨率模型并保持性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于视频超分辨率中的模型量化，不涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界动作模型）。其层敏感度分析和量化训练策略对高效推理有一定参考价值，但与机器人动作预测或世界建模无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods for large language models compress pretrained weights to low bit-widths without retraining by optimizing layer-local proxy objectives. Activation-aware scaling methods such as AWQ protect input channels with large activation norms, whereas second-order error-compensation methods such as GPTQ redistribute rounding error using the inverse of the unweighted input covariance matrix. We show that both paradigms -- along with diagonal Fisher quantization, block reconstruction, and Hadamard rotation methods -- are special cases of minimizing a single loss-derived quadratic form governed by gradient-weighted activation sensitivity. From a Gauss-Newton expansion of the task loss at a linear layer $Y = X W^\top$, we prove that under isotropic output curvature the expected excess loss from weight perturbation $\Delta W$ reduces to $\frac{1}{2 d_{\mathrm{out}}}\operatorname{Tr}(\Delta W H_D \Delta W^\top)$, where $H_D = \frac{1}{n} X^\top D X$ weights each calibration token's outer product by its squared output-gradient norm $D_{tt} = \|\nabla_{y_t}\mathcal{L}\|_2^2$. Within this framework, AWQ corresponds to a diagonal approximation of $H_D$ with uniform token weights ($D = I_n$) optimized via channel scaling, while GPTQ corresponds to Cholesky error compensation on $H_D$ under $D = I_n$. We derive closed-form optimal scaling exponents for diagonal sensitivity protection, formulate sensitivity-weighted Cholesky quantization (SAQ-GPTQ) on $H_D$, and prove bounds on token-gradient heterogeneity bias, cross-layer error amplification across residual blocks, and finite-sample calibration concentration. Controlled numerical simulations confirm that under token-gradient heterogeneity, replacing $X^\top X$ with $X^\top D X$ preserves $>99\%$ top-channel saliency recall and reduces INT3/INT4 excess loss by roughly $3\times$ over unweighted GPTQ.

analysis.key_results: 在控制数值模拟中，在 token 梯度异质性条件下，用 X^T D X 替换 X^T X 可保留超过99%的顶级通道显著性召回率，并将 INT3/INT4 超额损失减少约3倍（相较于未加权 GPTQ）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个统一的框架，将AWQ、GPTQ等多种训练后量化方法解释为最小化由梯度加权激活灵敏度所控制的同一二次形式，并证明在输出曲率各向同性的条件下，期望超额损失可简化为基于加权输入协方差矩阵的表达式。
analysis.method: 通过高斯-牛顿展开与推导，构造了由梯度加权的激活灵敏度矩阵 H_D = X^T D X / n，其中 D 为输出梯度平方范数作为对角权重。在此框架下，AWQ 被解释为具有均匀 token 权重的对角近似，GPTQ 则是在该矩阵上的 Cholesky误差补偿；进而推导出对角灵敏度保护的最优缩放指数公式，并提出灵敏度加权的 Cholesky 量化方法 SAQ-GPTQ。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文将多种训练后量化方法统一为最小化由梯度加权激活灵敏度控制的损失导出二次形式，并基于此提出灵敏度加权的Cholesky量化（SAQ-GPTQ）。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show promising knowledge accumulation ability through pretraining, yet continual learning remains challenging. Existing continual imitation learning (CIL) methods often require additional parameters or modules, limiting scalability for large VLA models. We propose Stellar VLA, a knowledge-driven CIL framework without parameter growth, featuring two variants: T-Stellar for task-centric modeling and TS-Stellar for hierarchical modeling of reusable skills across tasks. Stellar VLA jointly optimizes task representations and a self-evolving knowledge space, with knowledge-posterior-guided expert routing using knowledge relations and Top-K semantic embeddings for task specialization. Experiments on LIBERO demonstrate strong performance against VLA and CIL baselines with only 1% replay. Dual-arm real-world experiments validate knowledge transfer across embodiments and scenes. TS-Stellar excels in hierarchical manipulation, while visualizations demonstrate knowledge retention and task discovery. Project Website: https://stellarvla.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上以仅1%回放超越VLA和CIL基线；双机械臂真实世界实验验证跨本体和场景的知识迁移；TS-Stellar在层次化操作中表现优异；可视化展示知识保留和任务发现。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Stellar VLA框架，包括T-Stellar和TS-Stellar两种变体，通过联合优化任务表示和自演化知识空间，实现无参数增长的持续模仿学习，并利用知识后验引导的专家路由和Top-K语义嵌入进行任务专业化。
analysis.method: 联合优化任务表示和自演化知识空间，使用知识后验引导的专家路由和Top-K语义嵌入，以及任务中心建模（T-Stellar）与层次化技能建模（TS-Stellar）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Stellar VLA，一种无需参数增长的持续模仿学习框架，通过任务表示和自演化知识空间实现技能的持续学习与迁移。

papers.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models often exceed a single accelerator's memory capacity. Offloading experts to host memory creates a severe PCIe I/O bottleneck because data-dependent routing keeps transfers on the critical path. We present Specter, an inference system that uses quantization to combine speculative decoding with expert offloading. Its lightweight quantized draft model runs efficiently on device while preserving high-fidelity expert activation patterns. This provides accurate multi-step lookahead over future expert usage, allowing the runtime to organize expert movement and execution ahead of verification and improve both communication and execution efficiency. Under single-request inference, Specter achieves an average 1.50x (up to 1.88x) speedup in time per output token (TPOT) over the state-of-the-art system. Specter makes memory-constrained, single-GPU MoE inference more practical on commodity hardware. Our code is available at https://github.com/wwwwwf/specter_asplos.

analysis.key_results: 在单请求推理中，相比现有最先进系统，TPOT平均加速1.50倍，最高1.88倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Specter推理系统，将量化与推测解码结合用于专家卸载，通过精确的多步预测优化通信与执行效率，单请求推理下TPOT平均加速达1.50倍。
analysis.method: 使用轻量量化草稿模型在设备上高效运行，保持高保真专家激活模式，实现多步前瞻预测未来专家使用，从而预先组织专家移动和执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Specter利用量化草稿模型实现多步推测解码，结合专家卸载以加速单GPU上的MoE推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用MoE模型的高效推理，不直接涉及VLA或WAM；但所提出的量化与推测解码结合方法可为VLA/WAM等大型模型的边缘部署提供效率优化思路。

papers.abstract: We present Actron3D, a framework that enables robots to acquire transferable 6-DoF manipulation skills from monocular, uncalibrated, RGB-only human demonstration videos. Our key idea is to represent manipulation knowledge within a video as a continuous neural function over object space. At the core of Actron3D lies the Neural Affordance Function, which distills geometry, visual features, contact priors, and action flows from diverse demonstration videos into a compact 3D neural representation. During deployment, we adopt a hierarchical pipeline that retrieves the matched affordance function and transfers encoded manipulation knowledge to novel objects through coarse-to-fine differentiable optimization. Leveraging the continuous nature of Neural Affordance Function, the framework performs spatial queries over multimodal features to align demonstrations with observations and generates precise 6-DoF manipulation policy. Experiments in both simulation and the real-world demonstrate that Actron3D significantly outperforms prior methods, achieving a 14.9 percentage point improvement in the average success rate across 13 tasks while requiring only 2-3 demonstration videos per task.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，Actron3D 在 13 项任务上的平均成功率相较先前方法提高 14.9 个百分点，且每项任务仅需 2-3 个演示视频。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Neural Affordance Function，将演示视频中的几何、视觉特征、接触先验和动作流蒸馏为紧凑的 3D 神经表示，并通过由粗到细的可微优化实现跨物体技能迁移。
analysis.method: 采用 Neural Affordance Function 表示操作知识，部署时通过分层流水线检索匹配的可负担函数，利用可微优化进行多模态特征空间查询以对齐演示与观测，生成 6-DoF 操作策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Actron3D 是一个从单目 RGB 人类演示视频中学习可迁移 6-DoF 操作技能的框架，其核心是用神经可负担函数将操作知识表示为连续 3D 神经函数。

papers.abstract: The generalization of vision-language-action (VLA) models heavily relies on diverse training data. However, acquiring large-scale robot manipulation data across varied object appearances is costly and labor-intensive. To address this, we introduce Embodied Manipulation Media Adaptation (EMMA), a framework for augmenting VLA policies that combines a generative data engine with an effective training pipeline. We introduce DreamTransfer, a diffusion Transformer-based architecture for generating multi-view consistent and geometrically plausible embodied manipulation videos. It supports text-driven video editing on foreground, background and lighting while preserving 3D structure and geometric fidelity. We also utilize a hybrid training set of real and generated data and propose AdaMix to enhance the training process. AdaMix is a training strategy that adaptively weights samples according to policy performance to emphasize challenging samples. Evaluations show DreamTransfer outperforms previous video generation models in multi-view consistency, geometric fidelity, and text-conditioning precision. In real-world robotic tasks with zero-shot visual settings, our framework achieves a relative performance increase of over 92% compared to training with real data alone, and improves by an additional 17% with AdaMix.

analysis.key_results: 在真实机器人零样本视觉任务中，相对仅用真实数据训练，性能提升超过92%；加入AdaMix后额外提升17%；DreamTransfer在多项指标上优于现有视频生成模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入EMMA框架，结合扩散Transformer生成多视角一致的具身操作视频和自适应训练策略，显著提升VLA模型在真实机器人零样本视觉任务中的鲁棒性。
analysis.method: DreamTransfer生成多视角一致、几何合理的操作视频，支持文本驱动的编辑；AdaMix根据策略表现对样本进行自适应加权；混合真实与生成数据进行训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出EMMA框架，通过生成式数据引擎DreamTransfer和训练策略AdaMix增强VLA策略的泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA策略的数据增强和训练改进，属于VLA的核心研究，与本站主题高度相关。
